ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_060..translation: Хе-хе, без проблем. Я сделаю все возможное, чтобы вы, девочки, были счастливы!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_060..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_060..original: When you have kids of your own, make some delicious pancakes for them, too.
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_060..translation: Если у вас есть дети, приготовьте для них вкусные блины.

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_060..original: We will. We'll treasure this forever.
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_060..translation: Мы будем. Мы будем хранить это вечно.

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_060..speaker: System
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_060..original: <CLEG>Mother's Recipe Notes<CLNR> received.
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_060..translation: <CLEG>Записки рецептов матери<CLNR> получены.

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: ...So cute.
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: ...Как мило.

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Eh?
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Э?

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: I've been thinking it all this time, of course, but the two of you are just so cute!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Я, конечно, все это время думал об этом, но вы двое такие милые!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Look at the foresight I had, in making clothing that turned out to suit you so well!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Посмотрите, какую предусмотрительность я проявил, создав одежду, которая так вам подошла!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Hey, that's right! I didn't think we'd ever get to, but now you've seen us wearing this!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Эй, это правда! Я не думал, что мы когда-нибудь доберемся до этого, но теперь вы видели, как мы носим это!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Yes! Hehe, what do you think, Mom? Do we look like alchemists?
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Да! Хе-хе, что ты думаешь, мама? Мы похожи на алхимиков?

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Yes, you do! Like exceptionally talented, exceptionally cute alchemists!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Да, так и есть! Как исключительно талантливые, исключительно милые алхимики!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: We need to get Roger to paint this. Your cuteness needs to be preserved for future generations!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Нам нужно, чтобы Роджер это нарисовал. Ваша привлекательность должна быть сохранена для будущих поколений!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Hahah! You're starting to sound like Liane...
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Ха-ха! Ты начинаешь походить на Лиану...

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: D-Don't worry, Mom! You don't need a painting, we'll come any time you want to see us!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Д-Не волнуйся, мама! Вам не нужна картина, мы приедем в любое время, когда вы захотите нас видеть!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Rip? Did I just hear a ripping sound?
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Рвать? Я только что услышал треск?

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Aaaaah! My clothing ripped! My side, my side is completely exposed!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Ааааа! Моя одежда порвалась! Моя сторона, моя сторона полностью раскрыта!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Oh my! Suelle, sorry, but can you take that off for a moment?
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: О боже! Сюэль, извини, но ты можешь снять это на минутку?

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: What? I think I'm too embarrassed to do that!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Что? Думаю, мне слишком стыдно это делать!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: It's alright. No one here to see. Come on, take it off!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Все в порядке. Здесь никого нет, чтобы увидеться. Давай, сними это!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Hands off, Mom! I can take off my own clothes!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Руки прочь, мама! Я могу снять свою одежду!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: There, all done. I'm glad there was a sewing kit here in the atelier.
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Вот и все готово. Я рада, что здесь, в ателье, появился набор для шитья.

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Amazing, Mom... You fixed that in the blink of the eye!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Удивительно, мама... Ты исправила это в мгновение ока!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Thank you! Huh? It seems easier to move in than before!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Спасибо! Хм? Кажется, переехать легче, чем раньше!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Yes. It was getting too small, so I adjusted it a little, too.
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Да. Он стал слишком маленьким, поэтому я тоже его немного подкорректировал.

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: You've both grown so much bigger than I expected when I made this...
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Вы оба стали намного больше, чем я ожидал, когда делал это...

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Mom...
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Мама...

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: I'm glad. Hey, Lydie. Can I take a look at yours, too?
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Я рад. Привет, Лиди. Могу я тоже взглянуть на твою?

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: It must be getting tight as well. I'll fix it.
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Должно быть, тоже становится туго. Я исправлю это.

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Great! Thank you, Mom!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Большой! Спасибо, мама!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: I'll get you something to wear, then. It was super cold while I was waiting!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Тогда я принесу тебе что-нибудь надеть. Пока я ждал, было очень холодно!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Thanks, Sue. I'll go and get changed!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Спасибо, Сью. Я пойду переодеваться!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: That's good. Kids should always surpass the expectations of their adults.
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Это хорошо. Дети всегда должны превосходить ожидания взрослых.

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..original: Being able to watch them grow up, though... Roger, I'm so jealous.
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_070..translation: Но возможность наблюдать, как они растут... Роджер, я так завидую.

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Say, I have a request for you both...
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Скажите, у меня к вам обоим просьба...

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: A request? Do you want a massage? Have you got an itchy back?
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Просьба? Хотите массаж? У вас чешется спина?

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: No. Actually, I was thinking I want to give alchemy a try!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Нет. Вообще-то я подумал, что хочу попробовать алхимию!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Roger
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Whaaaat?!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Чтоааа?!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: W-What's brought this on? And Dad, where did you spring from?
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Ч-что на это повлияло? А папа, откуда ты взялся?

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Roger
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: I just wanted to see Honnete! Forget that, anyway! What do you mean, you want to try alchemy?!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Я просто хотел увидеть Оннет! В любом случае, забудьте об этом! Что значит, хочешь попробовать алхимию?!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Hah, I'm just feeling a bit lonely... Everyone in this family can use alchemy but me...
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Ха, мне просто немного одиноко... Все в этой семье умеют алхимию, кроме меня...

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: It's like I'm on the outside! So I want to give it a try!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Я как будто снаружи! Поэтому я хочу попробовать!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Ah, so that's why... What do you think, Dad?
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: А, так вот почему... Что ты думаешь, папа?

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Roger
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Hmm... Once she sets her mind on something, she won't budge... The same as someone else we know...
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Хм... Как только она что-то задумала, она не сдвинется с места... Как и кто-то еще, кого мы знаем...

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Yes, I think I know who you are talking about...
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Да, кажется, я знаю, о ком ты говоришь...

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: S-Someone else? Like who? Anyway, why don't we all teach her together?
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: С-Кто-то еще? Как кто? В любом случае, почему бы нам всем не научить ее вместе?

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Yes. Good idea. A whole family practicing alchemy together would be lovely!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Да. Хорошая идея. Было бы здорово, если бы вся семья вместе занималась алхимией!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Hehe, you're right! Take your time and teach me everything you can!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Хе-хе, ты прав! Не торопитесь и научите меня всему, чему сможете!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Alrighty. I add this next, do I?
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Хорошо. Я добавлю это следующим, не так ли?

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Roger
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Gaaah! T-too much! Water! Add some water and dilute it!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Гааа! Т-слишком много! Вода! Добавьте немного воды и разбавьте!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Next, mix it as hard as possible! Hahaha, this is fun!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Далее перемешиваем как можно сильнее! Ха-ха-ха, это весело!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: It's flying everywhere! Splashing everywhere! Go slower! Uwah, it's really bitter, too!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Он летает повсюду! Брызги повсюду! Иди медленнее! Ух, это тоже очень горько!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Finally, we adjust the heat. It's just like cooking!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Наконец, регулируем нагрев. Это как готовить!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Mom, hold on! Don't turn it up that high!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Мама, держись! Не включайте его так высоко!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Oh dear. At least I finally get to say this line...
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: О, Боже. По крайней мере, я наконец могу сказать эту фразу...

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: ...Fire in the hole!!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: ...Огонь в дыре!!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Roger
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: We've finally finished cleaning all that up. It was worse than Lydie and Sue's first attempt!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Мы наконец закончили все это убирать. Это было хуже, чем первая попытка Лиди и Сью!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Hahaha... It doesn't look like I'm suited to alchemy.
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Не похоже, что я подхожу для алхимии.

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: I'm sorry, Mom. I don't really want to say this, but I think you're right.
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Мне очень жаль, мама. Мне не очень хочется этого говорить, но я думаю, что ты прав.

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: You are so incredible, all three of you. You do something so difficult all the time, don't you...
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Вы такие невероятные, все трое. Ты все время делаешь что-то такое сложное, не так ли...

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Alchemists really are incredible!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Алхимики действительно невероятные!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Roger
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Honnete...
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Оннет...

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Lydie, Suelle, and Roger. Keep up the good work!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Лиди, Сюэль и Роджер. Продолжайте в том же духе!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: I want to be able to boast to everyone I meet about how great my alchemist family is!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Я хочу иметь возможность похвастаться перед всеми, кого я встречу, тем, насколько велика моя алхимическая семья!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: Sure! You can count on us, Mom!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Конечно! Ты можешь рассчитывать на нас, мама!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: We'll have our names ring out across every world there is, you'll see!
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Наши имена будут звучать во всех мирах, вот увидите!

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..original: I'm behind you all the way, girls. You are my precious treasures, after all.
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_080..translation: Я полностью за вами, девочки. В конце концов, вы — мои драгоценные сокровища.

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..original: (Your turn, Suelle. I'm going to test you to see if you remember. Promise with Mom Number 1?)
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..translation: (Твоя очередь, Сюэль. Я проверю тебя, помнишь ли ты. Обещание маме номер 1?)

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..original: (Easy! "Don't give up before you even try"!)

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..original: (I've got that one too! "Stay away from strange people"!)
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..translation: (У меня тоже есть такое! «Держись подальше от незнакомых людей»!)

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..original: (Hehe, I know! Maybe I can't study like Lydie...)
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..translation: (Хе-хе, я знаю! Может быть, я не смогу учиться, как Лиди...)

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..original: (But I remember all of our promises with you! I want to make you happy, Mom!)
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..translation: (Но я помню все наши с тобой обещания! Я хочу сделать тебя счастливой, мама!)

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..original: (Ah, good girl! Come here and let me pat you on the head!)
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_090..translation: (Ах, хорошая девочка! Подойди сюда, позволь мне погладить тебя по голове!)

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..original: (Look, Lydie! I found a lovely flower!)

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..original: (Yes, look! Mom, this is called a Punitrancer!)

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..original: (They call it that because it entrances puni. It's so cute, isn't it?)
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..translation: (Они называют его так, потому что оно захватывает дух. Это так мило, не правда ли?)

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..original: (Wow, I didn't know that! You know so much, Lydie. Have you been reading the encyclopedia again?)
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..translation: (Ух ты, я этого не знал! Ты так много знаешь, Лиди. Ты снова читала энциклопедию?)

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..original: (Yep! You bought it for me, so I've read it all the way through!)
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..translation: (Да! Вы купили это для меня, поэтому я прочитал это полностью!)

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..original: (That's amazing! You'll be a great scholar in the future!)
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..translation: (Это потрясающе! В будущем вы станете великим учёным!)

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..original: (What? No way! I want to be alchemist, just like Dad!)
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..translation: (Что? Ни в коем случае! Я хочу быть алхимиком, как папа!)

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..original: (Hehe, of course. But all this studying will pay off as well, I'm sure.)
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..translation: (Хе-хе, конечно. Но я уверен, что все это обучение тоже окупится.)

ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..speaker: Honnete
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..original: (You keep up the hard work and stay my bright little Lydie!)
ebm:qc08_hon/event_message_qc08_hon_100..translation: (Продолжай усердно работать и оставайся моей умной маленькой Лиди!)

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Mireille... Uwah, what a crazy line! She looks too busy to see us...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Мирей... Ух, какая сумасшедшая фраза! Она выглядит слишком занятой, чтобы видеть нас...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Next. Ah, tax related? Take these documents to the tax office.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Следующий. Ах, связано с налогами? Отнесите эти документы в налоговую инспекцию.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Next. Oh my, divorce? Fill this form, then. Next!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Следующий. О боже, развод? Тогда заполните эту форму. Следующий!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Wow, she's getting through them so quickly! The line is almost gone already!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Ого, она так быстро их преодолевает! Очередь уже почти закончилась!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Phew. Hey, girls! Is this about your Atelier Rank?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Уф. Эй, девочки! Речь идет о вашем ранге Ателье?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Ah, no... We just want to talk to you, actually.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Ах, нет... На самом деле мы просто хотим поговорить с тобой.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: That's more than welcome. Work has just calmed down a little, too.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Это более чем приветствуется. Работа тоже немного успокоилась.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: You handled that work so efficiently, Mireille!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Ты так хорошо справилась с этой работой, Мирей!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Yes, well, I have confidence in my work. I've been doing this since I was small, after all!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Да, ну, я уверен в своей работе. В конце концов, я занимаюсь этим с самого детства!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Ah, that confidence is so cool! You are wonderful, Mireille!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Ах, эта уверенность – это так здорово! Ты прекрасна, Мирей!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: I know. Cheerful, honest, and so skillful! Just the kind of woman I want to grow up to be!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Я знаю. Веселый, честный и такой умелый! Именно такой женщиной я хочу вырасти!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Oh... uhm...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Ох... хм...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Wow... Have we made you blush?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Ух ты... Мы тебя заставили покраснеть?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Don't...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Не...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: What?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Что?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Please, don't praise me like that... I'm just not used to it.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Пожалуйста, не хвалите меня так... Я просто к этому не привыкла.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: I've been living in a world of adults since I was a child. Doing this job is just what I was raised to do.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Я с детства живу в мире взрослых. Выполнение этой работы — это именно то, для чего меня воспитали.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Hahaha, that's unexpected! You're so beautiful, well dressed, and smart!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха, это неожиданно! Ты такая красивая, хорошо одетая и умная!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: I know! You have such smooth skin, too. Not to mention your wonderful handwriting!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Я знаю! У тебя тоже такая гладкая кожа. Не говоря уже о вашем чудесном почерке!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: Hold it, girls! Stop it. Stop it! I can't stop blushing!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Держитесь, девочки! Прекрати это. Прекрати! Я не могу перестать краснеть!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..original: What are they playing at now...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_010..translation: Во что они сейчас играют...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: Hehehe. I've been waiting for you, girls.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: M-Mireille? You have an extremely evil-looking look on your face!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: М-Мирей? У тебя очень злобное выражение лица!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: Don't I just! I'm planning something really evil, that's why.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Разве я не просто так! Я планирую что-то действительно злое, вот почему.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: I'm going to give you a special test now. If you can't do it, I'm dropping your rank!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Сейчас я устрою тебе специальный тест. Если ты не сможешь этого сделать, я снижу твой ранг!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: What?! Drop our rank?! Why would you do such a thing?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Что?! Понизить наш ранг?! Зачем вам это делать?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: Hah! This is payback for all those things you said to me before. I was so, so embarrassed!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Ха! Это расплата за все то, что ты сказал мне раньше. Мне было так, так стыдно!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: Tyrant! This is an abuse of power!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: What are you talking about? I'm just testing you, following the rules of the system!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: О чем ты говоришь? Я просто проверяю вас, соблюдая правила системы!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: Gah, this is hopeless! It's like hitting a puni with a stick!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Гах, это безнадежно! Это всё равно, что бить пуни палкой!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: We can't outmaneuver her... Just give up. Come on then, Mireille. What is the test?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Мы не сможем ее перехитрить... Просто сдавайся. Тогда давай, Мирей. Что такое тест?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: I want you to make Zettel! The highest quality you can, or I won't accept it!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Я хочу, чтобы ты сделал Зеттеля! Максимум качества, какое только можно, иначе я его не приму!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..original: A tougher question than I expected... We have to do it! We don't want to lose our Rank!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_020..translation: Вопрос сложнее, чем я ожидал... Надо это сделать! Мы не хотим терять свое звание!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Mireille, we made the Zettel. Is this good enough?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Мирей, мы сделали Зеттель. Это достаточно хорошо?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Yes, you've passed! Although, to be quite honest, there's no test to pass!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Да, ты прошел! Хотя, если быть совсем честным, никакого испытания не пройти!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: ...What?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: ...Что?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Hehe! You mocked me, so I thought I'd get a little payback!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Хе-хе! Ты издевался надо мной, и я подумал, что получу небольшую расплату!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: I wanted this Zettel for memo paper. It's just so comfortable to write on!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Я хотел этот Зеттель для бумаги для заметок. На нем так удобно писать!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: T-That's it?! All that worry for nothing?!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Т-И это?! Все эти переживания напрасны?!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: I'm sorry. Here's your reward.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Мне жаль. Вот ваша награда.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Hold on. All we did was make some Zettel... Are you sure you want to give us this much?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Подожди. Все, что мы сделали, это приготовили немного Зеттеля... Вы уверены, что хотите дать нам столько?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Yes. As an apology for tricking you. Go ahead and take it.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Да. В качестве извинения за то, что обманул тебя. Давай, возьми это.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Thank you! If you just wanted memo paper, though, does it have to be Zettel?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Спасибо! Но если вам просто нужна бумага для заметок, обязательно ли это должна быть бумага Зеттель?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: I just use any scrap of paper I can get my hands on...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Я использую любой клочок бумаги, который попадается под руку...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Ah, well, you know what they say. Nothing's better than Bettel!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Ах, ну, ты знаешь, что они говорят. Нет ничего лучше, чем Беттель!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Huh...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Хм...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Hah...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Ха...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: You see, nothing's better than...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Понимаете, нет ничего лучше, чем...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: We heard you! We heard you, no need to say it again!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Мы вас услышали! Мы вас услышали, не нужно повторять это снова!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Good. Funny, wasn't it? Pretty witty on my part, I think you'll agree!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Хороший. Забавно, не так ли? Довольно остроумно с моей стороны, думаю, вы согласитесь!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Hah. You're so cool the rest of the time, Mireille, but sometimes you just...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Ха. В остальное время ты такая крутая, Мирей, но иногда ты просто...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: We should write this one on an official notice. It's so good everyone in the city should know it!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Нам следует написать это в официальном уведомлении. Как хорошо, что это должен знать каждый в городе!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: Uh... Please don't...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Э-э... Пожалуйста, не надо...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..speaker: System
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..original: 1800 Coll received.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_030..translation: Получено 1800 Колл.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: Say, twins. I've got something to ask you.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Скажем, близнецы. У меня есть кое-что у тебя спросить.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: Uwah, in perfect unison, too! I've been feeling it, but I guess you're right.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Ух ты, тоже в полном унисон! Я это чувствовал, но думаю, ты прав.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: It's too extreme, isn't it? Not being allowed to leave the castle until I'm grown!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Это слишком экстремально, не так ли? Мне не разрешат покидать замок, пока я не вырасту!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: Hahaha. I guess there's no helping that?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Ха-ха-ха. Я думаю, тут уже ничего не поделаешь?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: Maybe, but that's a bit too clean and easy for me... I'm in line for the throne, after all.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Возможно, но для меня это слишком чисто и легко... В конце концов, я в очереди на трон.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: In order to learn more about the world, I'm thinking of going to do a homestay somewhere.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Чтобы узнать больше о мире, я подумываю о том, чтобы пожить где-нибудь в семье.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: Just a regular household. I'll wear an apron and call the owner "Sir", that kind of thing!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Просто обычная семья. Я надену фартук и назову хозяина «сэр», и все такое!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: Hold it, Lydie! What was that noise for?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Держи, Лиди! Для чего был этот шум?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: That's not a "homestay"! I don't know what that is!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Это не «проживание в семье»! Я не знаю, что это такое!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: R-Really? Then I think I have to change my plans.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Р-Правда? Тогда я думаю, что мне придется изменить свои планы.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..original: It looks like I'm more sheltered than I thought... I guess I shouldn't tease him so much anymore.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_040..translation: Похоже, я более защищен, чем думал... Думаю, мне не следует больше его так дразнить.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Hehe! Hehehe!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Хе-хе! Хе-хе-хе!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: That's scary! That laugh is real scary, Mireille!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Это страшно! Этот смех очень пугает, Мирей!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Uwah, I'm going to have nightmares about that. You need to sleep with me tonight, Lydie...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Ух, мне будут сниться кошмары по этому поводу. Тебе нужно переспать со мной сегодня вечером, Лиди...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: I-It was that bad? Sorry!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Я-это было так плохо? Извини!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: You were watching those kids, right? Not thinking about eating them, are you?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Вы наблюдали за этими детьми, да? Не думаешь их съесть, да?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Ah! If I was going to eat anyone, I'd start with you two delicious morsels!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Ах! Если бы я собирался кого-нибудь съесть, я бы начал с вас, двух восхитительных кусочков!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Uwah!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Ува!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: I'm joking. I was just taking a break from work. Watching kids play is very calming, right?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Шучу. Я просто отдыхал от работы. Наблюдать за игрой детей очень успокаивает, правда?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Huh... I've not seen this side of you before, Mireille.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Ха... Я раньше не видела тебя с этой стороны, Мирей.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Seeing them play so innocently, it gives me the energy to keep on going.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Видя, как они играют так невинно, это дает мне силы продолжать идти дальше.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: To make a great kingdom, that everyone will be proud to live in once they grow up.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Создать великое королевство, в котором каждый будет гордиться тем, что живет в нем, когда вырастет.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Haha, most impressive. Thinking about the future even when you're taking a break from work!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Хаха, самое впечатляющее. Думая о будущем, даже когда отдыхаешь от работы!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: H-Hold on! I told you to stop praising me!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Х-Держись! Я же говорил тебе перестать меня хвалить!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Hahaha! Hey, Mireille. We're still kids ourselves, right?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Привет, Мирей. Мы сами еще дети, да?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: So how about you make the rank tests a bit easier? Just for us?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Так как насчет того, чтобы сделать тесты на ранги немного проще? Только для нас?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Very well, then. I'll make them as hard as I possibly can, just for that!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Тогда очень хорошо. Я сделаю их настолько трудными, насколько смогу, только ради этого!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: A real sweet and naive child would never ask such a thing! You've just proven your maturity!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Настоящий милый и наивный ребенок никогда бы такого не спросил! Вы только что доказали свою зрелость!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Gah! Forget I said anything! Keep things the same, things are fine as they are!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Га! Забудь, что я сказал! Продолжайте в том же духе, все в порядке, как есть!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: Haha, then don't try to get tricky! Kids should be honest and innocent.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Ха-ха, тогда не пытайся хитрить! Дети должны быть честными и невинными.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..original: There will be plenty of time for tricks once you are all grown up, believe me.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_050..translation: Поверьте мне, когда вы подрастете, у вас будет достаточно времени для трюков.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: Ah, twins! Perfect timing! I just found something really great in this draw!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Ах, близнецы! Идеальное время! Я только что нашел что-то действительно замечательное в этом розыгрыше!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: A certificate of marriage? For Mathias and... you!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Свидетельство о браке? Для Матиаса и... тебя!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: That's right! Mathias made this when we were kids!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Это верно! Матиас сделал это, когда мы были детьми!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: You said something great, didn't you?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Ты сказал что-то великое, не так ли?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: You know what he's like now, of course, but back then he was so cute!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Ты, конечно, знаешь, какой он сейчас, но тогда он был таким милым!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: Kind, smart, and obedient. The perfect little brother. Ah, this takes me back!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Добрый, умный и послушный. Идеальный младший брат. Ах, это возвращает меня назад!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: I can't really picture Mathias like that... Uwah, I don't even want to try!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Я вообще не могу представить себе Матиаса таким... Ух, даже пробовать не хочу!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: He said he wanted to make me happy, but of course as brother and sister we can't really get married!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Он сказал, что хочет сделать меня счастливой, но, конечно, как брат и сестра, мы не можем пожениться!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: So he promised that he'd become a fine king, and make all people happy, rather than just me.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Поэтому он пообещал, что станет прекрасным королем и сделает счастливыми всех людей, а не только меня.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: I'm still hoping he's up to the challenge, to be honest.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Честно говоря, я все еще надеюсь, что он справится с этой задачей.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: Ah, but don't tell him about this. He'll get all carried away again if he hears this.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Ах, но не говори ему об этом. Он снова увлечется, если услышит это.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: Hahaha, that's true. It will just be our secret, then!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Ха-ха-ха, это правда. Тогда это будет просто наш секрет!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..original: Good. I'll put this back in the desk. Until the day he finally keeps his promise.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_060..translation: Хороший. Я положу это обратно на стол. До того дня, когда он наконец сдержит свое обещание.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: Say, girls. Be honest. What do you think of Mathias?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Скажите, девочки. Будьте честны. Что вы думаете о Матиасе?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: Hmm. I mean, that's not an easy question to answer... He's not a bad person, but a bit flaky?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Хм. Я имею в виду, что на этот вопрос нелегко ответить... Он неплохой человек, но немного ненормальный?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: Hahaha, I see where you are coming from... He's funny, though, so I like him.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я понимаю, откуда ты... Но он забавный, поэтому он мне нравится.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: Funny and flaky? It sounds like you think he's a pretty poor example of a man?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Смешно и расплывчато? Похоже, ты считаешь его довольно плохим примером мужчины?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: You don't hold back, do you... Although I guess he isn't all that reliable...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Ты не сдерживаешься, правда... Хотя, думаю, он не такой уж и надежный...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: At his core, though, Mathias is a serious fellow. He's always thinking about our kingdom first.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Однако по своей сути Матиас серьезный парень. Он всегда в первую очередь думает о нашем королевстве.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: But he's also a little bit of a coward, a trait not easily explained away... I don't know how it happened.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Но он также немного труслив, и эту черту нелегко объяснить... Я не знаю, как это произошло.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: There is that side to him... I wonder if there's any way to remedy it?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Есть в нем такая сторона... Интересно, можно ли как-нибудь это исправить?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: A remedy? Hmm, you know what, I've got an idea. I think I'll need your help with it, though.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Средство? Хм, знаешь что, у меня есть идея. Хотя я думаю, мне понадобится твоя помощь.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: What? Our help? To do what?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: A secret, for now. You can look forward to it, though!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Пока секрет. Но вы можете с нетерпением ждать этого!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: Maybe not. That smile is telling me there's nothing to look forward to for us!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Может быть, нет. Эта улыбка говорит мне, что нам нечего ждать!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..original: Hahaha! We'd better be ready for anything!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_070..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Нам лучше быть готовыми ко всему!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Twins, I'm sorry!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Близнецы, простите!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Ah, hold on! Mireille? What's wrong?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Ах, держись! Мирей? В чем дело?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: I need to apologize about the Royal Trial... That was meant to light a fire under Mathias...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Мне нужно извиниться за Королевский процесс... Это должно было разжечь огонь под Матиасом...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Seeing you two fight, he was meant to realize that someone else may take the throne from him, if he's not careful.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Видя, как вы двое сражаетесь, он должен был понять, что кто-то другой может отобрать у него трон, если он не будет осторожен.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: We pretty much guessed that much. But why are you apologizing?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Мы примерно так и догадались. Но почему ты извиняешься?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: I know you defeated the guardian, but actually the rules state that it has to be fought alone.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Я знаю, что ты победил Стража, но на самом деле правила гласят, что с ним нужно сражаться в одиночку.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: So you haven't actually earned the right to take the throne.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Значит, вы на самом деле не заслужили права занять трон.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: I tricked you, used you, and then gave you false hope! I'm really sorry, girls.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Я обманул тебя, использовал, а затем дал ложную надежду! Мне очень жаль, девочки.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Hahaha, don't worry about it. All that power, those robes, it would be too much for us anyway.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Ха-ха-ха, не волнуйся об этом. Вся эта сила, эти мантии в любом случае были бы для нас слишком велики.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Lydie is right. We can't rule. The one's who were born to become rulers should do it, after all.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Лидия права. Мы не можем править. В конце концов, это должны делать те, кто рожден, чтобы стать правителями.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: So, we're not that bothered about it. In fact, we're not bothered at all!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Так что нас это не особо беспокоит. На самом деле, нас это совершенно не беспокоит!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Twins! At least let me give you this. In thanks for your cooperation.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Двойняшки! По крайней мере, позвольте мне дать вам это. Благодарим за сотрудничество.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Uwah, thank you! I think we can use that!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Ува, спасибо! Я думаю, мы можем это использовать!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Good. You two really are something else, though, aren't you? Defeating that guardian like that!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Хороший. Но вы двое действительно нечто другое, не так ли? Победить этого стража вот так!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: That's right. There's nothing we can't do when we're together!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Это верно. Нет ничего, чего мы не могли бы сделать, когда мы вместе!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Hehe, nothing at all? I almost wish I'd got to see you both take the throne, then!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Хе-хе, вообще ничего? Тогда мне бы почти хотелось увидеть, как вы оба вступите на трон!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Hold on! I don't think that "nothing" includes ruling a nation! Sorry!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Подожди! Я не думаю, что «ничто» включает в себя управление нацией! Извини!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Promise with Mom Number 1! "Don't give up before you even try!" Something like that, right?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Обещание маме номер 1! «Не сдавайся, даже не попробовав!» Что-то в этом роде, да?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: That's what you always say, right? So nothing is impossible for you in this world.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Ты всегда так говоришь, да? Так что для вас в этом мире нет ничего невозможного.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Hehehe, you might be right! Becoming queens would let us live in the lap of luxury!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Хе-хе-хе, возможно, ты прав! Стать королевами позволит нам жить в роскоши!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Hold it, Sue! Don't get distracted. We have to become the greatest alchemists in the kingdom!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Держи, Сью! Не отвлекайтесь. Нам предстоит стать величайшими алхимиками королевства!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: Bah, this all because Mathias won't just bite the bullet and become king! Mathias, you flake!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: Ба, это все потому, что Матиас не стиснет зубы и не станет королем! Матиас, ты придурок!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..speaker: System
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..original: <CLEG>Smaragd<CLNR>, <CLEG>Ruby<CLNR>, <CLEG>Sapphire<CLNR> received.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_080..translation: <CLEG>Смарагд<CLNR>, <CLEG>Рубин<CLNR>, <CLEG>Сапфир<CLNR> получены.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..original: La la la! Work is going so smoothly today!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..translation: Ла-ла-ла! Сегодня работа идет так гладко!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..original: Hahaha, you seem in a good mood, Mireille. Is that because of Mathias?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха, кажется, у тебя хорошее настроение, Мирей. Это из-за Матиаса?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..original: That's right. He's finally made the decision to become the king.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..translation: Это верно. Он наконец принял решение стать королем.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..original: I've been working hard to make sure Mathias becomes a good king, but I'm almost done now.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..translation: Я много работал, чтобы Матиас стал хорошим королем, но сейчас я почти закончил.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..original: He'll be on the throne before you know it!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..translation: Он воссядет на трон прежде, чем вы это заметите!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..original: Yeah. I'm so relieved. I've done my duty as his sister! Thank goodness for that.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..translation: Ага. Я так рад. Я выполнила свой долг как его сестра! Слава богу за это.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..original: Now he's finally getting serious, he'll surely make a fine ruler. Which means I can finally...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_090..translation: Теперь, когда он наконец-то стал серьёзным, из него наверняка получится прекрасный правитель. Это значит, что я наконец смогу...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Tell me, twins. Is a golden puni statue required for living on your own?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Скажите мне, близнецы. Нужна ли золотая статуя Пуни, чтобы жить самостоятельно?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Why would it be?! What are you planning on using it for?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: С чего бы это?! Для чего вы планируете его использовать?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Hahaha, don't ask me. It was a gift so I'm just asking.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха, не спрашивай меня. Это был подарок, поэтому я просто спрашиваю.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Well, if you don't have a use for it you don't need... hold on, living on your own? Who?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Ну, если тебе это бесполезно, то не нужно... погоди, жить самостоятельно? ВОЗ?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Hahaha, who do you think? Me, of course.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха, как ты думаешь, кто? Я, конечно.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: M-Mireille! Living alone? C-Can you really do that?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: М-Мирей! Живете один? К-ты правда можешь это сделать?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Yes! Of course I can! Just who do you think I am?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Да! Конечно, я могу! Как ты думаешь, кто я?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: H-Huh. But why? Why now?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Х-ха. Но почему? Почему сейчас?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: I'm also in line for the throne, remember? But Mathias is the one who will become the king.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Я тоже в очереди на трон, помнишь? Но именно Матиас станет королем.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: It would get tricky if I was hanging around, so after he's crowned I'm leaving the castle.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Было бы сложнее, если бы я околачивался здесь, поэтому после того, как он будет коронован, я покину замок.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: So that's why... Sorry, Mireille, for ever thinking that you couldn't do it!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Так вот почему... Прости, Мирей, что всегда думала, что ты не сможешь этого сделать!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Hah! Just you have a look at this, then! Proof that I can handle living alone!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Ха! Тогда просто взгляните на это! Доказательство того, что я могу жить одна!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: That's a pretty long list... Just what is this?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Это довольно длинный список... Что это?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: That's everything you need to live alone! The bare minimum! You'll find it all correct and proper.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Это все, что нужно для жизни одному! Самый минимум! Вы увидите, что все это правильно и правильно.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: A crystal shield? Cross that off. And a crystal ball, too? What for? Cross that off.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Хрустальный щит? Вычеркните это. И хрустальный шар тоже? Зачем? Вычеркните это.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Twenty pairs of shoes? Cross! Knives, sure, but ten of them? Cross, cross!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Двадцать пар обуви? Крест! Ножи, конечно, но десять штук? Крест, крест!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: H-Hold on! My list is getting mutilated!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Х-Держись! Мой список портится!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: That's odd... You've cut it down to a fraction of what I started with.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Это странно... Вы сократили это до части того, с чего я начал.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: That's right. There was far too much waste on there to start with.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Это верно. Начнем с того, что там было слишком много отходов.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: And lots of things missing, too. You need cutlery, don't you? Dishes?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: И еще много чего не хватает. Тебе нужны столовые приборы, не так ли? Тарелки?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Dishes, right! Hey, I know, could you make some hard to break ones with alchemy?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Посуда, да! Эй, я знаю, можешь ли ты с помощью алхимии сделать что-нибудь, что трудно сломать?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: I think I'll probably break regular ones a bit too quickly.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Думаю, я, наверное, сломаю обычные слишком быстро.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Yes, okay. To celebrate you moving out, we'll bring you a lovely set of dishes!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Да, окей. В честь вашего переезда мы подарим вам прекрасный набор блюд!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: Thank you! Just a little gold leaf will be fine, and for the pattern...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Спасибо! Достаточно немного сусального золота, а для узора...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..original: They are going to be plain sturdy dishes, I'm afraid. Please keep that in mind.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_100..translation: Боюсь, это будет простая прочная посуда. Пожалуйста, имейте это в виду.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: Mireille, here are your hard to break dishes.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: Wow, they're lovely! Living on my own is going to be so much fun, I know it!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Вау, они прекрасны! Жить одной будет очень весело, я это знаю!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: But what's with you two? You seem a bit down?
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Но что с вами двумя? Ты выглядишь немного расстроенным?

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: We're just a bit sad that you're going to be leaving the castle, that's all.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Нам просто немного грустно, что ты собираешься покидать замок, вот и все.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: Hahaha, that's what you've been thinking about? I'm not a permanent fixture, after all!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Ха-ха-ха, ты об этом думал? В конце концов, я не постоянный спутник!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: Once I'm living alone, I also plan to rely heavily on both of you.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Когда я буду жить один, я также планирую во многом полагаться на вас обоих.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: You'll still see me, even if I'm not around here. So there's no need to be sad! Not at all!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Ты все равно меня увидишь, даже если меня здесь не будет. Так что не стоит грустить! Нисколько!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: Hey, that's right! In fact, we might see more of you than we do now!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Эй, это правда! На самом деле, мы могли бы увидеть вас больше, чем сейчас!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: That's right! You'll be sick of my face before long, I promise you!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Это верно! Мое лицо тебе скоро надоест, я тебе обещаю!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: Okay! I can't wait! You're welcome at our atelier any time!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Хорошо! Я не могу дождаться! Ждем вас в нашем ателье в любое время!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..original: Hehe! I need to get back to my preparations, anyway. There isn't long until the coronation.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_110..translation: Хе-хе! В любом случае мне нужно вернуться к приготовлениям. До коронации осталось совсем немного времени.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Right, that's another job done! Next...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Отлично, еще одна работа сделана! Следующий...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Mireille, hello! You're as busy as ever!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Мирей, здравствуйте! Ты занят как никогда!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: That goes without saying! I'm the ruler in the shadows now, which means work work work!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Само собой разумеется! Теперь я правитель в тени, а это значит работа, работа, работа!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Our king needs a lot of support, after all. I'm going to be working the rest of my life!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: В конце концов, нашему королю нужна большая поддержка. Я буду работать всю оставшуюся жизнь!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Hahaha! You seem pretty happy about it, though...
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Хотя ты, похоже, этому очень рад...

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: When he said he needed my help, to be honest, I was overjoyed.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Когда он сказал, что ему нужна моя помощь, я, честно говоря, очень обрадовался.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: And impressed, too. I've never considered that we might rule the kingdom together.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: И тоже впечатлил. Я никогда не думал, что мы сможем править королевством вместе.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Mathias has proved he can think outside the box. He's going to make a great king, you'll see.
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Матиас доказал, что может мыслить нестандартно. Вот увидите, из него выйдет великий король.

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: So I'm going to support him fully from behind! He's my brother, after all!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Так что я поддержу его полностью сзади! В конце концов, он мой брат!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Hehe... With both of you working on this, I'm sure you'll make an amazing kingdom!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Хе-хе... Если вы оба будете работать над этим, я уверен, что вы создадите потрясающее королевство!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: You can count on it! I'll do everything I can as the shadow ruler!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Вы можете на это рассчитывать! Как теневой правитель, я сделаю все, что смогу!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: This will be a country where every child can chase their dreams, just like you two!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Это будет страна, где каждый ребенок сможет осуществить свою мечту, как и вы двое!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Keep up the good work, then, Mireille! Ah, you're so cool, so beautiful!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Продолжай в том же духе, Мирей! Ах, ты такая классная, такая красивая!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: We're right behind you too, Mireille! Ah, you're so talented, so elegant!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Мы тоже за тобой, Мирей! Ах, ты такая талантливая, такая элегантная!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Hey! Quit it! Stop that, twins!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Привет! Бросайте это! Прекратите, близнецы!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Together
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Hahaha!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: System
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Hahaha!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Enough! You can't go around picking on adults!
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..translation: Достаточно! Нельзя придираться к взрослым!

ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc09_mir/event_message_qc09_mir_120..original: Hehehe, sorry about that! We'll see you again soon, Mireille!
