ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_130..original: Yeah, I think that's the best approach. Let's go and see what he says!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_130..translation: Да, я думаю, что это лучший подход. Пойдем посмотрим, что он скажет!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Mr. Fritz! Drossel!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Мистер Фриц! Дроссель!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: What's up? What's the panic?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Как дела? Что за паника?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Don't tell me! Monsters are attacking?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Не говорите мне! Монстры нападают?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Nothing like that! Let's put on a puppet show!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Ничего подобного! Давайте устроим кукольный спектакль!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: What? Where's this coming from?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Что? Откуда это взялось?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: You need to put on a puppet show. To help you get back together with Sister Grace!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Вам нужно поставить кукольный спектакль. Это поможет вам снова быть вместе с Сестрой Грейс!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Look, I appreciate the idea...
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Слушайте, я ценю эту идею...

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: But, like I said, she's living a full and rich life.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Но, как я уже сказал, она живет полноценной и насыщенной жизнью.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: That's right. We don't have the right to damage the happiness she has made for herself.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Верно. Мы не имеем права портить то счастье, которое она себе создала.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: So, I'm sorry, but we can't. Sorry if you thought up any ideas.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Так что извините, но мы не можем. Извините, если у вас возникли какие-либо идеи.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Sister Grace told us that she made you unhappy by leaving.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Сестра Грейс сказала нам, что она расстроила тебя своим уходом.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: What? She said that?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Что? Она так сказала?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: And you two said that Sister Grace leaving you was your own fault, right?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: И вы двое сказали, что Сестра Грейс оставила вас по вашей вине, верно?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Both sides think it was their fault... You actually want to apologize, don't you?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Обе стороны думают, что это их вина... Ты ведь хочешь извиниться, не так ли?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Deep down, you all want to make up and live together again, don't you?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: В глубине души вы все хотите помириться и снова жить вместе, не так ли?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: You don't know how long your family will be around. Eventually, a true parting will come...
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Вы не знаете, как долго ваша семья будет рядом. В конце концов, может наступить настоящее расставание...

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: That's why I think, if you can be together, you should! While you can!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Вот почему я думаю, если вы можете быть вместе, то сделайте это! Пока можете!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Mr. Fritz! Drossel! You've finally, finally met up with Sister Grace again!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Мистер Фриц! Дроссель! Наконец-то вы снова встретились с Сестрой Грейс!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: In which case, don't think about it too much! Just try and make up!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: В этом случае не думайте об этом слишком много! Просто попробуйте помириться!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Lydie... Sue...
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Лиди... Сью...

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Of course... Because of your mother...
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Конечно... Из-за вашей мамы...

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Dad... I don't think we can win this one.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Папа... Я не думаю, что мы сможем победить.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Yeah, this isn't like us. Hahaha! We need to use the greatest puppet show here...
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Да, это не похоже на нас. Ха-ха-ха! Здесь нужно использовать величайший кукольный спектакль...

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: And make up with mom! Thank you, girls. You've given us the wake-up call we needed.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: И помириться с мамой! Спасибо, девочки. Вы дали нам сигнал, который нам был нужен.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Great!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Прекрасно!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Let's prepare, then, without letting Sister Grace notice... We need to surprise her!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Тогда давайте подготовимся, не позволяя Сестре Грейс заметить... Нам нужно ее удивить!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Hahaha, a big surprise! In which case, we need to start work on the script and the puppets!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Ха-ха-ха, большой сюрприз! В таком случае надо начинать работу над сценарием и куклами!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Ah... Girls, could you arrange a venue for us?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Эх... Девочки, а не могли бы вы организовать для нас место?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Leave it to us! I'm sure Pamela can help us sort something out.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Оставьте это нам! Я уверен, что Памела поможет нам во всём разобраться.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Hmm. In which case, let's make this reuniting show a success!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Хм. В таком случае, давайте сделаем это представление воссоединения успешным!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: Together
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: OK!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: ХОРОШО!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..speaker: System
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..original: Sure!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_140..translation: Конечно!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Pamela! There's something we'd like to discuss, if you have a moment?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Памела! Мы хотели бы кое-что обсудить, если у тебя есть минутка?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Yes, what is it? Some mischief? A surprise attack? Hehe, I can't wait!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Так, что тут у нас? Очередная шалость? Нападение из засады? Хе-хе, жду не дождусь!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Hehehe, you're almost right...
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Хе-хе-хе, ты почти права...

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: I see. I'll help however I can, then!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Понятно. Тогда я помогу, чем смогу!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Great! Thank you, Pamela! Now we need to think up an actual plan!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Замечательно! Спасибо, Памела! Теперь нам нужно придумать реальный план!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Right. How about we dress it up like a normal church gathering?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Верно. Как насчет того, чтобы провести это как обычное церковное собрание?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Hey, that's a good idea... We'll tell her that we want to organize one ourselves!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Эй, это хорошая идея... Мы скажем ей, что хотим организовать его сами!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: So we'll pretend it's just a church gathering, and then bring out the surprise puppet show!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Итак, мы притворимся, что это просто церковное собрание, а затем устроим кукольный спектакль-сюрприз!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Great! This will knock her socks off!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Отлично! Это её просто поразит!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Knock who's socks off? Mine? Sue, are you planning something?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Кого поразит? Меня? Сью, ты что-то планируешь?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Kyaaah! S-S-Sister Grace! I'm not planning anything!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Ой! С-С-Сестра Грейс! Я ничего не планирую!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Girls, it's do or die! Just follow my lead here.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Девочки, это вопрос жизни и смерти! Просто следуйте моему примеру.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: It can't be helped, if you've overheard us. The twins want to hold a church gathering.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Что ж поделать, раз уж ты нас подслушала. Близняшки хотят провести церковное собрание

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Ah, that's right! You always work so hard on them...
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Ах, это правда! Ты всегда так усердно работаешь над ними...

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: So we wanted to give you a break and let you enjoy yourself once in a while.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Вот мы и хотели, чтобы ты немного отдохнула и хоть изредка могла развлечься в своё удовольствие

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Is that so? Well, there's no need to keep that a secret!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Неужели? Что ж, нет необходимости держать это в секрете!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Very well. I accept your proposal to hold your own gathering.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Очень хорошо. Я принимаю ваше предложение провести собственное собрание.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Great! Thank you, Sister Grace!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Отлично! Спасибо, Сестра Грейс!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Not at all. I'm looking forward to it already.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Не за что. Я уже с нетерпением жду этого.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Good, good. Now we've secured the venue.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Хорошо, хорошо. Теперь мы обеспечили себе место проведения.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Nice. Now we just have to wait for Mr. Fritz to be ready.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Отлично. Теперь нам остается только ждать, пока мистер Фриц не будет готов.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: One thing, twins... Have you decided what it is you want to do?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Еще одно, близняшки... Вы уже решили, что будете делать?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Do? You mean, at the gathering?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Делать? В смысле, на собрании?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Ready for this? They're going to do a comedy routine!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Готова? Они собираются показать комедийный номер!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Oh, that sounds hilarious! I can't wait to see it.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: О, звучит забавно! Не могу дождаться, чтобы увидеть это.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Y-Yeah, that's right. "Young lady, is this the Soleil Street?"
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Д-да, это правда. «Юная леди, это Улица Солей?»

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: "On my soul it is!" Hahaha!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: «Век соли не видать, она самая!» Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Hahaha! That's funny! I can't wait to see more!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Забавно! Не могу дождаться, чтобы увидеть больше!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Phew, it worked somehow... Thank you so much, Pamela.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Уф, это как-то сработало... Огромное спасибо, Памела.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Hehe, no problem. One thing, though...
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Хе-хе, без проблем. Однако ещё кое-что...

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: You're going to need to work on your joke material.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: Вам нужно будет поработать над шутками.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..original: Uwah, no need to rub it in... I'm really embarrassed already!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_150..translation: О-о-ох, не сыпь соль на рану... Мне и так уже жутко неловко!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Hello, girls!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Здравствуйте, девочки!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Hahaha! We've made the ultimate puppets, and the ultimate script!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Мы создали идеальных кукол и лучший сценарий!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Really? Great! We've got the venue ready.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Правда? Отлично! Мы подготовили площадку.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: It might be a bit sudden, then, but let's do the show tomorrow! The sooner the better!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Тогда это может быть немного неожиданно, но давайте устроим спектакль завтра! Чем скорее, тем лучше!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Well said. Tomorrow it is!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Хорошо сказано. Это будет завтра!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: You should be looking forward to it as well, girls. Part of it is based on you!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Девочки, вам тоже стоит этого ждать с нетерпением. Отчасти это зависит от вас!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Hehe. See you later!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Хе-хе. Увидимся позже!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Right. We have to let Sister Grace know!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Верно. Мы должны сообщить Сестре Грейс!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Yeah!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Ага!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Right, Sue. Are you ready?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Верно, Сью. Ты готова?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Perfect! Off we go!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Идеально! Пошли!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Ah, hello girls. I've been waiting for you.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Ой, здравствуйте, девочки. Я ждала вас.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Ah, Sister Grace. Sorry for all the rush.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Ах, Сестра Грейс. Извини за спешку.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Oh, I don't mind at all. This is your gathering, after all.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: О, я совсем не против. В конце концов, это ваше собрание.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Hehehe! Good luck with your comedy routine!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Хе-хе-хе! Удачи вам в ваших комедийных номерах!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Thanks! Ah, it looks like it's time to start. We'll see you later!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Спасибо! Ох, похоже, пора начинать. Увидимся позже!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Gentlemen and girls! Boys and ladies! Welcome, everyone!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Господа и девочки! Мальчики и дамы! Добро пожаловать!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Calm down... ahem! We're here to thrill you with our comedy, but first!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Соберись... хм! Мы здесь, чтобы порадовать вас нашей комедией, но сначала!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: We've called in two special guests! Here we go!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Мы пригласили двух специальных гостей! Вот они!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: It is an honor to have been invited here today. We are Fritz and Drossel, puppeteers!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Для меня большая честь быть приглашенным сюда сегодня. Мы Фриц и Дроссель, кукловоды!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: What's this!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Что это!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: We've been called in by our hosts to put on a show for you today!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Ведущие пригласили нас устроить сегодня для вас спектакль!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: For the most important person in our lives!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Для самого важного человека в нашей жизни!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Without further ado, then, let's get started! Take it away!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Итак, без лишних слов, приступим! Начинаем!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Listen now, to our story of the friendship between four alchemists.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Послушайте нашу историю о дружбе четырех алхимиков.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: One is a kind girl who met a living book. Another, a lively girl who dreamed of the outside world.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Одна — добрая девочка, встретившая живую книгу. Другая, бойкая девочка, мечтавшая о внешнем мире.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: And then, two twins, living together as they keep their promises to their departed mother.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: А затем две близняшки, живущие вместе и выполняющие свои обещания, данные ушедшей матери.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: The footsteps of home, in which they tread. The endless dream, for which they aim!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Путь к родному дому, по которому они идут. Бесконечная мечта, к которой они стремятся!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Do not blink, for fear of what you'll miss! This is our ultimate tale. Its name-
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Не моргайте, иначе вы пропустите! Это наша главная история. Ее название...

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: "The Mysterious, Mysterious Story"!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: «Таинственная-претаинственная история»!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Ah! I'm exhausted! We had to do our comedy routine in the end, too!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Ах! Я измождена! В конце концов, нам тоже пришлось сыграть нашу комедийную программу!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: That was unexpected, but the audience loved it, so that's what really matters.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Это было неожиданно, но зрителям это понравилось, и это действительно важно.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: It was good, I'll admit, but you did make one mistake!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Признаю, получилось неплохо, но ты допустил одну ошибку!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: What! I didn't think anyone would notice. I can't believe you saw that!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Что! Я не думал, что кто-то заметит. Я не могу поверить, что ты это видела!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: I saw it too, actually, although I just covered for it.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Я тоже это видела, хотя просто прикрыла это.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Haha, you're still not quite there yet. Your adlibbing was so obvious!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Ха-ха, ты тоже ещё не достигла вершины. Твоя импровизация была слишком очевидной!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Gah! As strict as ever, Mom...
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Ох, ты строга как всегда, мам...

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Only because my love of puppet theater is as strong as your own!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Только потому, что моя любовь к кукольному театру такая же сильна, как и ваша!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Hehe. Come on, Sue.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Хе-хе. Давай, Сью.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: Yeah. We need to go and practice our routine!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Ага. Нам нужно пойти и попрактиковать наше выступление!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..original: It's too late for that now! Hahaha!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_160..translation: Теперь уже слишком поздно для этого! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..original: Come on, Mom! Where shall we go next?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..translation: Ну же, мам! Куда пойдём дальше?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..original: Hmm, let me think... There's a delicious cake place nearby!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..translation: Хм, дайте-ка подумать... Неподалёку есть место, где подают вкусные торты!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..original: Cake? I'm getting a bit too old for sweet things.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..translation: Торты? Я уже, пожалуй, староват для сладкого.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..original: Ah, don't worry! I'll eat your piece, Dad!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..translation: А, да ты не переживай, пап! Я съем твой кусок, пап!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..original: Hold on, what about me? You can just pay, darling!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..translation: Погодите-ка, а как же я? Дорогой, ты можешь просто за всё заплатить!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..original: W-What! You leave me no choice but to eat it, then!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..translation: Ч-что?! Ну уж нет, тогда мне ничего не остаётся, кроме как съесть его самому!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..original: Hahaha! Grin and bear it, Dad! Come on, to the cake shop!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Терпи, папуля, обратного пути нет! Вперёд, навстречу тортикам!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..original: Hey! Don't go running off on your own! You'll just get lost. Hey!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..translation: Эй! Не смей убегать одна! Ты же снова заблудишься! Эй, постой!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..original: Oh dear. She still can't tell where she is going, can she? Don't leave me behind, please!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..translation: Ох, боже мой. Она до сих пор совершенно не ориентируется на местности, верно? Подождите меня, пожалуйста, не бросайте!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..original: Hahaha! It looks like the three of them have completely made up.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..original: Yeah! They look so happy, I'm glad.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_170..translation: Ага! Они выглядят такими счастливыми, я рада.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: Sister Grace, hello! Sorry, but we saw you!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Сестра Грейс, здравствуй! Извини, но мы тебя видели!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: You were out with your family, and looked really happy!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Ты была с семьей и выглядела очень счастливой!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: Girls, you should have said something!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Девочки, вам следовало что-нибудь сказать!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: Hehe, I don't think I've ever seen you look so happy.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Хе-хе, мне кажется, я никогда не видела тебя такой счастливой.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: It was more fun to just watch, than to speak up and ruin the moment.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Было гораздо приятнее просто наблюдать, чем вмешиваться и портить момент.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: Hehe. I think you need some punishment for your sneakiness. A spanking, perhaps?
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Хе-хе. Думаю, тебя нужно наказать за твою хитрость. Может быть, порка?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: What?! No, I was just joking. We just didn't want to disturb you! I'm too old for a spanking!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Что?! Нет, я просто пошутила. Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить! Я уже взрослая для порки!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: Hehe, I'll forgive you just this once. I got back something very special to me, thanks to you.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Хе-хе, я прощу вас на этот раз. Благодаря вам я получила обратно нечто очень ценное для меня.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: After that, we talked a lot. About the past, and about the future...
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: После этого мы много разговаривали. О прошлом и о будущем...

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: I haven't spent time like that in more than a decade. It was so satisfying!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Я не проводила время так уже больше десяти лет. Это было так приятно!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: Lydie, and Sue... Thank you so much for bringing us back together!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Лиди и Сью... Огромное спасибо, что снова собрали нас вместе!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: I'm so happy for you, Sister Grace.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Я так рада за тебя, Сестра Грейс.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: Thank you! Me too!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Спасибо! Я тоже!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: I'm sad, too, though... Now we won't be able to call you "Sister" any more!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Хотя мне грустно... Теперь мы больше не сможем называть тебя «Сестра»!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: Right, of course... You'll be living as Grace the puppeteer now, won't you...
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Да, конечно… Значит, отныне ты будешь жить как Грейс, мастер кукол?

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: No? I'm going to carry on living here as a nun.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Нет. Я собираюсь продолжать жить здесь как монахиня.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: I've been doing this for a long time, after all. I can't go back to that life now.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: В конце концов, я занимаюсь этим уже давно. Я не могу сейчас вернуться к той жизни.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: Uwah! So you'll still be Sister Grace! But I wanted to see your puppet show again!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Ух! Значит, ты все равно останешься Сестрой Грейс! Но мне хотелось еще раз посмотреть твой кукольный спектакль!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: Don't worry about that. I'll put one on during the next church gathering.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Не беспокойтесь об этом. Я сделаю ещё спектакль на следующем церковном собрании.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: Great! Haha! What will it be this time? Romance? Tragedy? I can't wait!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Прекрасно! Ха-ха! Что будет на этот раз? Романтика? Трагедия? Я не могу дождаться!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: I'm sorry, Head Sister! Ines has upset someone who came for confession!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Мне очень жаль, старшая сестра! Инес расстроила пришедшего на исповедь!

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: I-I'm sorry. I said a bit too much.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Мне жаль. Я сказала лишнего.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: What are you doing, dear? Honestly. I'm coming, I'm coming.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Что ты сделала, дорогая? Честное слово. Я иду, иду.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: You heard them, girls. My mediation skills are needed. I will see you later.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Вы их слышали, девочки. Нужны мои посреднические навыки. Увидимся позже.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: May the blessings of god be with you.
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Да пребудет с вами благословение Божие.

ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..original: Hehe, and with you too, Sister Grace. And with you too!
ebm:qc10_gra/event_message_qc10_gra_180..translation: Хе-хе, и с тобой тоже, Сестра Грейс. И с тобой тоже!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: An untarnished brilliance~!<CR>Deep in my soul~!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Незапятнанный блеск~!<CR>Глубоко в моей душе~!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Hello, Hagel! Hahaha, singing again today?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Привет, Хагель! Ха-ха-ха, сегодня снова поешь?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Hey, girls. Haha, I'm always singing!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Привет, девочки. Хаха, я всегда пою!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Singing with feeling makes work go more smoothly. More than that...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Пение с чувством делает работу более гладкой. Более того...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: It would be a waste to not let my customers hear my lovely voice!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Было бы расточительством не позволить моим клиентам услышать мой прекрасный голос!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Hah, "waste" isn't the word I'd use!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Ха, «отходы» — это не то слово, которое я бы использовал!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Bah! You have no clue about art, Sue! No clue at all!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Ба! Ты понятия не имеешь об искусстве, Сью! Никакой подсказки!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Enough about this, anyway. What can I do for you today?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: В любом случае, хватит об этом. Что я могу сделать для тебя сегодня?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Ah, well. We have a knife with a nick on it...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Ах, ну. У нас есть нож с зазубриной на нем...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: We found some uni but they are super tough. I took a mighty swing and it was the knife that lost...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Мы нашли несколько университетов, но они очень крутые. Я сильно замахнулся, и нож потерялся...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Of course it did! A cooking knife isn't a weapon! Gah, like this is the first time...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Конечно, так оно и было! Кухонный нож – не оружие! Ох, как будто это впервые...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Hahaha... You've repaired not only our knives but also our pots and even our cauldron many times!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Ты много раз ремонтировал не только наши ножи, но и кастрюли, и даже казан!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Good point. Thinking about it, almost all the metal stuff in our house was made by you, Hagel.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Хорошая мысль. Если подумать, почти все металлические вещи в нашем доме были сделаны тобой, Хагель.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Hahaha, you bet it is! Breaking things is what you do best, girls!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха, можешь поспорить, что это так! Ломать вещи — это то, что у вас получается лучше всего, девочки!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Leave it to me, anyway. I'll have that knife as good as new, before you know it!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: В любом случае оставь это мне. Этот нож будет у меня как новенький, и ты даже не заметишь этого!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Great! Thanks so much, Hagel!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Большой! Большое спасибо, Хагель!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: No problem! Now, in exchange for this, maybe...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Без проблем! Теперь, в обмен на это, может быть...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Could I add a function to your cauldron? Press a button and the flame color changes...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Могу ли я добавить функцию в ваш котел? Нажимаешь кнопку и цвет пламени меняется...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: That sounds completely pointless. No thanks. Please just repair the knife.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Это звучит совершенно бессмысленно. Нет, спасибо. Пожалуйста, просто отремонтируйте нож.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..original: Gah, you guys are no fun... Alright, I'll take care of the knife, as boring as that is.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_010..translation: Га, ребята, вы невеселые... Ладно, я позабочусь о ноже, как бы скучно это ни было.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: Hey, girls. There's a little something I want to ask of you.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Привет, девочки. Я хочу кое-что у тебя спросить.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: That's right! I need you to fetch me some real quality ground metal!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Это верно! Мне нужно, чтобы ты принес мне немного настоящего качественного шлифованного металла!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: Ground metal? That's it? Any particular reason why you are asking this of us?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Земляной металл? Вот и все? Есть ли какая-то конкретная причина, почему вы спрашиваете об этом у нас?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: I'm recalling something about a pot with two bottoms and a endlessly spinning doorknob... We really don't need that.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Что-то вспоминается про горшок с двумя донышками и бесконечно крутящуюся дверную ручку... Нам это совсем не нужно.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: Those are just silly ideas I came up with when drinking with Roger.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Это просто глупые идеи, которые пришли мне в голову, когда я пил с Роджером.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: This time I'm making something much more serious, don't worry!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: На этот раз я делаю что-то гораздо более серьезное, не волнуйтесь!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: Alright... Then you won't mind telling us what it is you're making?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Хорошо... Тогда ты не против рассказать нам, что ты делаешь?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Нет, этого я не могу сделать.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: You aren't serious at all! You're planning on making something totally weird again!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Вы вообще несерьёзны! Вы снова планируете сделать что-то совершенно странное!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: No, I'm not. I'll pay you, so please just do the job!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Нет, я не такой. Я заплачу тебе, поэтому, пожалуйста, просто выполняй работу!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..original: Alright, okay. I'm not really trusting this, but work is work.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_020..translation: Хорошо, хорошо. Я не особо в это верю, но работа есть работа.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Ah, that's just what I needed! Some fine, fine ground metal. Great work, girls!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Ах, это как раз то, что мне было нужно! Немного тонкого, тонко отшлифованного металла. Отличная работа, девочки!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: I can make something really great with this. I can't wait to get started!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: С этим я могу сделать что-то действительно великолепное. Не могу дождаться, чтобы начать!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: In that case, I think we'll stay and watch. I'm still worried about what you're going to make...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: В таком случае, я думаю, мы останемся и посмотрим. Я все еще беспокоюсь о том, что ты собираешься сделать...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Yeah, good point. We'd better keep an eye on him.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Да, хороший момент. Нам лучше присмотреть за ним.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: I don't mind an audience, but being stared at that hard makes me really uncomfortable.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Я не против публики, но когда на меня пристально смотрят, мне становится очень некомфортно.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Good, it's done!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Отлично, дело сделано!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: ...what is that.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: ...что это такое.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: ...statue of a man with a shiny head?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: ...статуя человека с блестящей головой?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: YOU! Who are you calling bald?!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: ТЫ! Кого ты называешь лысым?!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Uwah! No one said bald!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Ува! Никто не сказал лысый!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: You just said it, you little...!!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Ты только что сказал это, маленький...!!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Uwaaah! That's not fair!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Увааа! Это не справедливо!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Hold on, Hagel... Is this you?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Подожди, Хагель... Ты ли это?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Yes, that's right! Well done, Sue. Nice that you at least understand art!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Да, это так! Молодец, Сью. Приятно, что вы хотя бы разбираетесь в искусстве!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Didn't you say she had no clue when we were here before?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Разве ты не говорил, что она понятия не имела, когда мы были здесь раньше?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Let me level with you. As part of promoting my store I've been placing statues of myself around.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Позвольте мне поравняться с вами. В рамках продвижения своего магазина я размещаю вокруг себя статуи.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: They've become a bit too popular, though. Statues of the God of the Forge, they call them.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Однако они стали слишком популярными. Они называют их статуями Бога Кузницы.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Huh... Because it looks a bit divine?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: А... Потому что это выглядит немного божественно?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Who's head looks pristinely divine?! Huh?!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Чья голова выглядит первозданно божественно?! Хм?!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Uwah! I can't say anything, can I?!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Ува! Я ничего не могу сказать, да?!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: I don't mind a bit of fame, but it has its downsides too. You can't be too careful.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Я не против славы, но у нее есть и свои недостатки. Нельзя быть слишком осторожным.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: So I decided to try a smaller size. That is what you see before you now, girls!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Поэтому я решил попробовать размер поменьше. Вот что вы видите сейчас перед собой, девочки!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Okay. This sounds about as totally ridiculous as I was expecting, but very well. What is this for?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Хорошо. Это звучит так же нелепо, как я и ожидал, но очень хорошо. Для чего это нужно?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Decoration, of course! The bedroom. The living room. It will brighten any space where you place it!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Конечно, украшение! Спальня. Гостиная. Он украсит любое пространство, где вы его разместите!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Brighten? More like intimidate...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Просветлеть? Больше похоже на запугивание...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Hahaha, that's fine too! That just makes it more worthy of being displayed!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Ха-ха-ха, это тоже хорошо! Это только делает его более достойным показа!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Right. As a reward, this one is for you.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Верно. В награду это для вас.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: What? W-We don't need that...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Что? М-нам это не нужно...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Huuuh?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Хуууу?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: W-Wow! What a lovely gift, thank you so much!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Вау! Какой чудесный подарок! Большое спасибо!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: W-What should we do with this? A paperweight? A doorstop, maybe?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Ч-что нам с этим делать? Пресс-папье? Дверной упор, может быть?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: Toss it in the cauldron and see what happens... That sounds like the best idea.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: Бросьте это в котел и посмотрите, что произойдет... Кажется, это лучшая идея.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..speaker: System
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..original: <CLEG>Small Statue of Hagel<CLNR> was forced upon you...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_030..translation: <CLEG>Маленькая статуя Хагеля<CLNR> была навязана вам...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: Hey, Pamela. It's rare to see you here.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Привет, Памела. Тебя здесь редко можно увидеть.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: I guess it is! Sorry, but the doorknob to my room broke...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Я думаю, это так! Извините, но дверная ручка в моей комнате сломалась...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: I don't have to get it fixed, of course, but it is a bit of a bother.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Конечно, мне не нужно это исправлять, но это немного хлопотно.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: Grace told me you're good at your job, so I came to see if you can help me!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Грейс сказала мне, что ты хорошо справляешься со своей работой, поэтому я пришел узнать, сможешь ли ты мне помочь!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: I see, I see. That sounds like something I can handle... hold on!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Я вижу, я вижу. Похоже, я с этим справлюсь... держись!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: I was thinking the same thing! I just can't remember where it was?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Я думал о том же! Я просто не могу вспомнить, где это было?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: Me either. The south? The west? Or could it be...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Я тоже. Юг? Запад? Или может быть...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: Hmm, this is so annoying! Like an itch I can't scratch!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Хм, это так раздражает! Как зуд, который я не могу почесать!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: It can't be helped if we both don't remember. Pamela, was it?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Ничего не поделаешь, если мы оба не помним. Памела, не так ли?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: How about sharing a meal some time? I think we'd get along pretty well!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Как насчет того, чтобы вместе пообедать? Я думаю, мы бы неплохо поладили!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: Oh my, that sounds lovely! I'll definitely take you up on that offer!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: О боже, это звучит прекрасно! Я обязательно воспользуюсь этим предложением!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: That settles it! Ah, now about this troublesome doorknob...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Это решает вопрос! Ах, теперь об этой неприятной дверной ручке...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: W-Wow, the two of them are getting along like a house on fire!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Н-ух ты, они вдвоем ладят, как в горящем доме!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..original: Hahaha! Like two weird little peas in a pod!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_040..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Как две странные горошины в стручке!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: Hey, girls. I've got another request for you!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Привет, девочки. У меня к вам еще одна просьба!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: Yes? What is it this time?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: Well, I want some thread. As delicate as you can find, smooth, and in bulk! Lots and lots of it!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Ну, я хочу какую-нибудь нить. Настолько нежный, насколько это возможно, гладкий и объемный! Много-много всего этого!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: Lots of thread? What are you planning this time?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Много ниток? Что ты планируешь на этот раз?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: I can't tell you! Torture me with my own forge implements, I won't tell!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Я не могу вам сказать! Мучайте меня моими же кузнечными орудиями, я не скажу!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: It's something strange again, isn't it? The Hagel Toothbrush? The Hagel Towel?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Опять что-то странное, не так ли? Зубная щетка Хагель? Полотенце Хагеля?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: Nothing like that! This time I'm aiming for something more...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Ничего подобного! На этот раз я стремлюсь к чему-то большему...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: Hah! I'm not falling for that, either! This one is top secret!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Ха! Я тоже на это не поведусь! Это совершенно секретно!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: You'll need to try harder than that to trick me! Now go and get to work, girls!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Тебе придется постараться больше, чтобы обмануть меня! А теперь идите и приступайте к работе, девочки!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..original: Uwah, fine, fine. It's just going to be more worthless junk this time, though, isn't it?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_050..translation: Ува, ладно, ладно. Но на этот раз это будет еще более бесполезный хлам, не так ли?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Hagel. We've got the thread that you wanted...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Хагель. У нас есть тема, которую вы хотели...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Uwah! I literally only said your name!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Ува! Я буквально сказал только твое имя!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Ah! Sorry, little lady. I'm getting pretty nervous, for lots of reasons.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Ах! Извините, маленькая леди. Я очень нервничаю по множеству причин.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Huh? Anyway, please accept this delivery.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Хм? В любом случае, пожалуйста, примите эту поставку.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Hey, this is good! Smooth as a maiden's hair, with great color and luster too!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Эй, это хорошо! Гладкие, как девичьи волосы, с великолепным цветом и блеском!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Hahaha! If this works, it'll be long and flowing again...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Если это сработает, оно снова будет долгим и текущим...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Ah, nothing, nothing! Here you go, girls. Your reward.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Ах, ничего, ничего! Вот, девочки. Ваша награда.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: What? This much? All we did was bring you some thread!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Что? Это много? Все, что мы сделали, это принесли вам немного ниток!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: It's fine, don't worry about it! However...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Все в порядке, не беспокойтесь об этом! Однако...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Don't tell anyone else about this. Understand?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Не говори об этом никому больше. Понимать?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Good. Everything is going according to plan!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Hey, Sue... You guessed what Hagel is planning on making, right?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Привет, Сью... Ты догадалась, что планирует сделать Хагель, верно?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Yeah. I've got a pretty good idea.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Ага. У меня есть неплохая идея.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: But why now? I don't know how I'll react if he comes out wearing, well, you know...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Но почему сейчас? Не знаю, как я отреагирую, если он выйдет одетым, ну, вы знаете...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..original: Hahaha! Let's just leave him to it, shall we?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_060..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Давай просто предоставим ему это, ладно?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: Yes, all ready. What about you?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: Good! Now we can proceed to the final stage!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..translation: Хороший! Теперь можно переходить к заключительному этапу!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: Excellent. I'm so looking forward to this!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: Me too. Let's make a real splash!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..translation: Я тоже. Давайте устроим настоящий фурор!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: You said it! Like fireworks and gunpowder!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..translation: Ты сказал это! Как фейерверк и порох!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: What can we do, Sue? I think we just saw something pretty crazy!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..translation: Что мы можем сделать, Сью? Я думаю, мы только что увидели что-то довольно сумасшедшее!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: Hagel and Pamela! The two of them together are more dangerous than a cauldron about to explode!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..translation: Хагель и Памела! Они вдвоем опаснее котла, который вот-вот взорвется!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: Lydie... Promise with Mom Number 7: "Sometimes pretend you didn't see anything".
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..translation: Лидия... Обещание маме номер 7: «Иногда делай вид, что ничего не видишь».

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..original: Well said. We didn't see a thing. We don't know a thing. Nope! Nothing!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_070..translation: Хорошо сказано. Мы ничего не видели. Мы ничего не знаем. Неа! Ничего!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Come on, you rabble! Make some noise!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Давай, сброд! Пошумите!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Onlookers
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Raaaah!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Раааа!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Hehehe! You over there, come and watch too!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Хе-хе-хе! Ты там, приходи и тоже смотри!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: What's this? Isn't that...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Что это? Разве это не...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: H-Hagel and Pamela? What are they doing now?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Х-Хагель и Памела? Что они делают сейчас?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Come on! Are you having a good time?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Ну давай же! Вы хорошо проводите время?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Onlookers
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Yeah!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Ага!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: If you aren't, I'll have to punish you!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Если нет, мне придется тебя наказать!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Spectator
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: I want to be punished!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Я хочу быть наказанным!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: What is this? Someone, please, I need an explanation!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Что это? Кто-нибудь, пожалуйста, мне нужны объяснения!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Here comes our first song!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Вот и наша первая песня!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: We're going to sing with all our hearts! Listen with all of yours! This song is called...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Мы будем петь от всей души! Слушайте всеми своими! Эта песня называется...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Together
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: "Ah, Burning Sister of Love!"
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: «Ах, Пылающая сестра любви!»

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: System
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: "Ah, Burning Sister of Love!"
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: «Ах, Пылающая сестра любви!»

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Nearby Resident
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: That was incredible! I'm so pumped!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Это было невероятно! Я так взволнован!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: unknown(name_id=36)
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Yeah! When the big guy dived into the crowd, though, I thought I was going to get squashed!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Ага! Однако когда здоровяк нырнул в толпу, я подумал, что меня раздавит!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Old Man
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Hohoho! I was hoping that young lady would take a stage dive!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Хо-хо-хо! Я надеялся, что эта молодая леди прыгнет со сцены!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: So this is what they were planning...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Так вот что они планировали...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Yeah. A totally bizarre concert, right in front of the castle.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Ага. Совершенно странный концерт прямо перед замком.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Even crazier than I imagined!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Даже безумнее, чем я себе представлял!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..original: Those two really are something. But what that something is, I'm not quite sure...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_080..translation: Эти двое действительно нечто. Но что это такое, я не совсем уверен...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: There comes a time, for a man and a woman~!<CR>When they simply cannot back down~!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Наступает время для мужчины и женщины~!<CR>Когда они просто не могут отступить~!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Hahaha, Hagel is in a good mood.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха, Хагель в хорошем настроении.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Because of that concert?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Из-за того концерта?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Hey! You saw that, did you?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Привет! Ты это видел, да?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Yeah. It was all very unexpected, though. I wasn't sure what I was even seeing.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Ага. Хотя все это было очень неожиданно. Я даже не был уверен, что именно вижу.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Hahaha, glad to hear it! That was one hot performance!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха, рад это слышать! Это было жаркое выступление!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: I made all sorts of plans with Pamela, and I'm glad they all worked out!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: У меня с Памелой были самые разные планы, и я рад, что они все сработали!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: I'm just glad you didn't get arrested. Doing that right in front of the castle!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Я просто рад, что тебя не арестовали. Делаю это прямо перед замком!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Hahaha! I bet the king is a fan, too!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Могу поспорить, что король тоже фанат!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: What do you think, girls? How about joining us up on the stage next time...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Что вы думаете, девочки? Как насчет того, чтобы присоединиться к нам на сцене в следующий раз...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Together
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: No thanks.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Нет, спасибо.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: System
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: No thanks.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Нет, спасибо.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Gah, you're no fun...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Гах, ты не веселый...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: To tell you the truth, I did learn one thing from that performance.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Честно говоря, из этого выступления я узнал одну вещь.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Yes? What is it, Hagel? You look so serious, all of a sudden!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Да? Что такое, Хагель? Ты вдруг стал таким серьезным!
