ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Listen to this. At the end of the concert, I dived into the crowd.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Послушайте это. В конце концерта я нырнул в толпу.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Unfortunately, by doing so, I totally busted my back!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: К сожалению, сделав это, я полностью сломал себе спину!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Hah! Sounds like you got what you deserved...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Ха! Похоже, ты получил то, что заслужил...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: It was all sorts of fun, so I don't mind, but it wasn't all nice...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Это было очень весело, так что я не против, но не все было хорошо...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: I'm not a young man any more. I can't push myself so hard!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Я уже не молодой человек. Я не могу себя так сильно заставить!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: I think that kind of foolishness should be avoided, regardless of your age!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Я считаю, что подобных глупостей следует избегать, независимо от вашего возраста!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: So I have an idea! Before my body gives out, I want to forge the ultimate weapon!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Итак, у меня есть идея! Прежде чем мое тело выйдет из строя, я хочу выковать совершенное оружие!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Huh...
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Хм...

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: That's not much of a reaction! You know what I'm going to say next, right?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Это не такая уж реакция! Знаешь, что я скажу дальше, да?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: What? We can leave?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Что? Мы можем уйти?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: You're joking! I want you to get me the materials using your alchemy!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Ты шутишь! Я хочу, чтобы ты добыл мне материалы, используя свою алхимию!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: I guessed as much... What kind of materials do you want, then?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Я так и предполагал... Какие же материалы вам нужны?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Right. It's a metal, and it's called Harnonian. Nope, Harmonican? Harminimum?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Верно. Это металл, и он называется гарнониан. Нет, Гармоника? Гарминимум?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Anyway, it's really hard to make, even using alchemy. But I bet you two can do it!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: В любом случае, его действительно сложно сделать, даже используя алхимию. Но я уверен, что вы двое сможете это сделать!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Alright. If this is to make a weapon, I guess we can help you.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Хорошо. Если речь идет о создании оружия, думаю, мы сможем вам помочь.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..original: Well said, girls! The most beautiful sisters in the city! I'm counting on you!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_090..translation: Хорошо сказано, девочки! Самые красивые сестры города! Я рассчитываю на тебя!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Ah! Yes! This is Hagelnium!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Ах! Да! Это Хагельниум!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: You mean Harmonium.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Вы имеете в виду Гармониум.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: That's right, that's the stuff. Now I can make the ultimate weapon!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Правильно, в этом вся суть. Теперь я могу создать совершенное оружие!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Right, let's get started at once! I need your help too, girls!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Хорошо, давайте начнем сразу! Девочки, мне тоже нужна ваша помощь!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Lend me all of your knowledge as alchemists!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Одолжите мне все свои знания алхимика!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Hahaha! We can't turn you down, Hagel!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Мы не можем отказать тебе, Хагель!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: That's right! Let's combine our strengths and create the ultimate weapon!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Это верно! Давайте объединим наши силы и создадим совершенное оружие!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Everyone
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: We did it!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Мы сделали это!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: System
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: We did it!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Мы сделали это!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: System
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: We did it!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Мы сделали это!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: This is our weapon! A weapon among weapons, the ultimate weapon!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Это наше оружие! Оружие среди оружия, лучшее оружие!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: I don't know much about weapons, but I can tell these are amazing!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Я не особо разбираюсь в оружии, но могу сказать, что оно потрясающее!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Me too! We've made something really incredible, haven't we?
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Я тоже! Мы сделали что-то действительно невероятное, не так ли?

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Of course! Made by the greatest blacksmith and the two future greatest alchemists!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Конечно! Сделано величайшим кузнецом и двумя будущими величайшими алхимиками!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: It's so amazing, the word "amazing" can't do it justice!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Это настолько потрясающе, что слово «потрясающе» не передаст этого!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Hagel! You're right!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Хагель! Ты прав!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: You two girls, too, have really grown up. All your advice back there really helped me out.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Вы, девочки, тоже по-настоящему выросли. Все ваши советы мне очень помогли.

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Totally different from when you were blowing up your cauldron all the time! Gah, now my eyes are sweating!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Совершенно не похоже на то, когда вы все время взрывали свой котел! Гах, теперь у меня глаза потеют!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Hey, Hagel! No need to cry! Please, you're going to make us choke up!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Привет, Хагель! Не надо плакать! Пожалуйста, ты заставишь нас подавиться!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Hey, one thing! Please, keep coming! Keep coming to my shop!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Эй, одно дело! Пожалуйста, продолжайте приходить! Продолжайте заходить в мой магазин!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Hagel
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: No matter how impressive you get, I'll make anything you might need! I promise!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Каким бы впечатляющим вы ни были, я сделаю все, что вам может понадобиться! Я обещаю!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: Sure! We understand! We'll come! Well keep coming for sure!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Конечно! Мы понимаем! Мы приедем! Ну обязательно приезжайте!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: So please, Hagel! Just stop crying!
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: Пожалуйста, Хагель! Просто перестань плакать!

ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..speaker: System
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..original: <CLEG>Bloom Spiral<CLNR> and <CLEG>Star Suelle<CLNR> received.
ebm:qc11_hag/event_message_qc11_hag_100..translation: <CLEG>Спираль Блум<CLNR> и <CLEG>Звездная Сюэль<CLNR> получены.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Spin it, and spin it... Like this, Plachta?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Крутите, крутите... Вот так, Плахта?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Yes, that looks good. Next...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Да, это выглядит хорошо. Следующий...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: What's this? Firis is learning alchemy from Plachta?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Что это? Фирис учится алхимии у Плахты?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Wow, yeah! But isn't Firis Sophie's student?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Вау, да! Но разве Фирис не ученица Софи?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Hey, you two. That's right, I'm Miss Sophie's student.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Эй, вы двое. Верно, я ученица мисс Софи.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: But since that also makes her the student of my student, I sometimes also teach Firis myself.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Но поскольку это также делает ее ученицей моей ученицы, я иногда сам преподаю Фирис.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Plachta can teach really well. It goes without saying that she's a great alchemist, too.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Плахта может очень хорошо преподавать. Само собой разумеется, она еще и великий алхимик.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Wow! She does look like she'd be good at taking care of people.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Ух ты! Похоже, она умеет заботиться о людях.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Hehe, thank you. But please don't tell Sophie about this.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Хе-хе, спасибо. Но, пожалуйста, не говори об этом Софи.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: What? Why not? It's not like you're doing anything wrong...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Что? Почему нет? Не похоже, что ты делаешь что-то не так...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Haha, well, it makes her jealous.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Хаха, ну, это заставляет ее ревновать.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: If I teach Firis, Sophie gets mad and starts going on about how she's Firis' teacher.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Если я буду учить Фирис, Софи разозлится и начнет говорить, что она учительница Фирис.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Honestly. She's a grown woman now, but inside she's still just a kid.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Честно. Она уже взрослая женщина, но внутри она все еще ребенок.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Hahaha, she still relies on you a lot, Sophie!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха, она все еще во многом на тебя рассчитывает, Софи!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Oh, you bet she does. Sometimes I think she'd do better without...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: О, можешь поспорить, она так и делает. Иногда мне кажется, что ей было бы лучше без...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Plachta! I've baked some cookies! Let's have some tea!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Плахта! Я испекла печенье! Давайте выпьем чаю!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Yes, I'm coming! Sorry, girls, but it's time for tea.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Да, я иду! Простите, девочки, но пора пить чай.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Sophie, what's on the menu for today?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Софи, что сегодня в меню?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Some of my special cakes, and some lemon tea too!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Немного моих фирменных пирожных и немного чая с лимоном!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: She just stopped mid-sentence and went off to eat, didn't she?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Она просто остановилась на полуслове и пошла есть, не так ли?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Hahaha, this might sound odd coming from me, but Plachta's first loyalty is to her stomach!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха, это может показаться странным с моей стороны, но первая преданность Плахты — ее желудку!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..original: Hah, that's unexpected! I guess Plachta might also be more of a little kid than I thought!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_010..translation: Ха, это неожиданно! Думаю, Плахта тоже может оказаться еще большим ребенком, чем я думал!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Hello, Plachta. Fancy a little friendly competition?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Здравствуйте, Плахта. Хотите устроить небольшое дружеское соревнование?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Very well. What do you propose?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Очень хорошо. Что вы предлагаете?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Hahaha! Nothing less than a test of alchemy knowledge!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Не что иное, как проверка знаний алхимии!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: You've got guts, Suelle. Thinking you can compete with me in alchemy!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: У тебя есть смелость, Сюэль. Думаю, ты сможешь соревноваться со мной в алхимии!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Oh no, I'm not going to be your opponent. Ta-dah! Lydie is!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: О нет, я не собираюсь быть твоим противником. Та-да! Лиди есть!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: What? Me? Me?! This is the first I'm hearing about this!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Что? Мне? Мне?! Впервые слышу об этом!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: It just suddenly came to me! You like to read a lot, right Lydie?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Это просто внезапно пришло ко мне! Ты любишь много читать, да, Лиди?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: So maybe you can give Plachta a run for her money!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Так что, возможно, вы сможете дать Плахте шанс заработать деньги!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: I don't have your confidence! I'm sorry, Plachta. I forfeit to you, of course.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: У меня нет твоего доверия! Мне очень жаль, Плахта. Я проигрываю тебе, конечно.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: No, I don't accept that. Let's do this. I like a good challenge!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Нет, я этого не принимаю. Давайте сделаем это. Мне нравится хороший вызов!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: No need to get quite so excited! Very well, I'll do it...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Не нужно так волноваться! Очень хорошо, я сделаю это...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Question 1! Is puni fluid acid or alkaline?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Вопрос 1! Пуниная жидкость – кислота или щелочь?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Together
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Alkaline.<CR>Alkaline!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Щелочная.<CR>Щёлочная!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: System
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Alkaline!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Щелочная!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Correct! What does "alkaline" mean again?... Anyway, next question! Spines of an uni are always...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Правильный! Что еще значит «щелочная»?... Впрочем, следующий вопрос! Шипы универа всегда...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Together
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: A multiple of four.<CR>A multiple of four!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Кратное четырем.<CR>Кратное четырёх!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: System
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: A multiple of four!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: кратно четырем!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Another correct answer from you both! Who counted them, anyway? On to question three...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Еще один правильный ответ от вас обоих! Кто их вообще считал? Переходим к третьему вопросу...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Uwah, I knew I'd lose. There was no way I could hope to win!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Ух, я знал, что проиграю. Я не мог надеяться на победу!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Not at all, Lydie. I'm impressed. You've acquired much knowledge for your young age.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Вовсе нет, Лидия. Я впечатлен. Вы приобрели много знаний для своего юного возраста.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: You should be more confident. Your daily studies will surely pay off.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Вам следует быть более уверенным в себе. Ваши ежедневные занятия обязательно окупятся.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Plachta! Thank you. I'll try to keep it up!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Плахта! Спасибо. Я постараюсь продолжать в том же духе!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Wow. I can never tell them that I didn't know most of the answers to the questions I was asking.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Ух ты. Я никогда не смогу сказать им, что не знаю большинства ответов на вопросы, которые задавал.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..original: Right... I'm going to forget today ever happened. So, what to eat tomorrow? Hahaha!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_020..translation: Верно... Я забуду, что произошло сегодня. Итак, что съесть завтра? Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Plachta! Plachta! We've got a question for you!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Плахта! Плахта! У нас есть к вам вопрос!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Can we watch you while you do some alchemy?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Можем ли мы посмотреть, как ты занимаешься алхимией?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Well, what do you think? You're Sophie's teacher, after all!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Ну, что ты думаешь? В конце концов, ты учитель Софи!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: You must be quite the alchemist! Do you mix while standing on your head? Ooh, tell me that you do!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Ты, должно быть, настоящий алхимик! Вы смешиваете, стоя на голове? Ох, скажи мне, что ты делаешь!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Girls. I'm an alchemist, not a clown!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Девушки. Я алхимик, а не клоун!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Also, I'm sorry to betray your expectations, but I can't actually synthesize.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Кроме того, мне жаль, что я предал ваши ожидания, но я не могу синтезировать.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: What? You can't?! What do you mean?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Что? Ты не можешь?! Что ты имеешь в виду?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Exactly what it sounds like. There's a reason why I can't make items.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Именно так это звучит. Есть причина, по которой я не могу создавать предметы.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Really? But you know so much about alchemy!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Действительно? Но ты так много знаешь об алхимии!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Of course, I used to synthesize in the past. But since I've had this body...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Конечно, раньше я синтезировал. Но поскольку у меня было это тело...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Yeah... I don't think we should stick our noses in this one...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Да... Я не думаю, что нам стоит совать нос в это...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Plachta, thank you. Sorry for asking something so weird.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Плахта, спасибо. Извините, что спросил что-то такое странное.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: No, that's fine. I can offer you some advice about alchemy, instead.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Нет, это нормально. Вместо этого я могу дать вам несколько советов по поводу алхимии.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Wow, are you sure? That would be great!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Вау, ты уверен? Это было бы здорово!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..original: Without further delay, then. The secret to thinking up recipes...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_030..translation: Тогда без дальнейших проволочек. Секрет придумывания рецептов...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hmm. Which should I read next?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Хм. Что мне прочитать дальше?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hey, Plachta. Are you choosing a book?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Привет, Плахта. Вы выбираете книгу?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Yes. I love to read. Would you both care to join me?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Да. Я люблю читать. Не могли бы вы оба присоединиться ко мне?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hahaha, I thought you'd never ask! No running away, Sue, please!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я думал, ты никогда не спросишь! Не убегай, Сью, пожалуйста!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Gyah! She caught me...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Да! Она поймала меня...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Of course I did. I'm your sister!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Конечно, я это сделал. Я твоя сестра!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Plachta was kind enough to ask us to join her! A little reading will do you some good.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Плахта любезно предложила нам присоединиться к ней! Небольшое чтение пойдет вам на пользу.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Ugh... fine! But just a little, okay?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Ух... ладно! Но совсем немного, ладно?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hmm. You may not like reading, Suelle, but you handle those books with care.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Хм. Возможно, ты не любишь читать, Сюэль, но ты обращаешься с этими книгами осторожно.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Of course. Just because I hate something, it doesn't mean I'm going to throw it around!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Конечно. Если я что-то ненавижу, это не значит, что я собираюсь это выбросить!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Promise with Mom Number 3! "Handle books with care"!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Обещание маме номер 3! «Осторожно обращайтесь с книгами»!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hahaha... That one only came about because you always used to leave books lying around...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Это произошло только потому, что ты всегда оставлял книги валяться повсюду...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: I was a baby! I look after books now by keeping them safe on the shelf at all times.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Я был ребенком! Теперь я забочусь о книгах, всегда держу их на полке.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hah! You get bored too easily, Sue.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Ха! Тебе слишком быстро становится скучно, Сью.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hehe. In any case, I'm impressed to see you looking after books so well.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Хе-хе. В любом случае, я впечатлен тем, что ты так хорошо следишь за книгами.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Eating while reading, or folding page corners, I cannot abide people who do such things!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Есть во время чтения или загибать уголки страниц — я терпеть не могу людей, которые делают такие вещи!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hahaha! Plachta, you sound like a book yourself.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Плахта, ты сама говоришь как книга.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: With good reason, I assure you. I was a book, once.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Уверяю вас, на то есть веские причины. Когда-то я был книгой.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: ... What?! You were a book?!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: ... Что?! Ты был книгой?!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Hey, Lydie... Plachta says the weirdest things sometimes, doesn't she?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Эй, Лиди... Плахта иногда говорит самые странные вещи, не так ли?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Yeah... Is she simply joking? She doesn't look like the type to joke around...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Да... Она просто шутит? Она не похожа на человека, над которым можно шутить...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: I know. But I can't believe that's true, either... Hmm?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Я знаю. Но я тоже не могу поверить, что это правда... Хм?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Girls? Is something wrong?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Девушки? Что-то не так?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..original: Ah! No, it's nothing. We're fine.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_040..translation: Ах! Нет, это ничего. У нас все в порядке.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: ... Эм-м-м!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Just... wanna...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Просто... хочу...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: W-What's got into both of you? Why are you staring at me like that?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Ч-что нашло на вас обоих? Почему ты так смотришь на меня?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Well... After looking at you closely, we can really see how your body is a doll...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Что ж... Присмотревшись к тебе повнимательнее, мы действительно можем увидеть, насколько твое тело похоже на куклу...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: You've got that tail going on, of course, and those cool parts stuck to your back...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: У тебя, конечно, есть этот хвост, и эти крутые части прилипли к твоей спине...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: What does it feel like, I wonder? Can I touch you?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Интересно, на что это похоже? Могу ли я прикоснуться к тебе?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: O-Of course not! How embarrassing. Please excuse me!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: О-конечно нет! Как стыдно. Пожалуйста, извините меня!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Ah, hold on!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Ах, держись!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Hey! Don't grab that! Don't grab my tail! And it's not a tail either, it's an important piece of...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Привет! Не хватай это! Не хватай меня за хвост! И это тоже не хвост, это важная часть...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Heh, it looks like a tail to me... So, Plachta...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Хех, мне кажется, это хвост... Итак, Плахта...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Just what can your body do? I've seen you eating stuff, like cookies... Do you use the toilet?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Что же может сделать ваше тело? Я видела, как ты ел что-нибудь, например печенье... Ты ходишь в туалет?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Are you soft? Or unexpectedly hard? Please, let me touch you! Just a little!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Ты мягкий? Или неожиданно тяжело? Пожалуйста, позволь мне прикоснуться к тебе! Совсем немного!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: W-What's with you both?! Please, stay back!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Ч-что с вами обоими?! Пожалуйста, держись!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Sophie! Sophie! Save me! Please, save me!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Софи! Софи! Спаси меня! Пожалуйста, спаси меня!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Bah! But I still have loads of questions...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Ба! Но у меня еще масса вопросов...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: I just wanted to poke her tummy a little... That's all.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Мне просто хотелось немного потыкать ей животик... Вот и все.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: What are you talking about? Lydie and Sue? That doesn't sound much like them.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: О чем ты говоришь? Лиди и Сью? Это не очень похоже на них.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: It is! It's exactly like them! Those two little monsters!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Это! Это точно так же, как они! Эти два маленьких монстра!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: Hmm, it feels like I've seen this before somewhere?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: Хм, такое чувство, будто я где-то это уже видел?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..original: It can't be helped that they're inquisitive, anyway. I had all sorts of questions myself, haha...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_050..translation: В любом случае, ничего не поделаешь, если они любознательны. У меня самого были разные вопросы, хаха...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: I'm going to try again. Just asking can't hurt! Plachta, how old are you?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Я попробую еще раз. Просто спросить не повредит! Плачта, сколько тебе лет?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Sue! I know this is an interesting topic, but I think you're starting to bother the poor woman!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Сью! Я знаю, это интересная тема, но мне кажется, ты начинаешь беспокоить бедную женщину!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Asking her age is very rude, too. I'm sorry, Plachta.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Спрашивать ее возраст тоже очень грубо. Мне очень жаль, Плахта.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Hold on, I want to know the answer! All this talk about "long ago"... Well, how long?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Подожди, я хочу знать ответ! Все эти разговоры о «давно»… Ну и как долго?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Hehe, I don't mind answering this one. My age? I am...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Хе-хе, я не против ответить на этот вопрос. Мой возраст? Я...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Yes?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Да?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Sixteen.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Шестнадцать.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: This body was made to look sixteen. And a doll body does not age.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Это тело было создано так, чтобы выглядеть шестнадцатилетним. А тело куклы не стареет.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Therefore, I am sixteen. So long as I am in this body, I will be sixteen forever!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Следовательно, мне шестнадцать. Пока я в этом теле, мне навсегда будет шестнадцать!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Sounds like cheating to me...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Для меня это звучит как обман...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: What is it actually? About 520? A bit more?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Что это такое на самом деле? Около 520? Еще немного?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Sophie! Why did you have to ruin it?!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Софи! Зачем тебе было его портить?!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Sorry, but I can't just sit by while a friend so fiendishly covers up her age...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Извините, но я не могу просто сидеть сложа руки, пока подруга так яростно скрывает свой возраст...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: 520! That's like, a super granny! The grandma among grandmas!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: 520! Вот типа супербабушка! Бабушка среди бабушек!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Ah... I wouldn't throw terminology like that around...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Эх... Я бы не стал разбрасываться такой терминологией...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: It's all right. I'm definitely an old maid, however you count it.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Все в порядке. Я определенно старая дева, как бы вы это ни считали.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: A stubborn, set-in-her ways, always complaining, eccentric old granny, that's me!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Упрямая, своенравная, вечно жалующаяся, эксцентричная старая бабушка – это я!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Oh dear, you've done it now... Girls, please, try and change the subject!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: О боже, ты уже это сделал... Девочки, попробуйте сменить тему!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Okay, okay... I know! Plachta, I've got another question!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Ладно, ладно... Я знаю! Плачта, у меня еще вопрос!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: You've been a book, and now a doll... Do you want to become human again?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Ты была книгой, а теперь куклой... Хочешь снова стать человеком?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Yes. Of course I do. But there's also no hurry.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Да. Конечно, да. Но и спешить некуда.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: I have complete faith in Sophie, and she'll be able to turn me back, one day.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Я полностью верю в Софи, и однажды она сможет вернуть меня.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Uwah! Plachta, you really do trust Sophie...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Ува! Плахта, ты действительно доверяешь Софи...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Yes. Even if she does go around spilling all my secrets.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Да. Даже если она выдаст все мои секреты.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Ah, I'm going to pay for that one later... That's the problem with the elderly!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Эх, за это я потом заплачу... Вот в чем проблема стариков!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: What?! Another kick while I'm down! And you dare to address your teacher in such a way!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Что?! Еще один удар, пока я лежу! И вы смеете так обращаться к своему учителю!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Hahaha, Sophie and Plachta really are such good friends!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Ха-ха-ха, Софи и Плахта действительно такие хорошие друзья!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: I've never seen two people who seem to be having so much fun when they are fighting.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Я никогда не видел двух людей, которым было бы так весело, когда они ссорились.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: You're such a slob, too! Look, I can see your underwear again!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Ты тоже такой неряха! Смотри, я снова вижу твое нижнее белье!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..original: Hey, you don't have to say that with them here! And you're one to talk about showing off...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_060..translation: Эй, тебе не обязательно говорить это с ними здесь! И ты один из тех, кто говорит о хвастовстве...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: How many times do I have to tell you?! After you've used something, put it back!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Сколько раз мне тебе говорить?! После того, как вы что-то использовали, положите это обратно!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Gah! I was just placing it somewhere I can easily find it again, that's all...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Га! Я просто положил его туда, где смогу легко его найти, вот и все...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Ah, Sophie is getting chewed out again...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Ох, Софи снова разжевывают...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Hahaha... I've seen that so often, I'm starting to think it's just a routine in this atelier.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Я видел это так часто, что начинаю думать, что это просто рутина в этом ателье.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Great timing, girls! Take care of Plachta, will you? Later!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Отличное время, девочки! Позаботься о Плахте, ладно? Позже!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Hey, wait! Gah, she's gone. Always so fast to run away!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Эй, подожди! Га, она ушла. Всегда так быстро убегаешь!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Sorry about that. It looks like our timing was off?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Извините за это. Похоже, мы опоздали?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: No, it's fine. Hehehe. We can just start from the beginning when she gets back.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Нет, все в порядке. Хе-хе-хе. Мы сможем начать с самого начала, когда она вернется.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Uwah! Cold hearted!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Ува! Холодное сердце!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: It's not like I'm lecturing her for my own enjoyment.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Я не читаю ей лекции ради собственного удовольствия.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: While Sophie's alchemy may have grown in leaps and bounds, her general living skills are still poor.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Хотя алхимия Софи, возможно, и выросла семимильными шагами, ее общие жизненные навыки все еще остаются плохими.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: If I can't change this, she'll become a worthless old lady who's only saving grace is her alchemy!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Если я не смогу это изменить, она превратится в никчемную старушку, единственным спасением которой является ее алхимия!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: I want her to be happy, that's all. So she needs to be able to do more than just alchemy...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Я хочу, чтобы она была счастлива, вот и все. Значит, ей нужно уметь больше, чем просто алхимию...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: I see... So that's the reason behind all of your lecturing.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Понятно... Вот в чем причина всех ваших лекций.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Hahaha! Plachta, it's like you're her mother!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Плачта, ты как будто ее мать!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: M-Mother?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: М-мама?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: I've been called "elderly" and "granny" and all sorts in the past...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: В прошлом меня называли «пожилой», «бабушкой» и так далее…

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: But this is the first time I've been called a "mother". Wow, this one might be really getting to me...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Но это первый раз, когда меня называют «матерью». Ого, возможно, это меня действительно задевает...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Really? Hehe, Mother Plachta! I think it quite suits you.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Действительно? Хе-хе, матушка Плахта! Думаю, тебя это вполне устраивает.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: S-Stop that! I think I'd rather be treated like a frail old lady than be called "mother"!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: П-прекрати это! Я думаю, что лучше со мной будут обращаться как с хрупкой старушкой, чем называть «матерью»!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Both of you, don't call me that again! Understand?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Вы оба, не называйте меня так больше! Понимать?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Okay! No problem, Mommy Plachta!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Хорошо! Ничего страшного, мамочка Плахта!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Suelle, time for one of my famous lectures. All of your dreams are about to come true!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Сюэль, пришло время одной из моих знаменитых лекций. Все ваши мечты вот-вот сбудутся!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Oh no, I went too far! Run for it!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: О нет, я зашел слишком далеко! Беги за этим!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: Hey, Sue! Ah, Plachta, see you later!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Привет, Сью! Ах, Плахта, увидимся позже!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..original: I can hardly keep up with those two, honestly...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_070..translation: Честно говоря, я с трудом успеваю за этими двумя...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Oh? Welcome, you two. Would you like some tea?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Ой? Добро пожаловать, вы двое. Хотите чаю?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Are you all right, Plachta?!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: С тобой все в порядке, Плахта?!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: ... I am sorry. It's embarrassing, but I'm not very used to this body yet...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: ... Мне жаль. Стыдно, но я еще не очень привыкла к этому телу...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: It's been 500 years since I had a human one. I can't seem to find the right balance...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Прошло 500 лет с тех пор, как у меня был человеческий. Не могу найти правильный баланс...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Oh... I guess a doll's body and a human one must be pretty different...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Ох... Наверное, тела куклы и человека сильно отличаются...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: By the way, how does it even feel, having a doll's body? Were your joints like all hard?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Кстати, каково это вообще иметь кукольное тело? Ваши суставы были твердыми?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Not at all. It was a work of a master, after all.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Нисколько. В конце концов, это была работа мастера.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Even if there were times when I would injure it, it never failed me otherwise.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Даже если были моменты, когда я мог его поранить, в остальном он меня никогда не подводил.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Hmmmm. Does that mean that a human body is actually less comfortable?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Хмммм. Означает ли это, что человеческое тело на самом деле менее комфортно?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Ahaha, well, I wouldn't say that... I am simply not used to it yet.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Ахаха, ну я бы так не сказал... Просто я еще не привык.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: But this body does... how should I say it... "fit better"? I guess.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Но это тело... как бы это сказать... "подходит лучше"? Наверное.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: "Fit better"?... I can't even begin to understand...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: «Лучше подходит»?... Я даже не могу понять...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: That is natural. Usually, humans do not get to experience having more than one kind of body, after all.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Это естественно. В конце концов, обычно людям не удается иметь более одного типа тел.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Well, when I first got my doll body it didn't take that much to get used to it. So I think it won't be long now...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Что ж, когда я впервые получила свое кукольное тело, мне не потребовалось много времени, чтобы к нему привыкнуть. Так что я думаю, что это ненадолго...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Yeah, my favorite student made this body for me after all, and I want to use it freely as soon as I can... Ohoh.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Да, мой любимый ученик все-таки сделал для меня это тело, и я хочу использовать его свободно, как только смогу... Ох.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Uh? That was some nasty noise. Ahh! The flask is in shards!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Эм-м-м? Это был какой-то противный шум. Ах! Колба разлетелась на осколки!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: I think it got crushed under Plachta's bottom... Hip-crusher Plachta... A technique to fear...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Думаю, его раздавило под задом Плахты... Бедродробилка Плахты... Техника, которой стоит бояться...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Hip-crusher?! Don't give me any weird nicknames!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Хип-сокрушитель?! Не давайте мне никаких странных прозвищ!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Yeah, I mean her hips are pretty big... Oh. No. I mean... ! Ugh, well, we'll be going now! Bye!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Да, я имею в виду, что ее бедра довольно большие... Ох. Нет, я имею в виду... ! Ух, ну, сейчас пойдем! Пока!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Wait right there! Mocking my complexes... You'll get an earful yet!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Подождите здесь! Издеваюсь над моими комплексами... Еще по уху получишь!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Waaah! She can run just fine! I think we've inspired her to master her new body!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Вааа! Она прекрасно умеет бегать! Я думаю, мы вдохновили ее на освоение своего нового тела!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Run for it! She'll spank us for sure if she catches up!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Беги за этим! Она нас обязательно отшлепает, если догонит!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..original: Girls! I won't forgive you easily for this! Get back here!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_080..translation: Девушки! Я не прощу тебе этого легко! Вернись сюда!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: Hey, girls! I've been waiting for you!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: You have? Some kind of emergency job?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: У вас есть? Какая-то экстренная работа?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: Was that your tummy rumbling, Plachta? That means...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Плахта, это у тебя в животе урчало? Это значит...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: That's right. It's been a long time since I experienced rumbling like this.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Это верно. Давно я не сталкивался с таким грохотом.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: Since becoming human again, everything I eat is just so delicious!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: С тех пор, как я снова стал человеком, все, что я ем, стало таким вкусным!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: So I want both of you to feed me with the most delicious stuff you can find!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Поэтому я хочу, чтобы вы оба накормили меня самым вкусным, что только сможете найти!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: Hahaha, I guess that makes sense. You can leave this to us, then!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я думаю, это имеет смысл. Тогда вы можете оставить это нам!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: We'll bring enough food to feed you ten times over!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Мы привезём столько еды, чтобы накормить вас в десять раз больше!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: As quickly as possible, please. Hehehe!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: I'm so hungry, the two of you are starting to look quite delicious!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Я так голоден, вы двое начинаете выглядеть очень аппетитно!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..original: Uwaaah! We'll be quick, we promise, just don't eat us!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_090..translation: Увааа! Мы будем быстрыми, обещаем, только не ешьте нас!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Plachta! We've got some of the most delicious food we could find!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Плахта! У нас есть одни из самых вкусных блюд, которые мы только могли найти!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: This should fill you up, Plachta! Go ahead, eat...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Это должно тебя наполнить, Плахта! Давай, ешь...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Phew, thanks. That was all very good.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Уф, спасибо. Все было очень хорошо.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: What! You've finished already?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Что! Ты уже закончил?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: I-I think I blinked and missed it! Is this what happens when you go hungry for 500 years?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Кажется, я моргнул и пропустил это! Вот что происходит, когда голодаешь 500 лет?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: The 500 Years' Hunger! Yes, I might enter an eating contest under that name.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: 500-летний голод! Да, я мог бы принять участие в конкурсе еды под этим именем.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Hahaha. You'll probably face Firis in the final!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха. Вероятно, в финале вы встретитесь с Фирис!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Probably. Anyway, recently, eating has been giving me much joy.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Вероятно. В любом случае, в последнее время еда доставляла мне много радости.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Being able to truly enjoy delicious food might be the best thing about becoming human again.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Возможность по-настоящему наслаждаться вкусной едой может оказаться лучшим способом снова стать человеком.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: I did eat while I was a doll, after all, but I couldn't taste the food.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: В конце концов, я ела, когда была куклой, но не могла ощутить вкус еды.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: I see, I see... A bit of indulging now isn't going to hurt, then, is it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Понятно, понятно... Немного побаловаться сейчас не повредит, не так ли?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Hmm...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Хм...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: What is it, Suelle? Have I got some food stuck on my face?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Что такое, Сюэль? У меня на лице застряла еда?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: No, but I was just thinking... Have you put on a little weight, Plachta?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Нет, я просто подумал... Ты не поправилась, Плахта?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Hey, now that you mention it... You do look a little plumper!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Эй, теперь, когда ты об этом упомянул... Ты выглядишь немного полнее!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Y-You might be right... I have been feeling heavier recently.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Д-возможно, ты прав... В последнее время я чувствую себя тяжелее.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: I overlooked that point. Completely forgot about it! A human body gets larger, doesn't it!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Я упустил из виду этот момент. Совсем забыл об этом! Человеческое тело становится больше, не так ли!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: It's much easier to put it on that it is to take it off.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Надеть его гораздо проще, чем снять.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Uwah! Is the human body so cruel?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Ува! Так ли жестоко человеческое тело?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: What can I do?! I want to eat, but I don't want to get fat!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Что я могу сделать?! Я есть хочу, но не хочу толстеть!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Sophie! Sophie! Answer me! Give me the answer!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Софи! Софи! Ответьте мне! Дай мне ответ!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Plachta... That's a battle that every human has to fight for themselves...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Плахта... Это битва, которую каждому человеку приходится вести за себя...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: That's the truth of life, Plachta. You're living it now.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Это правда жизни, Плахта. Ты живешь этим сейчас.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..original: Sue, I think that might be going a little far!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_100..translation: Сью, я думаю, это зашло слишком далеко!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ugh... My back is killing me.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ух... Моя спина меня убивает.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Eh?! Are you alright? Did you sprain it?!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Э?! Ты в порядке? Ты его вывихнул?!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: No way! I'm not that old yet! I just spent a bit too long at my desk last night...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ни за что! Я еще не так стар! Вчера вечером я слишком долго просидел за столом...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Oh... Well, maybe you just need a massage? I could help you.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ох... Ну, может, тебе просто нужен массаж? Я мог бы помочь тебе.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: I'm actually pretty good at it! Sometimes I even get asked by our neighbors...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: На самом деле у меня это неплохо получается! Иногда меня даже спрашивают наши соседи...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Really? Well, if you don't mind...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Действительно? Ну, если ты не против...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Sophie? Sorry, I think I'll need my usual maintenance...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Софи? Извините, думаю, мне понадобится обычное обслуживание...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ahahaha! Maintenance? You're a human now!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ахахаха! Обслуживание? Ты теперь человек!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ah... Right. Sorry, of course you're right...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ах... Верно. Извините, конечно, вы правы...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Heh... That heavenly ticklish feeling... I guess I'll never get to experience that again.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Хех... Это божественное щекотливое чувство... Думаю, мне больше никогда не доведется его испытать.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: She looks pretty disappointed about that. Does maintenance really feel that good?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Она выглядит очень разочарованной этим. Действительно ли обслуживание так приятно?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: I wonder... It's not like we can do it to humans... Hm?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Интересно... Не похоже, что мы можем сделать это с людьми... Хм?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Oh! I've got it! Your offer of a massage. I think there's someone better to...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ой! Я понял! Ваше предложение массажа. Я думаю, есть кто-то лучше...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Aaaaahhhh...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ааааааа...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ehehe, does it really feel that good, Plachta?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Эхехе, неужели так хорошо, Плахта?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: It does... It really does... It feels the best...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Да... Действительно так... Это лучше всего...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Wow. That's some face, Plachta! Lydie must be really good.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ух ты. Вот какое лицо, Плахта! Лиди, должно быть, очень хороша.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ugh, I think I'm getting envious. Lydie! I want one too, after all!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ох, кажется, я начинаю завидовать. Лиди! Я ведь тоже хочу!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Okaay! Just give me a few minutes here. ...Hn! This should be a good spot!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Хорошо! Просто дай мне здесь несколько минут. ...Хн! Это должно быть хорошее место!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Oooohh! Amazing... you're amazing, Lydie! I can't... think anymore...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ооооо! Потрясающе... ты потрясающая, Лиди! Я не могу... больше думать...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Ehhehe! That's right, that's right. And for the finish... there's this special technique...
