ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Эхехе! Это верно, это верно. А для завершения... есть такая особая техника...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Oooohh! I'm in heaven... !
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Ооооо! Я в раю... !

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Thank... you... very much...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Большое спасибо...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: It was... very... good
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Это было... очень... хорошо

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: ... Ooops. I might have overdone it a little.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: ... Упс. Возможно, я немного переборщил.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: I wouldn't say "a little"... But they look pretty happy, so I guess it's alright?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Я бы не сказал "немного"... Но они выглядят довольно счастливыми, так что, думаю, всё в порядке?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: Yeah, you're right! It's nice to do something good!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Да, ты прав! Приятно делать что-то хорошее!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: ... Good? ... That?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: ... Хороший? ... Что?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: I am... very happy... Thank you...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Я... очень счастлив... Спасибо...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: It was... great
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: Это было... здорово

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..original: ... I don't think I'll ever risk getting a massage from Lydie.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_110..translation: ... Не думаю, что когда-нибудь рискну получить массаж от Лиди.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Plachta, hello.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Плахта, здравствуйте.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Girls, good timing. In fact, perfect timing!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Девочки, удачное время. На самом деле, идеальное время!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I've got a request for you. Will you watch me synthesize?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: У меня к вам просьба. Ты посмотришь, как я синтезирую?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Synthesize? But you said you couldn't do it before...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Синтезировать? Но ты сказал, что не мог сделать это раньше...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: That was because of my doll body.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Это произошло из-за моего кукольного тела.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Now I am human again, I should - in theory - be able to perform alchemy again...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Теперь я снова человек и теоретически должен снова уметь заниматься алхимией...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Of course! In which case, we'd love to watch you in action, Plachta!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Конечно! В таком случае, мы будем рады увидеть тебя в деле, Плахта!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: We get to see 500 years of alchemy experience in action! I can't wait! Plachta, go ahead!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Мы увидим 500-летний опыт алхимии в действии! Я не могу дождаться! Плахта, вперед!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Thank you. Listen to the desires of the materials, and change their properties. Remember...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Спасибо. Прислушивайтесь к желаниям материалов и меняйте их свойства. Помнить...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I did it! Success!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Я сделал это! Успех!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Great! Congratulations! Not to mention the high quality...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Большой! Поздравляем! Не говоря уже о высоком качестве...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: So this is your skill, Plachta? Uwah, I think I've got goosebumps!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Так это твое умение, Плахта? Ух, кажется, у меня мурашки по коже!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Hehe, this takes me back. The feeling of creating something new. That raw thrill!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Хе-хе, это возвращает меня назад. Ощущение создания чего-то нового. Этот необузданный восторг!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: It's been so long since I experienced this. Alchemy really is something special, isn't it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Прошло так много времени с тех пор, как я испытал это. Алхимия действительно нечто особенное, не так ли?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: You're right! Alchemy is fun!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Ты прав! Алхимия – это весело!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: It's been 500 years for you, hasn't it? That must make it feel even better!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Для тебя прошло 500 лет, не так ли? Это должно заставить его чувствовать себя еще лучше!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: It does. Now I can experience this again any time I want!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Это так. Теперь я могу испытать это снова в любое время, когда захочу!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I owe Sophie even more gratitude, clearly. She has given me back something very dear to me.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Очевидно, я обязан Софи еще большей благодарностью. Она вернула мне что-то очень дорогое для меня.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Hehe. You look so happy, Plachta!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Хе-хе. Ты выглядишь такой счастливой, Плахта!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I'm glad, too. Please show us what you can do again soon!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Я тоже рад. Пожалуйста, покажите нам, что вы можете сделать снова в ближайшее время!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: Of course. Any time you like, girls, if that is all right with you. Thank you for today.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Конечно. Девочки, в любое время, если вас это устраивает. Спасибо за сегодня.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: It's been a while since I synthesized anything, but there's one thing I can't ignore from this.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Давненько я ничего не синтезировал, но есть одна вещь, которую я не могу игнорировать.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: From the quality of this item, it's clear that my student surpassed me long ago...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: По качеству этой вещи видно, что мой ученик уже давно меня превзошёл...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..original: I think the time may have finally come...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_120..translation: Я думаю, что время, наконец, пришло...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Sophie! Plachta! Do you want to play cards with us?...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Софи! Плахта! Хотите поиграть с нами в карты?...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Hold on. It looks like they are having some serious discussion...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Подожди. Похоже, у них серьезный разговор...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Alright, Plachta. What is it that you want to talk about?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Хорошо, Плахта. О чем ты хочешь поговорить?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Do you remember, Sophie, the goal that I once set for you?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Помнишь ли ты, Софи, цель, которую я когда-то перед тобой поставил?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Of course. To surpass you as an alchemist, Plachta. What about it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Конечно. Превзойти тебя как алхимика, Плахта. Что насчет этого?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: I tried some synthesis recently. It was a success. I made an item without any trouble.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Недавно я попробовал синтезировать. Это был успех. Я сделал предмет без каких-либо проблем.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Wow, you did? That's great, Plachta!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Вау, ты это сделал? Это здорово, Плахта!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Thank you. However, at the same time, I realized something. You have already well surpassed me.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Спасибо. Однако в то же время я кое-что понял. Вы уже значительно превзошли меня.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: ...What?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: ...Что?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Congratulations, Sophie. You have surpassed me as an alchemist.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Поздравляю, Софи. Ты превзошёл меня как алхимик.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: As your friend, your family, and your teacher, I am so happy. You really have worked hard.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Как ваш друг, ваша семья и ваш учитель, я так счастлив. Вы действительно много работали.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: ...Thank you. All that work has paid off...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: ...Спасибо. Вся эта работа окупилась...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: But this doesn't mean things are going to change, right? We'll still be a student and a teacher?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Но это не значит, что все изменится, верно? Мы все равно останемся учеником и учителем?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: No, we won't. In this moment, I think something has definitely changed.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Нет, мы не будем. В этот момент, я думаю, что-то определенно изменилось.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: ...What do you mean?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: ...Что ты имеешь в виду?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: You've been so good to me, Sophie. You've done so much for me, all these years.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Ты была так добра ко мне, Софи. Ты так много сделал для меня за все эти годы.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: I am so grateful for all of that. Too grateful for words!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Я так благодарен за все это. Слишком благодарен за слова!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: But that's also why I'm worried. Worried about you.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Но именно поэтому я волнуюсь. Беспокоюсь о тебе.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Sophie. Am I getting in your way? Are you missing out on your own happiness, because of me?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Софи. Я мешаю тебе? Ты лишаешь своего счастья из-за меня?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: If so, then you've done enough. You've made me as happy as I can possibly be.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Если да, то вы сделали достаточно. Ты сделал меня настолько счастливым, насколько это возможно.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: For the sake of your own happiness, is it time for us to take different paths?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Не пора ли нам пойти разными путями ради собственного счастья?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: What!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Что!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: You know what I mean. Time for you to graduate. We should go our...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Если вы понимаете, о чем я. Тебе пора заканчивать учебу. Нам пора идти...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Ughhhh...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Уххх...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: S-Sophie! I'm not finished yet!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: С-Софи! Я еще не закончил!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Sophie? Sophie! I'm only thinking of your happiness! That's why I suggested...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Софи? Софи! Я думаю только о твоем счастье! Именно поэтому я предложил...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Ah! She's done it now. I can see why Sophie would be angry, putting it like that...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Ах! Она сделала это сейчас. Я понимаю, почему Софи рассердится, если сформулировать это так...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..original: Me too. Plachta is just too blunt sometimes...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_130..translation: Я тоже. Плахта иногда бывает слишком прямолинейной...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Oh, Sophie... What did I say wrong?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ох, Софи... Что я сказал не так?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Uwah! Plachta is super depressed!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ува! Плахта в супер депрессии!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Ah, girls! Please help me... Sophie won't listen to a thing I say.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ах, девочки! Пожалуйста, помогите мне... Софи не слушает ничего, что я говорю.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: I only proposed what I did because I was thinking of Sophie's future.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Я предложил то, что сделал, только потому, что думал о будущем Софи.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Ah, Sophie! We need to finish our conversation...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ах, Софи! Нам нужно закончить наш разговор...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Hah!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ха!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Ah! Aaah!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ах! Ааа!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Hahaha... Sophie doesn't hold back, does she?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Софи не сдерживается, не так ли?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: I don't understand this. I truly don't!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Я этого не понимаю. Я правда нет!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Does Sophie hate me now? Is that it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Софи меня теперь ненавидит? Это все?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Come on! She could never hate you, Plachta!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ну давай же! Она никогда не сможет тебя ненавидеть, Плахта!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Of course not! Sophie still loves you a lot, even now!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Конечно, нет! Софи все еще очень тебя любит, даже сейчас!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: That's exactly why she's acting like this. Can't you see that?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Именно поэтому она так себя ведет. Разве ты не видишь этого?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: I'm sorry. I just don't understand.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Мне жаль. Я просто не понимаю.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Lydie, Suelle! Please! Tell me the answer!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Лиди, Сюэль! Пожалуйста! Скажи мне ответ!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: I can't believe that not being able to talk to Sophie is so difficult!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Не могу поверить, что не иметь возможности поговорить с Софи — это так сложно!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Uh, I'm really starting to feel sorry for her. But...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Ох, мне действительно становится ее жаль. Но...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: I know. We can't tell her. This is Sophie and Plachta's problem.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Я знаю. Мы не можем ей сказать. Это проблема Софи и Плахты.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Plachta. You don't have to worry about anything.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Плахта. Вам не о чем беспокоиться.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: That's right. You just need to place your hand on your heart and think for yourself.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Это верно. Вам просто нужно положить руку на сердце и подумать самостоятельно.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Plachta, you're human now. The things you feel when your heart is throbbing the most...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Плахта, ты теперь человек. То, что ты чувствуешь, когда твое сердце бьется сильнее всего...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: Those are your true feelings, Plachta.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Вот твои истинные чувства, Плахта.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: My true feelings?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Мои истинные чувства?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: That's enough hints from us! You can handle the rest yourself!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Хватит с нас подсказок! Остальное вы можете сделать сами!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: We'll see you later!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Увидимся позже!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..original: When my heart is throbbing? My true feelings? I want... for things to stay the same with Sophie!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_140..translation: Когда мое сердце бьется? Мои истинные чувства? Я хочу... чтобы с Софи все оставалось по-прежнему!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Luard... It's a strange thing, isn't it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Луард... Странная вещь, не правда ли?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Yes? What?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Да? Что?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Sophie has surpassed me, and became a wonderful alchemist... Yet I'm so happy about it!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Софи превзошла меня и стала замечательным алхимиком... Но я так этому рада!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: In the past I pushed myself so hard, not wanting to lose to anyone.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Раньше я очень старался, не желая никому проигрывать.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Yet now, having my student surpass me makes me the happiest I've ever been.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: И все же теперь, когда мой ученик превзошел меня, я стал самым счастливым человеком, которым я когда-либо был.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Hehe. I understand that myself. Everything I've experienced changed my thinking, too.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Хе-хе. Я это понимаю сам. Все, что я испытал, изменило и мое мышление.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: It seems so clear now, doesn't it? There's no way that we two could hope to master alchemy.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Теперь это кажется таким ясным, не так ли? Мы не можем надеяться овладеть алхимией.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: With the passage of time, our alchemy will fade into the past... Progress overtakes us.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: С течением времени наша алхимия уйдет в прошлое... Прогресс настигает нас.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: That's good. That's the right thing. That's how alchemy evolves.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Это хорошо. Это правильно. Так развивается алхимия.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: As we become the past, more people are being saved by alchemy every day.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: По мере того, как мы уходим в прошлое, каждый день с помощью алхимии спасается все больше людей.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: That's why I'm happy to see us overtaken. If only I'd realized this 500 years ago...
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Вот почему я рад видеть, что нас обогнали. Если бы я только понял это 500 лет назад...

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Indeed. Well said.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Действительно. Хорошо сказано.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Our role now is to watch over them. To watch over and nurture the youth who will lead the future.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Наша роль сейчас – присматривать за ними. Присматривать и воспитывать молодежь, которая будет вести будущее.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Yes. This will be much harder than just synthesizing stuff! Do you think you can do it?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Да. Это будет намного сложнее, чем просто синтезировать вещи! Как вы думаете, вы сможете это сделать?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Hah, I was about to ask you the same thing. Can a softy like you really lead people?
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Ха, я собирался спросить тебя о том же. Может ли такой слабак, как ты, по-настоящему руководить людьми?

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Huh! If you can do it, there's no way that I can't!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Хм! Если вы можете это сделать, то я не смогу этого сделать!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Anyway. Look at us, both back in living bodies.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: В любом случае. Посмотрите на нас, оба снова в живых телах.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Our methods differed, but we can finally collect on an idea that we forgot 500 years ago.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Наши методы различались, но мы, наконец, можем собрать воедино идею, которую забыли 500 лет назад.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: That's right. Something bright, shining, and so important.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Это верно. Что-то яркое, сияющее и такое важное.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Alt
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: The seeds of tomorrow, which can never be forgotten.
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Семена завтрашнего дня, которые невозможно забыть.

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: Together
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Hope, for the future!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Надеюсь, на будущее!

ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..speaker: System
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..original: Hope, for the future!
ebm:qc12_pla/event_message_qc12_pla_150..translation: Надеюсь, на будущее!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Uwah, my head is starting to hurt... Lydie, what does this mean?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ух, у меня начинает болеть голова... Лиди, что это значит?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Let's have a look. You need to add them while mixing...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Давайте посмотрим. Их нужно добавлять во время смешивания...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Hey, look at this! Studying hard even on your own. That's the way, girls!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Эй, посмотри на это! Усердно учиться, даже самостоятельно. Вот так, девочки!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Ah, Ilmeria! We've been waiting for you!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ах, Ильмерия! Мы ждали вас!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Oh, you have? Do you have a question for me?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: О, у тебя есть? У вас есть ко мне вопрос?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: I'm tired of studying... Let's have some fun!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Я устал учиться... Давайте повеселимся!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: That's brave of you, Sue. To say that right after I just praised your diligence.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Это смело с твоей стороны, Сью. Сказать это сразу после того, как я только что похвалил ваше усердие.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: But all this reading wears me out! I really need a break!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Но все это чтение меня утомляет! Мне действительно нужен перерыв!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Hahaha, I'm sorry... Sorry Sue is such a bad student...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха, прости... Прости, Сью такая плохая ученица...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Hah, I guess it can't be helped. I was going to give you these later, but here's some sweets.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ха, я думаю, с этим ничего не поделаешь. Я собирался подарить тебе это позже, но вот сладости.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Ah! Are you sure? These are expensive!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ах! Вы уверены? Это дорого!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Are they? Don't worry about the cost, just eat them.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Они? Не беспокойтесь о стоимости, просто съешьте их.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Great! I love you! Let's eat!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Большой! Я тебя люблю! Давайте есть!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Thank you so much for that!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Огромное вам спасибо за это!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Wow, they were really good. So rich, but then they just melt in the mouth!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Вау, они были действительно хороши. Такие насыщенные, а потом просто тают во рту!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: I think you ate a few too many, though, Sue. Keep that up and you'll become fat!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Но я думаю, что ты съела слишком много, Сью. Продолжай в том же духе, и ты станешь толстым!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: I needed sugar after using my head so much! I watch my weight, don't worry about me!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Мне понадобился сахар после того, как я так много работал головой! Я слежу за своим весом, не беспокойтесь обо мне!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: I'm still growing, too! Everything I eat makes me taller, not wider!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Я тоже все еще расту! Все, что я ем, делает меня выше, а не шире!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: ...ugh.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: What, really? We might be twins, but I'm taller! Are you sure you aren't getting wider?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Что, правда? Может, мы и близнецы, но я выше! Вы уверены, что не становитесь шире?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: N-No I'm not! You're taller by, what, a centimeter? Maybe?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Н-нет, я не такой! Ты выше, на сколько, на сантиметр? Может быть?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: That doesn't even count. I'm growing every day! I might even overtake you soon!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Это даже не в счет. Я расту каждый день! Возможно, я даже скоро тебя догоню!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: ...Uuuuh!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: ...Уууу!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Um, Ilmeria? You've been moaning and groaning to yourself over there for a while now...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Эм, Ильмерия? Ты уже некоторое время стонешь и стонешь про себя там...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: It must be nice, to have such hope for the future. I've done all the growing... all the growing I'm...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Наверное, приятно иметь такую надежду на будущее. Я все взрослел... все взрослел, я...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Oh... Don't tell me, you've got a bit of a complex about your height?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ох... Только не говори мне, ты немного комплексуешь по поводу своего роста?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..original: Hahaha... I don't think we should bring up height around her...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Я не думаю, что нам стоит поднимать вокруг нее вопрос высоты...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: What now, then, Lydie? It's about to explode...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Что же теперь, Лиди? Он вот-вот взорвется...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Whaaat?! How can you be so calm? We have to do something!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Что?! Как ты можешь быть таким спокойным? Мы должны что-то сделать!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Sure we do, but I think it's too late. Hahaha...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Конечно, мы это делаем, но я думаю, что уже слишком поздно. Ха-ха-ха...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: This is no time for laughter! Uwaaah, help!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Сейчас не время для смеха! Увааа, помогите!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Put in some green neutralizer! Quickly!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Добавьте немного зеленого нейтрализатора! Быстро!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: What?! O-okay! Hey, it's stopped!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Что?! О-окей! Эй, это остановилось!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Phew, that was close. This one catches a lot of people off guard.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Уф, это было близко. Это застает многих людей врасплох.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Thank you so much. You literally saved us. You just turned up at the right time!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Большое спасибо. Вы буквально спасли нас. Вы просто появились в нужное время!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Hehe, I was watching outside. I thought it was about time you blew up your cauldron!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Хе-хе, я смотрел снаружи. Я подумал, что пришло время тебе взорвать свой котел!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Gah, are we that predictable? Why do I feel so ashamed?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Ха, мы настолько предсказуемы? Почему мне так стыдно?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Haha! I've got you in the palm of my hand. This is for you, then.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Хаха! Ты у меня на ладони. Тогда это для тебя.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: A textbook? Wow, it's packed with detailed information!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Учебник? Ого, как много подробной информации!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: That's right. It should contain all the data you need to proceed to the next level.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Это верно. Он должен содержать все данные, необходимые для перехода на следующий уровень.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: If you read all of that, your abilities could double!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Если вы прочитаете все это, ваши способности удвоятся!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: D-Double? Are you sure?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Д-дабл? Вы уверены?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Oh, you doubt me? Then I'll give you a task. Make the item here and bring it to me.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: О, ты сомневаешься во мне? Тогда я дам вам задание. Сделайте предмет здесь и принесите его мне.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Doing that should show you that this textbook is worth your time.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Это должно показать вам, что этот учебник стоит вашего времени.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Hmm, okay. We'll give it a try.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Хм, окей. Мы попробуем.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Don't try, do! And don't make that cauldron explode again! Bye-bye.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Не пытайся, делай! И не заставляй этот котел снова взорваться! Пока-пока.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: She came over just to bring us this book. She so different from Dad, I can't believe it!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Она пришла только для того, чтобы принести нам эту книгу. Она так отличается от папы, я не могу в это поверить!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Hahaha! He just leaves us to our devices, really...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Он просто оставляет нас на произвол судьбы, правда...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: Yeah. I'm so glad that she's a kind teacher! We have to work hard to keep her on our side!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: Ага. Я так рада, что она добрый учитель! Нам придется приложить немало усилий, чтобы удержать ее на нашей стороне!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..speaker: System
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..original: <CLEG>Ilmeria's Homework<CLNR> received.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_020..translation: <CLEG>Домашнее задание Ильмерии<CLNR> получено.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: Good, good. It looks like you've done a good job. Well done.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Хорошо, хорошо. Похоже, вы проделали хорошую работу. Отличная работа.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: How about that textbook? Did it help you?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: А как насчет того учебника? Вам это помогло?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: Yes, a lot! It was so easy to understand!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Да, много! Это было так легко понять!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: With all the images and diagrams I could read it too, no trouble!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Со всеми изображениями и диаграммами я тоже смог их прочитать, без проблем!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: You have great taste in textbooks, Ilmeria! Wherever did you find it?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: У тебя отличный вкус к учебникам, Ильмерия! Где вы это нашли?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: Oh, I didn't buy it. I made it!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Ой, я не купился. Я сделал это!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: What?! You made it yourself?! Your handwriting is amazing!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Что?! Ты сам это сделал?! Ваш почерк потрясающий!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: That's what you take away from that revelation? Well, I guess I'll take it.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Вот что вы вынесли из этого откровения? Ну, пожалуй, возьму.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: The textbook I used myself was really difficult. Very hard to decipher, just horrible.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Учебник, которым я пользовался сам, был действительно трудным. Очень сложно понять, просто ужасно.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: So I decided, if I ever got students of my own, to make my own textbook for them.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Поэтому я решил, если у меня когда-нибудь появятся ученики, сделать для них собственный учебник.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: I really broke down everything I had trouble with myself, so it should be quite easy to follow!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Я действительно разобрал все, с чем у меня были проблемы, так что следить за этим должно быть довольно легко!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: It was! Thank you so much for doing this for us!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Это было! Огромное спасибо, что делаете это для нас!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: We'll keep it safe, we promise! Hey, we'll make it a family heirloom!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Мы сохраним его, обещаем! Эй, мы сделаем это семейной реликвией!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: Y-You don't have to go that far! A bit of an exaggeration there!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Д-тебе не обязательно заходить так далеко! Здесь небольшое преувеличение!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: I hope it can be of help to you, though. It wasn't easy to make it, I can tell you that much!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Однако я надеюсь, что это может вам помочь. Сделать это было непросто, я могу вам многое сказать!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: Show me that all my hard work was worth it!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Покажите мне, что вся моя тяжелая работа того стоила!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: We will! Oh, and do you want me to write a book report on it? I can do that, if you like!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Мы будем! О, и вы хотите, чтобы я написал об этом отчет в книге? Я могу это сделать, если хочешь!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..original: Ah, no... That won't be necessary.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_030..translation: Ах, нет... В этом нет необходимости.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Ah, I've got one request. Could you show me the textbook that you used?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Ах, у меня есть одна просьба. Не могли бы вы показать мне учебник, который вы использовали?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Uwah, look at you! Ilmeria said it was "hard to decipher" and "horrible"! You want to see that?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Увау, посмотри на себя! Ильмерия сказала, что это «трудно понять» и «ужасно»! Вы хотите это увидеть?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: No need to tease her. Curiosity is a good thing. If you want to have a look, I'll show it to you.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Не надо ее дразнить. Любопытство – это хорошо. Если хочешь посмотреть, я тебе покажу.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Uwah, look at all that text! I can't tell what it's trying to say!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Увау, посмотри на весь этот текст! Я не могу понять, что он пытается сказать!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Yes, reading this isn't easy. It's filled with stuffy old expressions, too.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Да, читать это непросто. Он также полон скучных старых выражений.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: It's no good, I can't look at that! The person who wrote this must have been super strict!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Это нехорошо, я не могу на это смотреть! Человек, написавший это, должно быть, был очень строгим!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: I guess you could say that. A very particular person, one might say.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Думаю, ты мог бы так сказать. Можно сказать, очень специфический человек.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Hold on. Do you know the person who wrote this?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Подожди. Вы знаете человека, который это написал?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Of course. That book was written by my father. Look at the cover.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Конечно. Эту книгу написал мой отец. Посмотрите на обложку.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: "Alfred Von Leinweber". The same surname as you, Ilmeria!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: «Альфред фон Лейнвебер». Та же фамилия, что и у тебя, Ильмерия!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Hold on, Leinweber? How am I only just noticing this?!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Подожди, Лейнвебер? Как я только сейчас это заметил?!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: You don't mean the Leinwebers who are known as one of the three great houses of alchemy?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Вы не имеете в виду Лейнвеберов, которые известны как один из трех великих домов алхимии?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Yes, that's right. I'm his heir.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Да, это так. Я его наследник.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Uwah! Even I've heard of them! I had no idea you were that incredible!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Ува! Даже я слышал о них! Я понятия не имел, что ты такой невероятный!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: A super elite alchemist! Not someone we should just be chatting to like this!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Суперэлитный алхимик! Это не тот, с кем нам следует просто так болтать!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: You dummy, it's fine! There's nothing different about me just because of my famous family.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Ты, дурачок, все в порядке! Во мне нет ничего особенного только из-за моей знаменитой семьи.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: I'm your teacher, and you are my students. That isn't going to change.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Я ваш учитель, а вы мои ученики. Это не изменится.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: So please, do try and keep up with me! I'm going to train you as hard as I can, you'll see!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Так что, пожалуйста, постарайтесь не отставать от меня! Я буду тренировать тебя изо всех сил, вот увидишь!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Ilmeria! We'll follow you, as far as you'll lead us!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Ильмерия! Мы последуем за тобой, насколько ты поведешь нас!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: To the ends of the earth! In the bath or the washroom!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: На край земли! В ванной или туалете!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..original: Y-You don't have to go that far! You need to learn some boundaries, you dummy!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_040..translation: Д-тебе не обязательно заходить так далеко! Тебе нужно усвоить некоторые границы, дурачок!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Hmm, so if that's the case, the next material...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Хм, если это так, то следующий материал...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Uwah, another super difficult looking book! I can't believe you understand this, Ilmeria!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Ух, еще одна суперсложная на вид книга! Не могу поверить, что ты это понимаешь, Ильмерия!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Waaaaaaah!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Ваааааа!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: D-Don't sneak up like that! You surprised me!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Д-Не подкрадывайся так! Вы меня удивили!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: S-Sorry... We did call you when we came in.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: П-извини... Мы позвонили тебе, когда пришли.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: You just didn't react at all! What are you concentrating on so hard?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Ты просто никак не отреагировал! На чем ты так сильно концентрируешься?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Just my studies. I got my hands on a somewhat rare textbook.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Только моя учеба. Мне в руки попал довольно редкий учебник.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Wow, you're studying? Being such a genius, I was sure you never have to study!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Ого, ты учишься? Будучи таким гением, я был уверен, что тебе никогда не придется учиться!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Of course I do! If I'm a genius at anything, it's working hard!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Конечно, я знаю! Если я в чем-то гений, то это упорный труд!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Wow!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Ух ты!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: I know I said just studying isn't enough, but that doesn't mean you can skip studying altogether!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Я знаю, что сказал, что просто учиться недостаточно, но это не значит, что вы можете вообще пропустить учебу!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: In order to not lose to Firis, and to be able to remain your teacher...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Чтобы не проиграть Фирису и остаться твоим учителем...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: And, more than anything, to always be the very best, I have to work hard every single day!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: И, прежде всего, чтобы всегда быть лучшим, мне нужно усердно работать каждый божий день!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: I see. That stoic attitude is one of your greatest strengths, Ilmeria.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Я понимаю. Этот стоический настрой — одна из твоих самых сильных сторон, Ильмерия.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Ah, I'm glad you understand. Perhaps you could take a page out of my book too?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Ах, я рад, что ты понимаешь. Может быть, вы тоже могли бы вырвать страницу из моей книги?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: This, and this. How about this one, too?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Это и это. А как насчет этого?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Hold on, Ilmeria? Why are you piling up all those books?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Подожди, Ильмерия? Зачем ты складываешь все эти книги?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: That's more than would fit in any box I could carry!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Это больше, чем поместилось бы в любой коробке, которую я мог бы нести!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Ah, these books are your next homework. You need to read them all before tomorrow.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Ах, эти книги — твое следующее домашнее задание. Вам нужно прочитать их все до завтра.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Then I'm going to test you on them! Fail and I'll keep you back for more studying!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Тогда я проверю тебя на них! Потерпите неудачу, и я оставлю вас для дальнейшего обучения!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: What?! What are we going to do, Lydie?!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Что?! Что будем делать, Лиди?!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: W-We can't read them, that's for sure! Promises with mom or not!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: М-мы не можем их прочитать, это точно! Обещания с мамой или нет!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: I was thinking the same thing. In that case, there's only one thing left to do! Run!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Я думал о том же. В таком случае остаётся сделать только одно! Бегать!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..original: Hey, girls! Gah, spineless! Both of you!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_050..translation: Эй, девочки! Гах, бесхребетный! Вы оба!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Uwaaaaah?!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Уваааа?!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: W-What's wrong?! Why are you suddenly shouting like that?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ч-что случилось?! Почему ты вдруг так кричишь?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: This! This here! It's cute! So cute!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Этот! Это здесь! Это мило! Как мило!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: You're right! Is this yours, Ilmeria?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ты прав! Это твое, Ильмерия?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Yes. Do you have a problem with that?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Да. У вас есть проблемы с этим?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: No, no problem. I'm just surprised you like cute things.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Нет, нет проблем. Я просто удивлен, что тебе нравятся милые вещи.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: W-What?! I'm not that fond of them, not really!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ч-Что?! Мне они не очень нравятся, нет!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Really? If I take a better look around this atelier, there's actually lots of cute stuff in here...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Действительно? Если я присмотрюсь к этому ателье, то увижу, что здесь действительно много милых вещей...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: T-They were gifts. All of them! I didn't buy them myself.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Т-это были подарки. Все они! Я не покупал их сам.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Hmm? Hehehe... Let's see.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Хм? Хе-хе-хе... Посмотрим.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Hey, Ilmeria... I really like this doll, do you think I could have it?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Эй, Ильмерия... Мне очень нравится эта кукла, как думаешь, она мне подойдет?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Ugh?!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Фу?!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: If you don't actually like cute things, you don't mind if I take it, do you?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Если тебе на самом деле не нравятся милые вещи, ты не против, если я возьму их, не так ли?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Ugh...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Фу...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: It's not a problem, right? Ilmeria! Please!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Это не проблема, верно? Ильмерия! Пожалуйста!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Uwaaaah! N-No! Chirpy is mine, and no one can take him!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Уваааа! Н-нет! Веселый мой, и никто его не сможет забрать!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: C-Chirpy! Hahaha! Ilmeria, did you just say Chirpy?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ч-веселый! Ха-ха-ха! Ильмерия, ты только что сказала «Чирпи»?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: D-Don't laugh! So what if I like cute things?!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Д-Не смейся! Ну и что, что мне нравятся милые вещи?!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: You're the one who denied it! You could have just said so from the beginning...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ты тот, кто это отрицал! Можно было бы так сказать с самого начала...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: No, I mean...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Нет, я имею в виду...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Having a teacher who likes cute things... That's not very cool, is it?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Иметь учителя, который любит милые вещи... Это не очень круто, правда?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Ah! So cute! Sue, I think Ilmeria is the cutest thing in here!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ах! Как мило! Сью, я думаю, что Ильмерия здесь самая милая!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Yeah! I agree. My heart just skipped a beat! Ilmeria, you're so cute!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ага! Я согласен. Мое сердце просто екнуло! Ильмерия, ты такая милая!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: S-Stop that! Don't mock me! Gah, I didn't want you finding out about this!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: П-прекрати это! Не издевайтесь надо мной! Гах, я не хотел, чтобы ты узнал об этом!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Please, will you forgive us? We'll tell you about a place that sells all sorts of cute things...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Пожалуйста, ты простишь нас? Мы расскажем вам о месте, где продаются всякие милые штучки...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Really?! Oh, darn it!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Действительно?! Ох, черт возьми!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Oh! So cute... Ilmeria is so cute!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Ой! Такая милая... Ильмерия такая милая!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..original: Gah, I can't believe this. Getting teased by my own students! I'll remember this, both of you!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_060..translation: Гах, я не могу в это поверить. Меня дразнят мои собственные ученики! Я запомню это вам обоим!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Hmm, what to do... Lydie is one thing, but Sue...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Хм, что делать... Лиди одно, а Сью...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Ilmeria, what's up? Did you just say our names?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ильмерия, как дела? Ты только что назвал наши имена?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Oh, you heard that? I was just thinking about the best way to teach you.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: О, ты это слышал? Я просто думал о том, как лучше всего научить тебя.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Thinking about the best way to help my students grow is a part of my job as your teacher, after all.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: В конце концов, думать о том, как лучше всего помочь моим ученикам расти, — это часть моей работы как вашего учителя.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Uwah! You're so incredible, Ilmeria, I don't know what to say...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ува! Ты такая невероятная, Ильмерия, я даже не знаю, что сказать...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Incredible, you say? Recently I've been thinking, actually, about what kind of teacher I should be.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Невероятно, скажете вы? В последнее время я, собственно, задумался о том, каким учителем мне быть.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: What kind?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Какой?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Well, my teacher was also my father. He was very, very strict.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ну, мой учитель был также моим отцом. Он был очень, очень строгим.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Of course, I improved and matured a lot, thanks to him. But it was also very difficult.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Конечно, благодаря ему я сильно поправился и повзрослел. Но это было также очень сложно.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: So I've been trying to find an approach that differs from the one my father took.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Поэтому я пытался найти подход, отличный от того, который использовал мой отец.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: I see. I hadn't really considered the need to be a "kind" of teacher before.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Я понимаю. Раньше я действительно не задумывался о необходимости быть «своего рода» учителем.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Nor I, until now. What do you both think of me? Do you think I'm doing well as your teacher?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: И я, до сих пор. Что вы оба думаете обо мне? Как ты думаешь, я хорошо справляюсь с ролью твоего учителя?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Together
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Of course!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Конечно!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: System
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Of course!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Конечно!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: T-That was a little too smooth. You don't have to worry about my feelings...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Э-это было слишком гладко. Тебе не стоит беспокоиться о моих чувствах...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: We're not. You're so kind, and always listen to our problems.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Мы нет. Ты такой добрый и всегда выслушиваешь наши проблемы.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: You explain things clearly, and help us with so much. You really are a great teacher!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Вы доходчиво всё объясняете и во многом нам помогаете. Вы действительно отличный учитель!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Girls!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Девушки!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Ah! And more importantly, you're so cute!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ах! И что еще более важно, ты такой милый!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Hahaha! That's right! That's very important!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Это верно! Это очень важно!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: H-Hey! Stop calling me cute! Don't pick on your teacher!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Х-Эй! Перестань называть меня милой! Не придирайтесь к учителю!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Hehehe... You're even cuter when you're pouting!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Хе-хе-хе... Ты даже милее, когда дуешься!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: You might be right, Sue. Hey, this feels more like we're becoming friends, doesn't it?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Возможно, ты права, Сью. Эй, это больше похоже на то, что мы становимся друзьями, не так ли?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: You continue to underestimate me, girls! I'm going to teach you how fearsome I am!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Вы продолжаете меня недооценивать, девочки! Я научу тебя, насколько я страшен!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Both of you, stir that cauldron 1000 times each! 500 lap container marathon! Go, now!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Вы оба перемешайте этот котел по 1000 раз каждый! Контейнерный марафон на 500 кругов! Иди, сейчас же!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: W-What?! That's not fair!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ч-Что?! Это не справедливо!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: I think that's one of your flaws, Ilmeria!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Я думаю, это один из твоих недостатков, Ильмерия!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Silence! Students must listen to their teacher! Come on, move!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Тишина! Ученики должны слушать своего учителя! Давай, двигайся!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..original: Ah, we just got a bit carried away! We'll apologize! Forgive us!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_070..translation: Ах, мы просто немного увлеклись! Мы извинимся! Простите нас!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Hehehe...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Хехехе...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Ilmeria? Did something good happen? You look so happy!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Ильмерия? Произошло ли что-то хорошее? Ты выглядишь таким счастливым!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Yes, actually. I got a letter from my parents. Do you want to take a look?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Да, на самом деле. Я получил письмо от родителей. Хотите посмотреть?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Sue
