ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Yes please! Is it alright? Let's have a look here...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Да, пожалуйста! Все в порядке? Давайте сюда посмотрим...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: "Dearest Ilmeria. Thank you for sending the staff."
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: «Дорогая Ильмерия. Спасибо, что прислали посох».

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: "I'm happy to see that you've improved again. Your mother is very proud too."
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: «Я рад видеть, что тебе снова стало лучше. Твоя мама тоже очень гордится тобой».

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: "As your teacher, as well as your father, I'm happy to see your growth."
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: «Как твой учитель и твой отец, я рад видеть твой рост».

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: "It can't be easy living in another country, but stay happy and do your best!"
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: «Жить в другой стране нелегко, но будьте счастливы и делайте все, что в ваших силах!»

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Hehe, what a lovely letter. I can see why you're so pleased!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Хе-хе, какое чудесное письмо. Я понимаю, почему ты так рад!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: I know! I think recently I've started to understand how my father feels, too.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Я знаю! Думаю, недавно я тоже начал понимать, что чувствует мой отец.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: When he talks about being happy to see his student grow.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Когда он говорит о том, что рад видеть, как растет его ученик.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: After all, I feel the same thing, watching you two grow every day!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: В конце концов, я чувствую то же самое, наблюдая, как вы двое растете каждый день!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Ilmeria!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Ильмерия!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Girls, I want you to continue to work hard, in order to keep making me even happier!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Девочки, я хочу, чтобы вы продолжали усердно работать, чтобы и дальше делать меня еще счастливее!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: I'm not going to let you stay bottom tier alchemists forever, do you understand?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Я не позволю тебе вечно оставаться алхимиками низшего уровня, ты понимаешь?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Hahaha, leave it to us! We'll grow up so much that you won't be able to stop smiling!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Ха-ха-ха, оставь это нам! Мы так вырастем, что ты не сможешь перестать улыбаться!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: That's right! You just keep on watching us!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Это верно! Вы просто продолжайте наблюдать за нами!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Oh, I will. I'm going to watch every little thing that you do, trust me!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: О, я буду. Я буду следить за каждой мелочью, что ты делаешь, поверь мне!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Hahaha! I bet you could do that, too, couldn't you... That's kind of scary!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Могу поспорить, что ты тоже мог бы это сделать, не так ли... Это немного пугает!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..original: Hehe. I am really looking forward to it.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_080..translation: Хе-хе. Я действительно с нетерпением жду этого.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: That's it for today, then. Make sure you revise all of this!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Тогда на сегодня всё. Обязательно пересмотрите все это!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: We will! Thank you!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Мы будем! Спасибо!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Thank you! Uwah, my head is splitting...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Спасибо! Ух, голова раскалывается...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: You're still not one for studying at a desk, are you Sue? Just relax, I'll get you some sugar!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Ты все еще не из тех, кто учится за партой, не так ли, Сью? Расслабься, я принесу тебе немного сахара!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Thank you... Uwah, I could use it!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Спасибо... Ух, мне бы это пригодилось!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Ah, I'm alive again! If you feed me more sweet snacks, I might be able to study a bit more!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Ах, я снова жив! Если вы дадите мне больше сладких закусок, возможно, я смогу учиться немного больше!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Oh, you've done it now! I'm going to bury this room in candy, if that's what it takes!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: О, ты сделал это сейчас! Я собираюсь утопить эту комнату в конфетах, если это то, что нужно!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Uwah! I want to eat them, but I don't want to study! What a bind to be in!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Ува! Я хочу их есть, но не хочу учиться! Какая привязка!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: You're just too honest, Sue! Can't you be a little more serious with your studies?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Ты слишком честна, Сью! Не можешь ли ты отнестись к учебе немного серьезнее?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: I can't hear you! La la la! Tell me, though, isn't there some way to quickly get better at alchemy?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Я не слышу тебя! Ла-ла-ла! Скажите мне, однако, нет ли какого-нибудь способа быстро освоить алхимию?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: I know that studying and practicing are important, but isn't there another way?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Я знаю, что учиться и практиковаться важно, но нет ли другого пути?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: You could choose a rival? Someone to compete against? Like Firis is for me.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Вы могли бы выбрать соперника? Есть с кем соревноваться? Как и Фирис для меня.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: I see. A rival! Our rival would be Lucia, maybe?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Я понимаю. Соперник! Может быть, нашей соперницей будет Люсия?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Yes, that's a good choice. She's a skilled alchemist and she hates to lose.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Да, это хороший выбор. Она опытный алхимик и ненавидит проигрывать.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: But then you sisters are a bit like rivals too, aren't you?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Но вы, сестры, тоже немного похожи на соперниц, не так ли?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Hey, you're right! We started out together, and I definitely don't want to lose, even to my sister!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Эй, ты прав! Мы начинали вместе, и я точно не хочу проигрывать, даже сестре!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Eh? Sue as a rival? Hmm, that doesn't really sound challenging...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Э? Сью как соперница? Хм, это звучит не так уж и сложно...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: What did you just say?! I can't ignore that, even from you!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Что ты только что сказал?! Я не могу игнорировать это, даже от тебя!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Hahaha, I'm sorry, I was just kidding. You're a powerful rival, Sue.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха, извини, я просто пошутил. Ты сильный соперник, Сью.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: The more rivals you have, the better. There's nothing wrong with some friendly competition.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Чем больше у вас будет соперников, тем лучше. Нет ничего плохого в дружеском соревновании.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: No problem. We'll be like you and Firis! Sometimes at each other's throats, sometimes all snuggly!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Без проблем. Мы будем как ты и Фирис! Иногда в глотки друг другу, иногда все прижались!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Hey! We don't get "snuggly"!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Привет! Мы не «прижимаемся»!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: You don't? I've seen you looking pretty...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Вы не делаете? Я видел, как ты выглядишь красиво...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: No, we don't! Never! Gah, you girls just love to mock me, don't you?!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Нет, мы этого не делаем! Никогда! Га, вы, девчонки, просто любите издеваться надо мной, не так ли?!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..original: Wah, this is bad! She's going into Hardcore Master mode again!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..translation: Вау, это плохо! Она снова переходит в режим Hardcore Мастер!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_090..speaker: Sue

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: I know I'm not the best student, but I love being taught by her! Ah, I'm sorry, Ilmeria!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Я знаю, что я не лучший ученик, но мне нравится, когда она меня учит! Ах, прости, Ильмерия!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..original: Sue!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_100..translation: Сью!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: No... I'm not going to lose!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Нет... Я не проиграю!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: S-Sue, are you still reading? It's been over an hour!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: С-Сью, ты все еще читаешь? Прошло больше часа!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: You'll give yourself a fever and collapse, pushing yourself so! Stop it, Sue!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: От такого напряжения ты поднимешь себе температуру и упадешь в обморок! Прекрати, Сью!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Hey, that's just mean. It will take more than an hour to make me collapse!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Эй, это просто подло. Чтобы заставить меня рухнуть, понадобится больше часа!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: I guess it might, but what's brought this on so suddenly?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Я думаю, что да, но что заставило это случиться так внезапно?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: I'm worried about Ilmeria. I'm the reason she's so sad...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Я беспокоюсь за Ильмерию. Я причина, по которой ей так грустно...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: I can't imagine having any other teacher... We are so lucky to have found her...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Я не могу себе представить, чтобы у меня был другой учитель... Нам так повезло, что мы нашли ее...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: So I'm working to be able to withstand longer sessions of studying, but... uwah!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Так что я работаю над тем, чтобы выдержать более длительные занятия, но... ух!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: ...You can't take any more.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: ...Ты не можешь больше терпеть.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Yeah. My brain is about to melt.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Ага. Мой мозг вот-вот расплавится.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Ah. I'm worthless! A worthless student who only causes trouble for her teacher.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Ах. Я бесполезен! Бесполезная ученица, которая только доставляет неприятности своему учителю.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Sue... Right, I've got an idea!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Сью... Точно, у меня есть идея!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: An idea? What for, a recipe?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Идея? Зачем, рецепт?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: No, an operation. An operation to let our teacher know how we feel!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Нет, операция. Операция, позволяющая нашему учителю узнать, что мы чувствуем!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Ilmeria said it before, didn't she? That she is happy to see her students grow.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Ильмерия уже говорила это раньше, не так ли? Что она рада видеть, как растут ее ученики.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: So let's make an incredible item and give it to her! Something to show her how much we've grown!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Так давайте сделаем невероятную вещь и подарим ей! Что-нибудь, чтобы показать ей, насколько мы выросли!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Of course! We're alchemists, after all. Giving her something we've synthesized is the best gift!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Конечно! В конце концов, мы алхимики. Подарить ей то, что мы синтезировали, — лучший подарок!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Well said! Let's think about what we should make, then!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Хорошо сказано! Тогда давайте подумаем, что нам делать!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: We've done it. We've really done it! This isn't going to be easy, either, is it.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Мы сделали это. Мы действительно сделали это! Это тоже будет непросто, не так ли?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: If we're making something for Ilmeria, it has to be cute. This recipe is totally amazing!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Если мы делаем что-то для Ильмерии, это должно быть мило. Этот рецепт просто потрясающий!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Yes! These Cute Philosopher's Stones will surely tell her exactly how we feel!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Да! Эти милые философские камни наверняка расскажут ей, что именно мы чувствуем!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: Come on then, Sue! For the sake of our cute teacher, let's make the cutest thing we can!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Тогда давай, Сью! Ради нашей милой учительницы давайте сделаем самую милую вещь, какую только сможем!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..original: You said it! Just you wait and see, teacher!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_110..translation: Ты сказал это! Просто подождите и увидите, учитель!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Teacher! This is for you!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Учитель! Это вам!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Wow! Incredibly cute Philosopher's Stones!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Ух ты! Невероятно милые Философские Камни!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: They look so different, I presume this is an original recipe? Did you two think this up?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Они такие разные, я полагаю, это оригинальный рецепт? Вы двое это придумали?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Yes! We created it together!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Да! Мы создали его вместе!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: I almost can't believe it! But why? Don't tell me...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Я почти не могу в это поверить! Но почему? Не говорите мне...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Hehehe, I think you've worked it out. We wanted to show you how much we've grown.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Хе-хе-хе, я думаю, ты с этим справился. Мы хотели показать вам, насколько мы выросли.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: I know, I'm a bad student. I don't like studying, I can't sit still for ten seconds...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Я знаю, я плохой ученик. Я не люблю учиться, не могу усидеть на месте и десяти секунд...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: But I love learning alchemy from you! I want you to know that!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Но мне нравится учиться у тебя алхимии! Я хочу, чтобы вы это знали!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Suelle...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Сюэль...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Hehe. Other people have taught us, too, but your lessons just calm me down the most.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Хе-хе. Другие люди тоже нас учили, но ваши уроки меня успокаивают больше всего.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: After all, we've grown so much thanks to all the fundamentals you've drummed into us!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: В конце концов, мы так выросли благодаря всем тем основам, которые вы нам вдалбливали!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Lydie!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Лиди!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: You're the best teacher for us, Ilmeria. You should have more confidence!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Ты для нас лучший учитель, Ильмерия. Вам следует иметь больше уверенности!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: That's right. Be your normal, confident, kind, gentle and cute self! Please!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Это верно. Будьте нормальным, уверенным в себе, добрым, нежным и милым! Пожалуйста!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Please, Ilmeria! Continue to teach us!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Пожалуйста, Ильмерия! Продолжайте нас учить!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Please!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Пожалуйста!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Hold on. Did you think this would make me happy?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Подожди. Ты думал, это сделает меня счастливым?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: W-What? It didn't work?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Ч-Что? Это не сработало?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: B-Because I can't study? Are we going to be kicked out? Are we really going to be kicked out?!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Б-Потому что я не могу учиться? Нас выгонят? Неужели нас действительно выгонят?!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Haha! You dummies. I'm happy. Of course I'm happy! I'm so happy, I want to test you right now!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Хаха! Вы, дураки. Я счастлив. Конечно я рад! Я так рада, хочу проверить тебя прямо сейчас!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Hahahaha! Maybe we can skip that part?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Может, пропустим эту часть?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Hahaha, thank you, both of you. You've blown away all the clouds from my heart.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Ха-ха-ха, спасибо вам обоим. Ты сдул все тучи с моего сердца.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Lydie, Sue... You are the ultimate students.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Лиди, Сью... Вы лучшие ученики.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Teach...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Научите...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..original: Being blessed with such fine students... Ah, how lucky I am!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_120..translation: Иметь таких прекрасных учеников... Ах, как мне повезло!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Hold it! Firis is the best student, and that's a fact!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Держи! Фирис лучшая ученица, и это факт!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: No, that's not right! Escha is definitely a better student than me!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Нет, это не так! Эша определенно учится лучше меня!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: I won't accept that! Lydie and Sue are the best!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Я этого не приму! Лиди и Сью лучшие!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Oh... What's going on here?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Ох... Что здесь происходит?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Ah, well. We were having another teacher and student meeting...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Ах, ну. У нас была очередная встреча учителей и учеников...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: And we got into a fight about which of our students is the most capable...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: И мы поспорили о том, кто из наших учеников самый способный...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Hahaha, I think I see now. But hold on, Firis, you have a student too?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Ха-ха-ха, кажется, теперь я понимаю. Но погоди, Фирис, у тебя тоже есть ученик?

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: She does. Enough of this, though. This kind of battle means nothing at all.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Она так и делает. Впрочем, хватит этого. Такая битва вообще ничего не значит.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: That's right. I know it's odd for us to say this, being involved, but everyone has their own...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Это верно. Я знаю, что нам странно говорить это, будучи вовлеченными, но у каждого свое...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: There's no contest. The best student is Sophie, no doubt about it!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Никакого конкурса. Лучшая ученица – Софи, вне всякого сомнения!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Oh... There comes another bias teacher...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Ох... Приходит ещё один учитель по уклону...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Hey, girls, great timing!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Эй, девчонки, отличное время!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Come on, say something! Tell them that you're the best!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Давай, скажи что-нибудь! Скажи им, что ты лучший!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: What? W-We can't do that! It doesn't matter who's the "best", anyway.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Что? М-мы не можем этого сделать! В любом случае, не имеет значения, кто «лучший».

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Everyone
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Yes it does!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Да, это так!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: System
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Yes it does!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Да, это так!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: System
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Yes it does!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Да, это так!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Uwah!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Ува!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Very well. We aren't going to settle this today. Let's wait a little longer and see what happens.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Очень хорошо. Мы не собираемся решать этот вопрос сегодня. Подождем еще немного и посмотрим, что произойдет.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Good idea. Considering Escha's incredible potential, this should be settled pretty soon!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Хорошая идея. Учитывая невероятный потенциал Эши, этот вопрос должен быть решен довольно скоро!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Don't write yourself off so soon, Firis! You're still growing yourself!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Не списывай себя со счетов так рано, Фирис! Ты все еще растешь!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: And you're one to talk, Sophie! Your talent shows no signs of slowing down!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: И ты одна, чтобы поговорить, Софи! Ваш талант не проявляет никаких признаков замедления!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Let's not get caught up in this, Lydie...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Давай не будем ввязываться в это, Лиди...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Yeah. I can't see this ever being settled.
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Ага. Я не думаю, что этот вопрос когда-либо будет решен.

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Hah! None of you get it, do you? The alchemists with the greatest potential for the future are...
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Ха! Никто из вас этого не понимает, не так ли? Алхимики с наибольшим потенциалом на будущее – это...

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: The two who will become the greatest in the land, taught by a genius alchemist in her own right!
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Двое, которые станут величайшими в стране, которых обучает гениальный алхимик!

ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..original: Lydie and Sue! The only possible choices! Isn't that right, girls?
ebm:qc13_ilm/event_message_qc13_ilm_130..translation: Лиди и Сью! Единственный возможный выбор! Не так ли, девочки?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: Hello, Sue. Will you join me in some grocery shopping?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Привет, Сью. Присоединишься ли ты ко мне в поход за продуктами?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: Of course! Hehe, a great chance to pick up some more snacks, too.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Конечно! Хе-хе, отличный шанс купить еще чего-нибудь перекусить.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: I see. I think I understand, then. This could be called an opportunity.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Я понимаю. Тогда я думаю, что понимаю. Это можно назвать возможностью.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: Hey. Those are some unusual clothes...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: You're right. I wonder where she's from?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: А что насчет того другого дела?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Peddler
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: Ah! Well, I'm sorry to report, but we're having some issues with selecting a location...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Ах! Извините, что сообщаю, но у нас возникли некоторые проблемы с выбором места...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: I see. Will you please get it done as quickly as you can?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Я понимаю. Не могли бы вы сделать это как можно быстрее?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: For our future plans, the acquisition of the land is a most important starting step.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Для наших планов на будущее приобретение земли является наиболее важным стартовым шагом.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: Boss? I guess that means she's someone important.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Босс? Я думаю, это означает, что она кто-то важный.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: I've got it! All that talk of plans... She's a boss of some secret organization!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Я понял! Все эти разговоры о планах... Она босс какой-то секретной организации!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..original: Hahaha... You've been reading too many comics again, Sue...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Ты снова прочитала слишком много комиксов, Сью...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Phew. Finally, everything is ready.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Уф. Наконец, все готово.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Sue, look. It's that woman we saw!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Сью, посмотри. Это та женщина, которую мы видели!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Wow, you're right. The boss of a secret organization!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Вау, ты прав. Босс секретной организации!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Excuse me, sorry, but I've no recollection of starting any secret organizations.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Простите, извините, но я не припоминаю, чтобы создавал какие-либо секретные организации.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Uwah, you heard that? Sorry! Come on, Sue, you apologize too!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Увау, ты это слышал? Извини! Да ладно, Сью, ты тоже извинись!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Ah, sorry. I just remember someone calling you "boss" and, you know...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Ах, извини. Я просто помню, как кто-то назвал тебя "боссом", и, знаешь...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: I see. I need to tell my subordinates to be more careful with what they call me.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Я понимаю. Мне нужно сказать своим подчиненным, чтобы они были более осторожны с тем, как они меня называют.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Ah, sorry. I'm Corneria. Boss - that is, head - of the Corneria Enterprise.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Ах, извини. Я Корнерия. Босс - то есть руководитель - Компании Корнерии.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Corneria? We're...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Корнерия? Были...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Lydie and Sue, I take it?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Лиди и Сью, я так понимаю?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Suelle is my name. Everyone just calls me Sue.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Сюэль — моё имя. Все зовут меня просто Сью.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Hahaha, yeah, Lydie and Sue it is. Nice to meet you.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Ха-ха-ха, да, это Лиди и Сью. Рад встрече.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: One thing, Miss Corneria... Just what is it that your Enterprise does?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Еще одно, мисс Корнерия... Чем занимается ваша компания?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: The way you say that, I have to say, it takes me back!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: То, как ты это говоришь, должен сказать, возвращает меня назад!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: The Corneria Enterprise is the name of my shop. It's actually quite famous, in other lands.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: «Компания Корнерии» — это название моего магазина. На самом деле он довольно известен в других странах.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: So I'm here doing some market research in order to expand into Adalet.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Итак, я провожу исследование, чтобы выйти на рынок Адалета.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Wow... I thought the boss just sat at a desk and looked at documents!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Ого... Я думал, начальник просто сидит за столом и смотрит документы!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Hey, Sue! I'm sorry for my sister, she really is...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Привет, Сью! Мне жаль мою сестру, она правда...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: No, it's fine. In fact, most of the time, that's precisely what happens.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Нет, все в порядке. На самом деле, в большинстве случаев именно это и происходит.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: However, a move to a new market is best to be seen through by yourself.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Однако переход на новый рынок лучше всего продумывать самостоятельно.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: I'm just about to open a street stall to check the market for myself!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Я как раз собираюсь открыть уличный ларек, чтобы лично проверить рынок!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Ah, that makes sense. In which case, will you show us what you are selling?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Ах, это имеет смысл. В таком случае вы покажете нам, что продаете?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..original: Yes, of course. I've got plenty of confidence in my lineup, I can tell you that!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_020..translation: Да, конечно. Я очень уверен в своем составе, могу вам это сказать!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..original: Uwah! Your shop is packed with some of the best items I've seen!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..translation: Ува! В вашем магазине полно лучших товаров, которые я когда-либо видел!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..original: Tell me about it. We could do some real fine synthesizing with some of those goodies!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..translation: Расскажи мне об этом. Мы могли бы сделать отличный синтез с некоторыми из этих вкусностей!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..original: Synthesizing? Could it be that you are both alchemists?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..translation: Синтезирующий? Может быть, вы оба алхимики?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..original: That's right. I guess you could tell that from hearing "synthesizing."
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..translation: Это верно. Я думаю, вы могли бы сказать это, услышав слово «синтез».

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..original: But of course. I see, so you're alchemists?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..translation: Но конечно. Понятно, так вы алхимики?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..original: This might be a good business opportunity! Hehehe!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..translation: Это может быть хорошей возможностью для бизнеса! Хе-хе-хе!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..original: I'm sure she just gave me a really creepy smile. No, I'm just imagining things, right?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_030..translation: Я уверен, что она только что одарила меня жуткой улыбкой. Нет, я просто воображаю, да?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: Corneria, do you have a problem? Maybe we can help you!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Корнерия, у тебя проблемы? Возможно, мы сможем вам помочь!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: We solve problems for everyone in the city! At least, that's what we tell ourselves.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Решаем проблемы каждого жителя города! По крайней мере, так мы говорим себе.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: Hehe, is that so? In which case, let me try out your services.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Хе-хе, это так? В таком случае позвольте мне опробовать ваши услуги.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: I want to bring in new products from my hometown, but it's a bit too far away.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Я хочу привезти новинки из моего родного города, но он слишком далеко.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: Watches and autographs are one thing, but cakes and vegetables won't last the trip.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Часы и автографы – это одно, а тортов и овощей в поездке не хватит.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: I see. I wonder if we could do something with alchemy? Like, a portable ice room?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Я понимаю. Интересно, сможем ли мы сделать что-нибудь с помощью алхимии? Типа, портативная ледяная комната?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: Oh, good idea. That would stop things from spoiling!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: О, хорошая идея. Это предотвратит порчу вещей!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: Yes. That sounds like quite a good idea. Can I hire you to make that?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Да. Это звучит как неплохая идея. Могу ли я нанять вас, чтобы это сделать?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: Yes, leave it to us! We'll make it so you can bring in all the delicious cakes!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Да, оставьте это нам! Мы сделаем так, чтобы вы могли принести с собой все вкусные пирожные!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..original: Ah, well, this is about more than cakes... no matter. I'll just wait and see what you manage.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_040..translation: Ах, ну, это не только торты... неважно. Я просто подожду и посмотрю, что у тебя получится.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Oh, it's cold! I could even carry raw meat around using this!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Ой, холодно! Я мог бы даже носить с собой сырое мясо!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: That's great! Now we'll get all the cakes!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Замечательно! Теперь мы достанем все лепешки!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Hehe, I do have to thank you somehow, don't I? What would be a fitting reward?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Хе-хе, мне ведь нужно как-то тебя отблагодарить, не так ли? Какая награда будет достойной?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Y-You don't have to do anything special, please. We don't need anything...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Д-тебе не нужно делать ничего особенного, пожалуйста. Нам ничего не нужно...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Trust is an important part of my business. I need to thank you somehow...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Доверие — важная часть моего бизнеса. Мне нужно как-то отблагодарить тебя...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Ah, I know what to do! I'll start my volume retail service!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Ах, я знаю, что делать! Я начну оказывать оптовую розничную торговлю!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Volume retail? What's that?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Объем розничной торговли? Что это такое?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Here's the thing. I have a unique ability. Sue, will you lend me an item for a moment?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Вот в чем дело. У меня есть уникальная способность. Сью, одолжишь мне на минутку какую-нибудь вещь?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Sure. Here, what about this?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Конечно. Вот, а что насчет этого?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Thank you. Haaaha, teyaaah! There, what do you think?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Спасибо. Хаааа, теяаа! Вот, что ты думаешь?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: What! It multiplied? Are you some kind of magician?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Что! Оно размножилось? Ты какой-то волшебник?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: No, this is my power. I have the ability to copy objects.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Нет, это моя сила. У меня есть возможность копировать объекты.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Copy objects? I can't believe it. How is such a thing even possible?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Копировать объекты? Я не могу в это поверить. Как такое вообще возможно?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: It's a very rare power, apparently. It's made me very popular.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Судя по всему, это очень редкая сила. Это сделало меня очень популярным.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: I bet! Being able to copy items out of thin air like that? That's almost too convenient!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Бьюсь об заклад! Уметь копировать предметы из воздуха таким образом? Это почти слишком удобно!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Very well, Corneria. Can we ask you to provide us with that volume retail, too?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Очень хорошо, Корнерия. Можем ли мы попросить вас предоставить нам и такой объем розничной торговли?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Yes, of course. I'll give your requests priority, so feel free to pile them on me! No problem!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Да, конечно. Я отдам вашим запросам приоритет, так что смело перекладывайте их на меня! Без проблем!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: System
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: <CLEG>[Tutorial] ~Volume Retail~<CLNR>
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: <CLEG>[Учебное пособие] ~Оптовая розничная торговля~<CLNR>

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: System
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: At Corneria's shop, you can have her increase the count of your items.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: В магазине Корнерии вы можете попросить ее увеличить количество ваших предметов.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: System
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: This is done by copying items you already have. Their quality and properties will be identical.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Это делается путем копирования уже имеющихся у вас элементов. Их качество и свойства будут идентичными.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: System
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: Register the item you want and after a short while it will appear on the shelves.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: Зарегистрируйте нужный товар и через некоторое время он появится на прилавках.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..speaker: System
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..original: <CLR1>Using this service may prove a shortcut to becoming a truly great alchemist. Maybe!<CLNR>
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_050..translation: <CLR1>Использование этой услуги может оказаться кратчайшим путем к тому, чтобы стать по-настоящему великим алхимиком. Возможно!<CLNR>

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: Hello, Corneria. Business seems to be booming!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: Hehehe! Is this because you've been bringing in those new products?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Хе-хе-хе! Это потому, что вы вводите эти новые продукты?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: Yes. They're a big part of it. But my volume retail service is proving even more popular.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Да. Они — большая часть этого. Но мои оптовые розничные услуги становятся еще более популярными.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: I've limited the amount allowed to be copied each day, but I'm still packed with customers!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Я ограничил количество копий, которое можно копировать каждый день, но у меня по-прежнему полно клиентов!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: You've had to place a limit? I guess you can't be too convenient.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Вам приходилось устанавливать лимит? Я думаю, ты не можешь быть слишком удобным.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: No, it's a question of my basic nature. If I copy too many things, well, it won't be pretty...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Нет, это вопрос моей основной природы. Если я скопирую слишком много вещей, это будет некрасиво...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: Not pretty? What do you mean?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Некрасиво? Что ты имеешь в виду?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: Hehe, that's still a secret. Keep on shopping here and eventually I'll tell you.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Хе-хе, это пока секрет. Продолжайте делать покупки здесь, и в конце концов я вам расскажу.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: Gah, trying to run away? One thing, though, Corneria. Just don't push yourself too hard, alright?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Га, пытаешься убежать? Но кое-что, Корнерия. Только не напрягай себя слишком сильно, ладно?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: That's right. If you collapse from overwork then this will be all for nothing, after all!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Это верно. Если ты упадешь от переутомления, то ведь все это будет напрасно!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: Yes, I will be careful. This Ranking System, though, is a big business opportunity!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Да, я буду осторожен. Однако эта Система рангов ателье представляет собой большую возможность для бизнеса!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..original: I need to work hard, in order to make my enterprise even bigger!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_060..translation: Мне нужно много работать, чтобы мое предприятие стало еще больше!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: I can't find the shop they were talking about. Gah, where is it?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Я не могу найти магазин, о котором они говорили. Га, где это?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: S-Sorry? What made you shout like that?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: П-Извините? Что заставило тебя так кричать?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Can I ask you one thing? Have you ever been a doll?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Могу я спросить вас об одной вещи? Вы когда-нибудь были куклой?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Ah, sorry if that's weird! I just saw a doll that looked exactly like you, once...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Ах, извините, если это странно! Я только что однажды видел куклу, которая выглядела точно так же, как ты...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Hehe, that's a surprise for me too. A doll made to look like me? By who?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Хе-хе, для меня это тоже сюрприз. Кукла, похожая на меня? Кем?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Although I have a pretty good idea. Fritz... I'm going to invoice you for this!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Хотя у меня есть довольно хорошая идея. Фриц... Я выставлю тебе за это счет!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Ugh? I don't think it was Dad. And how do you know my dad, anyway?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Фу? Я не думаю, что это был папа. И вообще, откуда ты знаешь моего отца?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Yep, that's right! I'm Drossel! Nice to meet you!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Да, это так! Я Дроссель! Рад встрече!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Ah, I'm Corneria. I see, Fritz's daughter...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Ах, я Корнерия. Понятно, дочь Фрица...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: What are you doing here, anyway, Drossel? You've been wandering up and down for a while.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Что ты здесь вообще делаешь, Дроссель? Вы какое-то время блуждали взад и вперед.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Ah, of course. I'm looking for a shop called the Corneria Enterprise.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Ах, конечно. Я ищу магазин под названием «Компания Корнерии».

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Hold on, the shop is called Corneria... And your name is Corneria? Which means!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Подожди, магазин называется Корнерия... А тебя зовут Корнерия? Это значит!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Yes. The Corneria Enterprise is my store.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: Yes! I heard you sell lots of wonderful things, so I had to come and check it out!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Да! Я слышал, что вы продаете много замечательных вещей, поэтому мне пришлось зайти и проверить!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: I see. Then please, feel free to take a look around.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Я понимаю. Тогда, пожалуйста, не стесняйтесь осмотреться вокруг.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..original: I'll give you a discount, too, since you're Fritz's daughter.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_070..translation: Я тебе тоже сделаю скидку, так как ты дочь Фрица.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: A music box? What a lovely sound.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: Ah, welcome. Tell me, girls. Have you ever heard this music before?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Ах, добро пожаловать. Подскажите, девочки. Вы когда-нибудь слышали эту музыку раньше?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: No, I don't think so. Sue?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Нет, я так не думаю. Сью?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: Me neither. Is there some kind of secret to that music box?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: И я нет. Есть ли какой-то секрет в этой музыкальной шкатулке?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: Like, the music from it opens the door to a secret treasure?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Мол, музыка из него открывает дверь в тайное сокровище?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: No. This music is a clue to the location of my father. The father I've never met.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Нет. Эта музыка — ключ к разгадке местонахождения моего отца. Отец, которого я никогда не встречал.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: No. He left before I was born, so I don't even know what he looks like.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Нет. Он ушел еще до моего рождения, поэтому я даже не знаю, как он выглядит.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: I've finally discovered that he's in this region, but that's all the information I have.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Я наконец обнаружил, что он находится в этом регионе, но это вся информация, которой я располагаю.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: I see. In which case, Corneria, will you please tell us more about him?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Я понимаю. В таком случае, Корнерия, не могли бы вы рассказать нам о нем побольше?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: We've been living here for all our lives. Maybe we can help you!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Мы живем здесь всю жизнь. Возможно, мы сможем вам помочь!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: Girls... Thank you so much. Let me see...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Девочки... Спасибо вам огромное. Дайте-ка подумать...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: Someone dressed in the same kind of clothing as you, and with the same copy power...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Кто-то, одетый в такую же одежду, как и вы, и с такой же копировальной силой...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: Hmm. I'm pretty sure I'd remember someone like that.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Хм. Я почти уверен, что запомню такого человека.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: Sorry, Corneria. It turns out we can't help you after all.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Прости, Корнерия. Оказывается, мы все-таки не можем вам помочь.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: No, it's all right. I've been actively searching for him for more than ten years, after all.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Нет, все в порядке. Ведь я его активно искал уже больше десяти лет.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..original: But I'm not ready to give up yet.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_080..translation: Но я пока не готов сдаваться.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: Corneria, are you alright? You look completely exhausted!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Корнерия, ты в порядке? Ты выглядишь совершенно измотанным!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: Ah, I'm sorry... I should never let my customers see such weakness...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Ах, извини... Я никогда не должен позволять своим клиентам видеть такую слабость...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: I've been using my copying power too much recently. The two of you warned me about it, I know...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: В последнее время я слишком много использую свои копировальные способности. Вы двое предупреждали меня об этом, я знаю...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: You can barely stand! You need to rest!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Ты едва можешь стоять! Вам нужно отдохнуть!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: No. As a merchant, once the doors are open I can't close them until closing time...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Нет. Как торговец, если двери открыты, я не могу закрыть их до закрытия...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: You take all this too seriously! Very well. At least let us get something for you.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Ты относишься ко всему этому слишком серьезно! Очень хорошо. По крайней мере, позвольте нам получить что-нибудь для вас.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: Ah, good idea! What do you want? We'll bring you whatever you need!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Ах, хорошая идея! Что ты хочешь? Мы привезем вам все, что вам нужно!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: In which case, I'd like to drink some milk.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: В таком случае, я бы хотел выпить немного молока.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: What? Milk? Like, from a cow?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: Are you sure that's all you want? Are you sure you're not taking it easy on us?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Ты уверен, что это все, что тебе нужно? Ты уверен, что не относишься к нам легко?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: No, I'm not. I love milk, more than anything else.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: Нет, я не такой. Я люблю молоко больше всего на свете.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..original: In which case, it would be our pleasure. We'll bring you the most energizing milk ever!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_090..translation: В этом случае мы будем рады. Мы подарим вам самое бодрящее молоко!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Here you go, Corneria! Here's the milk you ordered, moooo!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Вот, Корнерия! Вот молоко, которое ты заказал, мууу!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Ah, that does look delicious! Let me get some of that right away!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Ах, это выглядит очень вкусно! Позвольте мне получить часть этого прямо сейчас!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Glug, glug, glug! Uwah!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Глюк, глюк, глюк! Ува!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Phew, I'm alive again! Thank you so much. I was about to shrink away to nothing!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Уф, я снова жив! Большое спасибо. Я собирался сжаться в никуда!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Hahaha, is that the first time I've heard you make a joke? Is work going to make you shrink?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я впервые слышу, как ты шутишь? Работа заставит вас сжаться?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: No. I'm not joking, unfortunately. That's the truth.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Нет. Я не шучу, к сожалению. Это правда.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Excuse me?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Прошу прощения?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: There's a cost of my power. Each item I copy makes me shrink a little.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Это цена моей силы. Каждый объект, который я копирую, заставляет меня немного съеживаться.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: If I rest a little then it returns to normal, but if I'm not careful I'll stay tiny forever!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Если я немного отдохну, то все придет в норму, но если я не буду осторожен, я навсегда останусь крошечным!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: What?! That's terrible!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Что?! Это ужасно!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: If you copy too much stuff, you'll be able to hide in the palm of my hand?!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Если ты скопируешь слишком много вещей, ты сможешь спрятаться у меня на ладони?!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: That might be cute, actually...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: На самом деле это может быть мило...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Sue, don't start that now. If that's the case, you should stop using that power, right away!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Сью, не начинай это сейчас. Если это так, вам следует немедленно прекратить использовать эту силу!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: No. I can't do that. It is one of the main services I offer.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Нет, я не могу этого сделать. Это одна из основных услуг, которые я предлагаю.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: But the cost is too great!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Но цена слишком велика!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: It's fine. If I can meet my father again, it's fine...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Все в порядке. Если я смогу снова встретиться со своим отцом, это будет хорошо...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Oh...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Ой...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Running this shop, I might meet someone who knows my father.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Управляя этим магазином, я могу встретить кого-нибудь, кто знает моего отца.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: If the shop becomes large and famous, my name may reach my father's ears.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Если магазин станет большим и известным, мое имя может достичь ушей моего отца.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: So long as I have this shop, one day I'll be able to meet him. That's what I believe.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Пока у меня есть этот магазин, однажды я смогу с ним встретиться. Вот во что я верю.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: So no matter how small it makes me, I'm not about to stop copying items...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Поэтому, каким бы маленьким я ни был, я не собираюсь прекращать копировать предметы...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: We can't get involved in this, Lydie. You understand how Corneria feels, right?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Мы не можем в это вмешиваться, Лиди. Ты же понимаешь, что чувствует Корнерия, да?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Yes. I'm sorry, Corneria. I said too much.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Да. Мне очень жаль, Корнерия. Я сказал слишком много.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Hehe, you're very kind, Lydie. If you are worried about me, there's one thing you can do.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Хе-хе, ты очень добра, Лиди. Если ты беспокоишься обо мне, ты можешь сделать одну вещь.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Keep buying stuff from this shop! That's what will make me the happiest.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Продолжайте покупать вещи в этом магазине! Это то, что сделает меня самым счастливым.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: Hahah! I see what you did there! So we just have to buy lots and lots of stuff, right?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Ха-ха! Я вижу, что ты там сделал! Значит, нам просто нужно покупать много-много вещей, верно?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..original: It looks like it. I walked right into that one! Come on then, Corneria, what have you got?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_100..translation: Похоже на это. Я вошел прямо в него! Да ладно, Корнерия, что у тебя есть?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Eh! Sophie, is that you?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Эх! Софи, это ты?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: What! Corneria?! Wow, it's been ages! How have you been?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Что! Корнерия?! Ух ты, прошло много времени! Как твои дела?
