ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Well, I haven't done much growing, but I'm fine. How are you doing, Sophie?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Ну, я не сильно выросла, но со мной все в порядке. Как твои дела, Софи?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Hahaha, I'm fine. Plachta too, of course!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я в порядке. Плачта тоже, конечно!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: You sound so polite, Corneria! Have you grown up a little?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Ты говоришь так вежливо, Корнерия! Ты немного подрос?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Yes, I'm trying to be a bit more respectable. The old accent comes out every now and then, however!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Да, я пытаюсь быть немного более респектабельным. Однако старый акцент время от времени проявляется!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Hello, Sophie. Are you doing some shopping at Corneria's store?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Здравствуйте, Софи. Вы делаете покупки в магазине Корнерии?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Hehehe, renewing old friendships, actually! Corneria and I have been friends for a long time!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Хе-хе-хе, вообще-то возобновляем старую дружбу! Мы с Корнерией дружим уже давно!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: We come from the same town. We've even adventured together.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Мы родом из одного города. Мы даже путешествовали вместе.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Wow, that's unexpected! The world is a smaller place than I thought!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Ух ты, это неожиданно! Мир меньше, чем я думал!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Hehe, I guess you could say that. I'm happy to see Corneria again.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Хе-хе, я думаю, ты мог бы так сказать. Я рад снова увидеть Корнерию.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Say, Corneria. Have you found your father yet?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Скажем, Корнерия. Ты уже нашел своего отца?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: No, not yet... But my shop is still getting bigger.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Нет, еще нет... Но мой магазин продолжает расти.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Yeah, the Corneria Enterprise! I know all about it! You've been working so hard, haven't you?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Да, Компания Корнерии! Я знаю об этом все! Ты так много работал, не так ли?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Not that hard, haha! What about you, Sophie? You became a certified alchemist?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Не так уж и сложно, хаха! А что насчет тебя, Софи? Вы стали сертифицированным алхимиком?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Yep, I totally did! I'm totally certified, from head to toe!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Да, я полностью это сделал! Я полностью сертифицирован с головы до ног!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: I see! Monika, Elise and a few of our friends were complaining about you never even visiting back home.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Я понимаю! Моника, Элиза и несколько наших друзей жаловались, что ты даже не приходил домой.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Monika even said she was going to head out herself and drag you back.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Моника даже сказала, что собирается уйти сама и притащить тебя обратно.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Uwah, I don't like the sound of that! It has been a while since I visited Kirchen Bell, though...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Увау, мне не нравится это звучание! Однако прошло много времени с тех пор, как я посещал Кирхен-Белл...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: We've got so much to talk about. How about going for a drink?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Нам есть о чем поговорить. Как насчет того, чтобы пойти выпить?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Yes, I'd like that very much. I'm quite a hard drinker, though, so watch out!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Да, мне бы этого очень хотелось. Однако я очень сильно пью, так что будьте осторожны!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Hahaha, sounds like it's on now! See you later!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Ха-ха-ха, похоже, оно уже включено! Увидимся позже!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Corneria, you looked very happy!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Корнерия, ты выглядела очень счастливой!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Of course. The reason I can have this shop is because of Sophie!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Конечно. Причина, по которой я могу иметь этот магазин, — это Софи!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: She hasn't changed at all, still so incredible! I wish I had half her conviction.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Она совсем не изменилась, все еще такая невероятная! Мне бы хотелось иметь хотя бы половину ее убеждений.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..original: Hehe, I know! I want to be just like her, too.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_110..translation: Хе-хе, я знаю! Я тоже хочу быть такой же, как она.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..original: Corneria is listening to that music box again. Do you think she's thinking about her dad?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..translation: Корнерия снова слушает музыкальную шкатулку. Думаешь, она думает о своем отце?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..original: Probably. I can't believe she's never even seen his face! That's just so sad.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..translation: Вероятно. Не могу поверить, что она даже никогда не видела его лица! Это так грустно.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..original: I know. I've got an idea, then! Let's really help her in the search for her dad!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..translation: Я знаю. Тогда у меня есть идея! Давайте действительно поможем ей в поисках папы!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..original: We know a lot about this region, after all. Let's ask around and collect some more information!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..translation: В конце концов, мы много знаем об этом регионе. Давайте поспрашиваем и соберем еще немного информации!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..original: Yeah! For Corneria, let's do our best! Come on!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..translation: Ага! Давайте сделаем все возможное для Корнерии! Ну давай же!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..original: Huh? Lydie and Sue? I wonder what they are up to?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_120..translation: Хм? Лиди и Сью? Интересно, что они задумали?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..original: Hey, Mathias... There's a person we'd like to find.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..translation: Эй, Матиас... Нам бы хотелось найти человека.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..original: A man in strange clothes, who can multiply objects? I've never heard of such a person...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..translation: Человек в странной одежде, умеющий умножать предметы? Я никогда не слышал о таком человеке...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..original: That's a shame... I thought you'd have heard some rumors for sure, Mathias.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..translation: Обидно... Я думал, что ты наверняка слышал какие-то слухи, Матиас.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..original: Hmm, okay. I'll ask around. Just don't expect too much!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..translation: Хм, окей. Я поспрошу. Просто не ожидайте слишком многого!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..original: There should be at least rumors about someone who stands out that much, but I've never heard a thing.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..translation: Должны быть по крайней мере слухи о ком-то, кто так сильно выделяется, но я никогда ничего не слышал.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..original: Yes, good point. Thank you, anyway.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_130..translation: Да, хороший момент. В любом случае, спасибо.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..original: Pamela? There's someone who we're looking for...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..translation: Памела? Есть тот, кого мы ищем...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..original: Someone who can copy items and wears strange clothing? Yes, I know who that is!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..translation: Кто-то, кто умеет копировать предметы и носит странную одежду? Да, я знаю, кто это!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..original: Hehehe. Her name is Corneria. We used to live in the same town, actually!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..translation: Хе-хе-хе. Ее зовут Корнерия. Вообще-то мы жили в одном городе!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..original: I should have explained that better. We're actually looking for Corneria's dad.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..translation: Я должен был объяснить это лучше. На самом деле мы ищем отца Корнерии.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..original: Oh, is that so? I'm sorry, I don't know anything about her dad...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..translation: О, это так? Извините, я ничего не знаю о ее отце...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..original: I see. Alright, thank you. We'll try someone else.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_140..translation: Я понимаю. Хорошо, спасибо. Мы попробуем кого-нибудь другого.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..original: Mr. Fritz, excuse us, but we've got something to ask...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..translation: Господин Фриц, извините, но нам есть что спросить...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..original: Oh? You're already aware of the issue?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..translation: Ой? Вы уже знаете о проблеме?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..original: We're old friends. We searched for clues while we were traveling together, but...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..translation: Мы старые друзья. Мы искали улики, пока путешествовали вместе, но...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..original: We didn't find any information on her father, I'm afraid.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..translation: Боюсь, мы не нашли никакой информации о ее отце.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..original: I see. Thanks for your time!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_150..translation: Я понимаю. Спасибо за ваше время!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..original: Huh. So we didn't learn anything about Corneria's dad.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..translation: Хм. Так что мы ничего не узнали об отце Корнерии.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..original: Yeah. It would've been really great to take some proper information back to her.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..translation: Ага. Было бы здорово вернуть ей нужную информацию.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..original: I guess it can't be helped... Let's at least tell her that we're willing to help.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..translation: Думаю, ничего не поделаешь... Давай хотя бы скажем ей, что мы готовы помочь.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..original: Yeah, good idea. I'm sorry, Corneria.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_160..translation: Да, хорошая идея. Мне очень жаль, Корнерия.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Corneria... Uhm...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Корнерия... Хм...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Corneria! Have you got any bargains for me? Oh, hold on! I've heard this music before!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Корнерия! У вас есть какие-нибудь выгодные предложения для меня? Ой, держись! Я уже слышал эту музыку!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: What? The music from this box?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Что? Музыка из этой коробки?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Yeah, I think so.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Да, я так думаю.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Where?! Where did you hear it?!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Где?! Где ты это услышал?!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: A village I visited on a walk... It was to the east of here, if I remember correctly!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Деревня, которую я посетил на прогулке... Это было к востоку отсюда, если я правильно помню!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: There's only sea to the east!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: На востоке только море!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: What, is there? Then south, maybe? Or north-north-west?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Что, есть? Тогда на юг, может быть? Или северо-северо-запад?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Oh my! We won't get any help from Drossel's terrible sense of direction.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: О боже! Нам не поможет ужасное чувство направления Дроссель.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Hey, don't blame me. What's with the music box, anyway?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Эй, не вини меня. А что там с музыкальной шкатулкой?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: You see...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Понимаете...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Oh... I should have tried harder to remember the location!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Ох... Мне следовало бы постараться запомнить это место!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: There were loads of people there dressed just like Corneria!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Там было полно людей, одетых точно так же, как Корнерия!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: That sounds like exactly the place we want! Gah, I can't take this heartbreak!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Похоже, это именно то место, которое нам нужно! Гах, я не могу вынести этого горя!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: It's all right... If you can't remember, you can't remember. I'll just keep on running the shop...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Все в порядке... Если ты не можешь вспомнить, ты не можешь вспомнить. Я просто продолжу управлять магазином...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: No, hold on. Do you think you can trust me, Corneria?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Нет, подожди. Думаешь, ты можешь доверять мне, Корнерия?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Why do you ask?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Почему ты спрашиваешь?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: I'm going to go back to that place again!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Я собираюсь вернуться в это место снова!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Hold on! Are you sure that's a good idea, Drossel?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Подожди! Ты уверен, что это хорошая идея, Дроссель?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Sure it is. I have a terrible sense of direction, but I'll get there in the end, I promise!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Конечно, это так. У меня ужасное чувство направления, но в конце концов я доберусь до цели, обещаю!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: You want to see your father, right, Corneria? That's what all your hard work has been for?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Ты хочешь увидеть своего отца, да, Корнерия? Вот ради чего была вся твоя тяжелая работа?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Well, yes...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Ну да...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Family is important, and that's a fact. If I'm the only one who's been there, I have to go!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Семья важна, и это факт. Если я единственный, кто был там, мне пора идти!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Leave this to me!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Оставьте это мне!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Very well. I want you to take this with you, then.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Очень хорошо. Тогда я хочу, чтобы ты взял это с собой.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: A flyer?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Листовка?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Yes. For my store. Please give it to the people in that village.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Да. Для моего магазина. Пожалуйста, отдайте его жителям этой деревни.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: My name was picked by my dad. So, if he is there in that village...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Имя мне выбрал мой отец. Итак, если он там, в той деревне...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: He should recognize my name. Just give him that, that's all you need to do.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Он должен узнать мое имя. Просто дайте ему это, это все, что вам нужно сделать.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: That's it? I could tell him to come?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Вот и все? Я мог бы сказать ему, чтобы он пришел?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: No. I have my pride as a merchant. Please just promote my store, that's all.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Нет. Я горжусь тем, что я торговец. Пожалуйста, просто рекламируйте мой магазин, вот и все.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Hahah, promote! I like that. Alright, you can count on me!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Ха-ха, продвигайте! Мне нравится, что. Хорошо, ты можешь рассчитывать на меня!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: She ran off in the opposite direction of the main gates, didn't she...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Она убежала в противоположном направлении от главных ворот, не так ли...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: Hahaha... It's okay. Drossel said to trust her, so that's all we can do...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Все в порядке. Дроссель сказал доверять ей, и это все, что мы можем сделать...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..original: You're right. I'll put my trust in you, then, Drossel!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_170..translation: Ты прав. Тогда я доверяюсь тебе, Дроссель!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Corneria... Drossel hasn't come back yet, has she?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Корнерия... Дроссель еще не вернулась, да?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: No. But I will keep on waiting...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Нет. Но я буду продолжать ждать...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Wah, I almost ran past the place! That was close!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Вау, я чуть не пробежал мимо этого места! Это было близко!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Drossel! Welcome back. So?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Дроссель! Добро пожаловать. Так?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Hahah! The promotion was a big success! It just took a bit longer than I expected.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Ха-ха! Акция имела большой успех! Просто это заняло немного больше времени, чем я ожидал.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: T-Thank you so much! And my father?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Т-Спасибо большое! А мой отец?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Hehe! There was this one person who reacted to the name at once, and even cried.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Хе-хе! Был один человек, который сразу отреагировал на это имя и даже заплакал.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: I'm pretty sure that was your father, Corneria.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Я почти уверен, что это был твой отец, Корнерия.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Really?!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Действительно?!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: That settles it, doesn't it?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Это решает проблему, не так ли?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Yes. We can only wait now and see if my father comes...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Да. Нам остается только подождать и посмотреть, придет ли мой отец...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Hahaha... It feels like we haven't done anything useful...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Такое ощущение, что мы не сделали ничего полезного...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: No, that's not true.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Нет, это неправда.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: You told me about Corneria's shop in the first place.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Прежде всего, ты рассказал мне о магазине Корнерии.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Without your promotion, none of this would have happened!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Без вашего продвижения ничего бы этого не произошло!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: What do you say, Corneria? How about making these two your promotion agents?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Что скажешь, Корнерия? Как насчет того, чтобы сделать этих двоих своими рекламными агентами?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Promotion agents? That sounds like a good idea. I think they may be perfectly suited.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Агенты по продвижению? Это звучит как хорошая идея. Я думаю, они могут идеально подойти.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: I don't mind! With my charm and my voice, I'll bring in more customers than you can handle!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Я не против! Благодаря моему обаянию и голосу я привлечу больше клиентов, чем вы сможете обслужить!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Hahaha, me too. If you'll let us do what we can between our other work, we'll help however we can!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я тоже. Если вы позволите нам делать то, что мы можем, в перерывах между нашей другой работой, мы поможем, чем сможем!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Very well. I'll need to find something to reward you with, won't I?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Очень хорошо. Мне нужно найти что-нибудь, чтобы вознаградить тебя, не так ли?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Lydie, Sue, and you, Drossel. Thank you so much for everything you've done!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Лиди, Сью и ты, Дроссель. Огромное спасибо за все, что вы сделали!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..original: Mysterious friendships, brought to me by my shop. I need to treasure them, going forward.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_180..translation: Таинственная дружба, принесенная мне моим магазином. Мне нужно ценить их, идя вперед.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Peddler
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Boss! We're ready for our second Merveille store! Not a street stall, but a proper shop.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Босс! Мы готовы открыть наш второй магазин Мервейль! Не уличный ларек, а настоящий магазин.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: I told you not to call me "boss". How about "Chairwoman"?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Я же говорил тебе не называть меня "босс". А как насчет «Председателя»?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Peddler
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Of course, that's right! Chairwoman. I'll be more careful!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Конечно, это так! Председатель. Я буду осторожнее!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Well then. With our second store, I'll be able to expand even more.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Ну что ж. Благодаря нашему второму магазину я смогу расшириться еще больше.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Hehe, Corneria! It looks like business is going well?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Хе-хе, Корнерия! Похоже, дела идут хорошо?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Hey, Lydie, Sue. Yes, thanks to you.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Привет, Лиди, Сью. Да, спасибо тебе.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: We have a communications network and sales are up. Business in Adalet is going to be good.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: У нас есть сеть связи, и продажи растут. Дела в Адалете будут идти хорошо.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: I see, I see. And what about your dad?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Я вижу, я вижу. А что насчет твоего отца?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: He hasn't come yet. But I can't afford to just sit around waiting.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Он еще не пришел. Но я не могу себе позволить просто сидеть и ждать.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Of course, I want to see him. But growing my business is important too.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Конечно, я хочу его увидеть. Но развитие моего бизнеса тоже важно.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: That's the Corneria we know and love! Merchant among merchants!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Это Корнерия, которую мы знаем и любим! Купец среди торговцев!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Thank you so much. Hehe, I'll just keep on doing my best!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Большое спасибо. Хе-хе, я буду продолжать стараться изо всех сил!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: To spread the name of Corneria Enterprise and supply as many as I can with affordable quality items!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Распространять имя Компании Корнерии и снабжать как можно больше людей доступными качественными товарами!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Great! We're supporting you, Corneria!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Большой! Мы поддерживаем тебя, Корнерия!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Ah, I know. How about selling some of the stuff that we synthesize?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Ах, я знаю. Как насчет продажи некоторых вещей, которые мы синтезируем?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: An interest rate around this, and then a low handling fee...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Примерно такая же процентная ставка, а затем низкая комиссия за обработку...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Hah, I'm not just going to swallow that. Push the handling up a little higher...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Ха, я не собираюсь просто проглотить это. Поднимите ручку немного выше...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Hahaha, you two are negotiating already? Come on, Sue, we can't be taking so much of her time.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Ха-ха-ха, вы двое уже ведете переговоры? Да ладно, Сью, мы не можем отнимать у нее так много времени.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Okay, okay. We'll continue this later, Corneria!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Хорошо, хорошо. Мы продолжим это позже, Корнерия!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Very well. I look forward to it. See you later.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Очень хорошо. Я с нетерпением жду этого. Увидимся позже.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: unknown(name_id=48)
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: ... Corneria? Is that really you?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: ... Корнерия? Это действительно ты?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: What? ... Are you my father?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Что? ... Ты мой отец?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Thank goodness for that.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Слава богу за это.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: I know!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Я знаю!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hello, girls! There's something I want to discuss with you.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Здравствуйте, девочки! Есть кое-что, что я хочу обсудить с тобой.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: There is? What is it?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Есть? Что это такое?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: I've been reunited with my father. He came and visited my shop!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Я воссоединился со своим отцом. Он пришел и посетил мой магазин!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Ah, I knew it! Corneria, congratulations!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Ах, я знал это! Корнерия, поздравляю!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: You must have had a lot to talk about. Did he tell you the reason why he left?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Вам, наверное, было о чем поговорить. Он рассказал вам причину, по которой ушел?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Yes. It was simple, really. Apparently, he copied too many things...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Да. На самом деле это было просто. Видимо, он слишком много чего скопировал...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Excuse me?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Прошу прощения?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: He took on a lot of work, for the sake of my mother, and shrunk down to a size of a bug!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Он взял на себя много работы ради моей матери и уменьшился до размеров жука!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Then my mother thought he had gone missing. It was all a misunderstanding, actually.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Потом моя мать подумала, что он пропал. На самом деле это было недоразумение.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hahaha... I was only joking about becoming that small, but it's actually possible?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Я только пошутил насчет того, чтобы стать таким маленьким, но это вообще возможно?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: You be careful then, Corneria. We don't want Sue keeping you like a pet!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Тогда будь осторожен, Корнерия. Мы не хотим, чтобы Сью держала тебя как домашнего любимца!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hey, I'd never go that far! Although, if I actually saw her, my resolve...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Эй, я бы никогда не зашёл так далеко! Хотя, если бы я действительно увидел ее, моя решимость...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hehe, I'll be careful, then. I don't want to end up as someone's pet, that's for sure.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Хе-хе, тогда я буду осторожен. Я не хочу стать чьим-то домашним любимцем, это точно.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: So, where's your dad now?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Итак, где сейчас твой отец?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: He isn't in the city anymore. I gave him this.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Его больше нет в городе. Я дал ему это.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: What is it? A travel ticket?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Что это такое? Проездной билет?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Yes. A ticket back to my hometown, to Kirchen Bell.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Да. Билет обратно в мой родной город, в Кирхен-Белл.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: There's so much more I want to talk to him about, but only when my mother is there too.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Я хочу еще о многом с ним поговорить, но только когда моя мама тоже будет рядом.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: I see! I'm sure she'll be happy about that! When will you be going back?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Я понимаю! Я уверен, она будет этому рада! Когда ты вернешься?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: It will be a while, I think.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Я думаю, это пройдёт некоторое время.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Business is just getting on track here. I can't afford to step away at the moment.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Бизнес здесь только набирает обороты. Я не могу позволить себе отойти в сторону в данный момент.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: What, are you sure? I think you need to get back there!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Что, ты уверен? Я думаю, тебе нужно вернуться туда!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: A little punishment for making me wait for so long. This time he will have to wait for me.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Маленькое наказание за то, что заставил меня так долго ждать. На этот раз ему придется меня дождаться.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hehe, I can see that. I bet he'll wait as long as it takes.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Хе-хе, я это вижу. Могу поспорить, он будет ждать столько, сколько потребуется.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Thank you. I'll be relying on your patronage a little while longer, girls.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Спасибо. Девочки, я еще некоторое время буду рассчитывать на ваше покровительство.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Lydie, Sue. I hope you'll continue to come and visit the Corneria Enterprise!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Лиди, Сью. Надеюсь, вы и дальше будете посещать Компанию Корнерии!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..original: Liane, you're Firis' older sister, right?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..translation: Лиана, ты старшая сестра Фирис, верно?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..original: That's right! She's my darling baby sister! Sweet enough to eat!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..translation: Это верно! Она моя дорогая младшая сестра! Достаточно сладкий, чтобы его можно было съесть!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..original: Haha, so the name of your store, "Lovely Firis"...
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..translation: Ха-ха, значит, название твоего магазина "Lovely Фирис"...

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..original: Right again, it's taken from Firis' name. It lets me feel like we're together all the time.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..translation: Опять же, оно взято из имени Фирис. Это позволяет мне чувствовать, что мы все время вместе.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..original: When I told her about it, she got all embarrassed! That was so cute too!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..translation: Когда я ей об этом рассказал, она очень смутилась! Это тоже было так мило!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..original: Ah, I can hardly put it into words just how great Firis is!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..translation: Ах, я с трудом могу выразить словами, насколько велика Фирис!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..original: L-Liane? Come on back to us, Liane!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..original: Lydie... I'm sorry for bringing all this up! Run for it!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..translation: Лиди... Прости, что подняла эту тему! Беги за этим!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..original: She'll never shut up if we hang around here...
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..translation: Она никогда не замолчит, если мы останемся здесь...

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..original: G-Good point! Liane, we'll see you later!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..original: And so I sneaked some veggies into her soup, and she got so angry when she noticed! But even so...
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_010..translation: И вот я подсунул ей в суп немного овощей, и она так разозлилась, когда это заметила! Но даже так...

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Liane... I can't accept this!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Лиана... Я не могу этого принять!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: It's fine, it's fine. Go ahead!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Все в порядке, все в порядке. Вперед, продолжать!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Hello, both of you. What are you doing?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Привет вам обоим. Что ты делаешь?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: I was just giving Firis her allowance!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Я просто отдавал Фирис ее карманные деньги!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: And I was just turning it down. I'm not a child any more!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: И я просто отказывался от этого. Я больше не ребенок!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Liane was trying to give me almost all of her earnings!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Лиана пыталась отдать мне почти весь свой заработок!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: You worked so hard to earn it all. You should use it for yourself.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Ты так много работал, чтобы заработать все это. Вы должны использовать его для себя.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: You seem to have the wrong idea. I am using this exactly for what I want!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Кажется, у вас неправильное представление. Я использую это именно для того, что хочу!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Giving it to you, Firis! That's all!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Отдаю это тебе, Фирис! Вот и все!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Ugh... She just won't listen...
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Тьфу... Она просто не слушает...

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Haha! You really do love Firis, don't you, Liane?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Хаха! Ты действительно любишь Фирис, не так ли, Лиана?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Of course I do! I can't live without her!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Конечно, я знаю! Я не могу жить без нее!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: I can't wait to see her in the morning! I eat lunch while thinking all about her!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Не могу дождаться, чтобы увидеть ее утром! Я обедаю, думая только о ней!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: In the evening, I think about her some more! And even when I dream, it's all about her!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Вечером я еще немного думаю о ней! И даже когда я мечтаю, это всё о ней!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Loving Firis! That is my life! That is my everything!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Обожаю Фирис! Это моя жизнь! Это мое все!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Come on, cut that out! Everyone is looking!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Давай, прекрати это! Все смотрят!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Let them look! They mean nothing in the face of my love for you!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Пусть смотрят! Они ничего не значат перед лицом моей любви к тебе!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: I didn't want to do this, but... Be quiet or I won't talk to you again today.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Я не хотел этого делать, но... Молчи, иначе я больше не буду с тобой разговаривать сегодня.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: ...ngh!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: ... нгх!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Hahaha! Liane, you're too easy!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Лиана, ты слишком легкая!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Hehe. You two are very close, aren't you?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Хе-хе. Вы двое очень близки, не так ли?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Yeah! She has her quirks, but I love Liane too.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Ага! У нее есть свои причуды, но я тоже люблю Лиану.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Firis! I'm so happy, Firis!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Фирис! Я так рада, Фирис!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: And there we go again... That's it for today, Liane, sorry!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: И вот снова... На сегодня всё, Лиана, прости!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Ah, wait! I won't survive that! Wait!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Ах, подожди! Я этого не переживу! Ждать!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Hehe, the two of them are so close! We can't lose to them, can we?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Хе-хе, они так близки! Мы не можем им проиграть, не так ли?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..original: Right!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_020..translation: Верно!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: Thank you for coming!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Спасибо, что пришли!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: Liane, hello! How is the shop going?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Лиана, здравствуйте! Как дела в магазине?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: Hehe, very well, thank you. Here.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Хе-хе, очень хорошо, спасибо. Здесь.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: Huh? What's this?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Хм? Что это?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: A survey I've been having my customers fill in. Take a look!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Опрос, который я просил своих клиентов заполнить. Взгляните!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: A survey? Let's see... "Offers a wide range of fresh produce".
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Опрос? Посмотрим... "Предлагает широкий ассортимент свежих продуктов".

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: "Shop owner is cute", "lots of items", "shop owner is hot", "shop owner is funny"...
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: «Владелец магазина милый», «Много товаров», «Владелец магазина горячий», «Владелец магазина забавный»…

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: Wow, yeah, you have a pretty good reputation! Although half of these are about you?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Ого, да, у тебя довольно хорошая репутация! Хотя половина из них про вас?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: Well, Liane, you are attractive, and kind too. You only sell the best, as well!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Что ж, Лиана, ты привлекательная и добрая. Вы также продаете только лучшее!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: I'm not surprised you get a lot of customers.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Я не удивлен, что у тебя много клиентов.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: Hehe, that's very kind of you to say. I need to make my shop even more famous now.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Хе-хе, это очень мило с твоей стороны. Теперь мне нужно сделать свой магазин еще более известным.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: I'm hoping you do the opposite, actually...
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Я надеюсь, что ты поступишь наоборот...

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: Hi, Firis! What do you mean by that?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Привет, Фирис! Что ты имеешь в виду?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: The more famous Liane's shop gets, the harder it is for me to live in Merveille!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Чем известнее становится магазин Лианы, тем труднее мне жить в Мервейле!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: First, the name! "Lovely Firis"! That's embarrassing enough as it is!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Во-первых, имя! «Прекрасная Фирис»! Это и так достаточно неловко!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: No it isn't! I think it's a lovely name.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Нет, это не так! Я думаю, что это прекрасное имя.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: Your opinion doesn't count! Then there's the way you interact with your customers.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Ваше мнение не имеет значения! Еще есть способ взаимодействия со своими клиентами.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: Can you stop telling them stories about me? I know people are talking about me when I walk past!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Можешь перестать рассказывать им истории обо мне? Я знаю, что люди говорят обо мне, когда я прохожу мимо!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: Oh, but come on! I want tales of your cuteness to be passed down through history, Firis!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: О, но давай! Я хочу, чтобы истории о твоей привлекательности вошли в историю, Фирис!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: Hah! Those stories may be good for business, but why do they have to be so embarrassing?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Ха! Эти истории могут быть полезны для бизнеса, но почему они должны вызывать такое неловкое положение?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: This is wrong. It's definitely wrong!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Это неправильно. Это определенно неправильно!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..original: Hahaha... You've got it tough too, haven't you Firis...
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_030..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Тебе тоже приходится нелегко, Фирис, не правда ли...

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Mathi...as?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: Thank you so much, Liane! You've really boosted my courage!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Огромное спасибо, Лиана! Вы действительно придали мне храбрости!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: Good. I know it will work out. Just do your best!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Хороший. Я знаю, что все получится. Просто делайте все возможное!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: What will work out? If you don't mind me asking?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Что получится? Если вы не против, я спрошу?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: Oh, that was a love-related advice.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: О, это был совет, связанный с любовью.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: L-Love-related? Liane, have you started a new line of work?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: L-связано с любовью? Лиана, ты начала новую работу?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: No, silly. I'm just running my shop, as usual.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Нет, глупо. Я, как обычно, просто управляю своим магазином.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: Lot's of people have been coming to ask for my advice recently. I'm not sure why.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: В последнее время многие люди приходят ко мне за советом. Я не уверен, почему.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: I guess maybe because you're so in control, and do such a good job running your business!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Я думаю, может быть, потому, что вы так хорошо все контролируете и так хорошо справляетесь со своим бизнесом!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: You're cheerful and easy to talk to, as well. I bet that's part of it!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Ты веселый и с тобой легко общаться. Могу поспорить, что это часть этого!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Together
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: If only it wasn't for all that stuff with Firis...
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Если бы не все эти дела с Фирис...

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: System
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: If only it wasn't for all that stuff with Firis...
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Если бы не все эти дела с Фирис...

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: What was that?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Что это было?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: Ah, no, it's nothing!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Ах, нет, это ничего!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: Anyway, it's how you always give sound and cheerful advice. That's why people come to you.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: В любом случае, ты всегда даешь дельные и веселые советы. Именно поэтому люди приходят к вам.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: Hehe. Just one of your many virtues, Liane!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Хе-хе. Всего лишь одно из многих твоих достоинств, Лиана!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: I see. I guess I should be happy, then. Thank you for listening to me.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Я понимаю. Думаю, тогда я должен быть счастлив. Спасибо, что выслушали меня.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: Here's a little reward. I made them myself. I hope you like them.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Вот небольшая награда. Я сделал их сам. Надеюсь, они вам понравятся.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: Uwah! Delicious looking cookies! Thank you, Liane!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Ува! Аппетитное на вид печенье! Спасибо, Лиана!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: Hehe! We love you too, Liane!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Хе-хе! Мы тоже тебя любим, Лиана!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..original: Ah, how cute you are! Please come again any time. I'm looking forward to it already!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_040..translation: Ах, какой ты милый! Пожалуйста, приходите снова в любое время. Я уже с нетерпением жду этого!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..original: Sue, Sue! What shall we make after getting home?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..translation: Сью, Сью! Что мы сделаем, вернувшись домой?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..original: Hmm, good question. A bomb or some medicine?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..translation: Хм, хороший вопрос. Бомба или лекарство?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..original: Hey, that's right. You two are alchemists, aren't you? Do you make suns, then?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..translation: Эй, это правда. Вы двое алхимики, не так ли? Так ты делаешь солнца?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..original: What? Suns? What are you talking about?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..translation: Что? Солнца? О чем ты говоришь?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..original: What do you think? A sun! Alchemists make small suns to melt snow, right?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..translation: Что вы думаете? Солнце! Алхимики создают маленькие солнышки, чтобы растопить снег, верно?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..original: No, we don't! I don't think that's even possible! I wouldn't even want to try doing that!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..translation: Нет, мы этого не делаем! Я не думаю, что это вообще возможно! Я бы даже не хотел пытаться это сделать!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..original: What, really? Firis used to do that...

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..original: What about making ship parts, then? Merveille is close to the water, so you must do that?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..translation: А как насчет изготовления деталей для кораблей? Мервейль находится недалеко от воды, так что вы должны это сделать?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..original: No! Ships are made by shipbuilders!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..original: Huh? What about items to restore a broken bridge in an instant, then? An instant bridge item?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..translation: Хм? А как насчет предметов, позволяющих мгновенно восстановить сломанный мост? Мгновенный мостовой предмет?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..original: Hahaha... You have a pretty confused view of alchemy Liane.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..translation: Ха-ха-ха... У тебя довольно запутанное представление об алхимии, Лиана.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..original: I-Is that so? I've been thinking alchemy was like magic, basically, all this time!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..translation: Я-это так? Я все это время думал, что алхимия похожа на волшебство!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..original: Hmm. Is this because Firis is a great alchemist, or because Liane is actually an airhead?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..translation: Хм. Это потому, что Фирис — великий алхимик, или потому, что Лиана на самом деле легкомысленная?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..original: Hahaha, maybe a little of both!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_050..translation: Ха-ха-ха, может быть, и то, и другое!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Hello!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Привет!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Sophie, give me a moment. I'll put these scattered materials into this container.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Софи, дай мне минутку. Я положу эти разбросанные материалы в этот контейнер.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Ah, sorry for the trouble, Liane.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Ах, извини за беспокойство, Лиана.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Liane. I seem to have misplaced my encyclopedia...
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Лиана. Кажется, я потерял свою энциклопедию...

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Ah, I know where that is. I put it on the table over there.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Ах, я знаю, где это. Я положил его вон на стол.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: I see. Thank you very much, that's a big help.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Я понимаю. Большое спасибо, это большая помощь.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Liane! Liane! I'm starving! Make me some food!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Лиана! Лиана! Я умираю с голоду! Приготовь мне еды!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Yes, yes. It will be ready soon, just wait a little longer.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Да, да. Скоро будет готово, подождите еще немного.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Great! What's on the menu today?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Большой! Что сегодня в меню?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Hehehe. Peppers stuffed with meat.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Хе-хе-хе. Перцы, фаршированные мясом.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Blegh! I don't need the peppers!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Блех! Мне не нужен перец!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: You don't get to pick and choose, either. Ah! It's Lydie and Sue!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Вы также не можете выбирать. Ах! Это Лиди и Сью!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Sorry, I only just noticed you there... Are you looking for anyone in particular?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Извините, я только сейчас вас там заметил... Вы ищете кого-то конкретного?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: No, we just dropped in to see what's happening... You really are incredible, Liane!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Нет, мы просто зашли посмотреть, что происходит... Ты действительно невероятна, Лиана!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Incredible? Whatever do you mean?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Невероятный? Что ты имеешь в виду?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: The housework! All this housework! You've tied Sophie's dirty room all the way up!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Работа по дому! Вся эта работа по дому! Ты полностью связал грязную комнату Софи!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Ugh!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Фу!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Then you told Plachta the location of her missing book!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Тогда вы сообщили Плахте местонахождение ее пропавшей книги!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Ugh!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Фу!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: And then handled Firis' picky eating without batting an eyelid!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: А затем, не моргнув глазом, справился с привередливой едой Фирис!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Ugh!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Фу!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: You're wonderful, truly! Every home should have one!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Ты прекрасен, правда! В каждом доме должен быть такой!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Hehe, thank you. I've always loved to take care of a home, and everyone living in it.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Хе-хе, спасибо. Я всегда любил заботиться о доме и всех, кто в нем живет.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: I know. Why don't you both eat with us? I'll make something really delicious, I promise!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Я знаю. Почему бы вам обоим не пообедать с нами? Я приготовлю что-нибудь очень вкусное, обещаю!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Thank you! That sounds lovely!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Спасибо! Это звучит прекрасно!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Sophie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Liane, I'll give you a hand in the kitchen...
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Лиана, я помогу тебе на кухне...

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Plachta
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: I'll set the table...
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Я накрою стол...

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: I'll do my best to eat as many peppers as I can, Liane...
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Я сделаю все возможное, чтобы съесть как можно больше перца, Лиана...

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: What's gotten into the three of you, now?
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Что сейчас нашло на вас троих?

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Hahaha! I think the way of life of Firis and the others is only possible because of Liane!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Я думаю, что образ жизни Фирис и остальных возможен только благодаря Лиане!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Hello!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Привет!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Sophie, give me a moment. I'll put these scattered materials into this container.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Ah, sorry for the trouble, Liane.
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Ах, извини за беспокойство, Лиана.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Ах, я знаю, где это. Я положил его вон на стол.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: unknown(name_id=18)
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: I see. Thank you very much, that's a big help.

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: You're wonderful, truly! Every home should have one!
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..translation: Ты прекрасен, правда! В каждом доме должен быть такой!

ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc15_lia/event_message_qc15_lia_060..original: Hehe, thank you. I've always loved to take care of a home, and everyone living in it.
