ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: As if! Your place leaks more than the one we rent!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Как будто! Ваше жилье протекает больше, чем то, которое мы снимаем!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: We're here because there's something we want to ask!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Мы здесь, потому что хотим кое-что спросить!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: Like what?! Not my secret savings! Hah, you'll never look under Sue's bed... ulp!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Как что?! Не мои тайные сбережения! Ха, ты никогда не заглянешь под кровать Сью... блевать!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: Not that either! We want to ask you about the Mysterious Paintings!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: И не это! Мы хотим спросить вас о Таинственных Картинах!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: Hold on... Mysterious Paintings? You know about them?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Подожди... Загадочные картины? Вы знаете о них?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: Who doesn't?! The rumors are everywhere! Twin alchemists, exploring worlds inside paintings!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Кто нет?! Слухи повсюду! Алхимики-близнецы, исследующие миры внутри картин!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: Wow, really? People are talking about us? Hehe, that's great!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Вау, правда? Люди говорят о нас? Хе-хе, это здорово!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: Lydie, a little modesty! Hehe! Anyway, why do you want to know about the paintings?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Лидия, немного скромности! Хе-хе! И вообще, зачем тебе знать о картинах?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: We want to make a puppet show about them. There are all sorts of worlds in there, right?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Мы хотим сделать о них кукольный спектакль. Там есть самые разные миры, верно?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: A world with only cute girls, or a world were gold can be found scattered on the ground?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Мир, в котором живут только милые девушки, или мир, в котором по земле можно найти золото?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: We haven't seen any worlds like that! It sounds like the rumors are a bit out of control!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Таких миров мы еще не видели! Похоже, слухи немного вышли из-под контроля!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: Come on then. We'll tell you the truth. These painting worlds...
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Давай тогда. Мы скажем вам правду. Эти нарисованные миры...

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: And that's how it works. Does that help?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: И вот как это работает. Это помогает?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: A lot! Hahaha, now I can write it! I can write a great script, based on this!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Много! Ха-ха-ха, теперь я могу это написать! На основе этого я могу написать отличный сценарий!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: I've had some new ideas for puppets, too! Hahaha! I need to get back and start work at once!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: У меня тоже появились новые идеи для кукол! Ха-ха-ха! Мне нужно вернуться и немедленно приступить к работе!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: Me too, Dad! Girls, we'll see you later!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Я тоже, папа! Девочки, увидимся позже!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: Uwah, that was a surprise. They sweep in here, and then sweep out again! Crazy!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Увау, это был сюрприз. Сюда заносятся, а потом снова выметаются! Сумасшедший!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: Hahaha... But you know what? I think I quite like them.
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Но знаешь что? Я думаю, они мне очень нравятся.

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: So intent on their goal, so full of energy... It's almost dazzling to look at them!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Такие устремленные к своей цели, такие полные энергии... На них почти ослепительно смотреть!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: Hmm. I think you're going to have terrible taste in men in the future, Lydie...
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Хм. Я думаю, в будущем у тебя будет ужасный вкус на мужчин, Лиди...

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: What! What's that supposed to mean?!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Что! Что это должно значить?!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: Exactly what it sounds like. You're going to need me to save you, I can tell!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Именно так это звучит. Я тебе понадобится, чтобы спасти тебя, я знаю!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..original: Hey! Hold on! Explain yourself! What are you talking about?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_090..translation: Привет! Подожди! Объяснитесь! О чем ты говоришь?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: So, when making a puppet, the most important parts to consider are the waist and the lower back...
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Итак, при изготовлении куклы наиболее важными частями, которые следует учитывать, являются талия и поясница...

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Hmm, I see. So that's what you like, Mr. Fritz?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Хм, я вижу. Так вот что вам нравится, мистер Фриц?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Hey, I didn't say that! I'm talking about puppet making, that's all...
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Эй, я этого не говорил! Я говорю о изготовлении кукол, вот и все...

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Another guest? Shall I let them in?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Еще один гость? Мне их впустить?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Yes, please.
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Да, пожалуйста.

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Yes, who is it?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Да, кто это?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Boo!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Бу!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Uwaaaah! P-P-P-Pamela!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Уваааа! П-п-п-Памела!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: W-What! Where did you come in from? How did you do that?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Ч-что! Откуда вы пришли? Как ты это сделал?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: A magician never reveals her tricks!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Фокусник никогда не раскрывает свои фокусы!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Hahaha, you haven't changed. What is it? How can I help?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха, ты не изменился. Что это такое? Как я могу помочь?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Good question! I'm here to request a puppet show from you.
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Хороший вопрос! Я здесь, чтобы заказать у вас кукольный спектакль.

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: I see, you want a performance. Where?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Я вижу, ты хочешь представление. Где?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: At the church. We hold these church gatherings, and we'd like you to be a part of it.
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: В церкви. Мы проводим эти церковные собрания, и мы хотели бы, чтобы вы стали их частью.

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: I knew it. The puppeteer you were talking about was Mr. Fritz.
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Я знал это. Кукольником, о котором вы говорили, был мистер Фриц.

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: That's right. Fritz is the best puppeteer I've ever seen!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Это верно. Фриц — лучший кукольник, которого я когда-либо видел!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Heh, an honor that you think so. Very well, I accept your request.
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Хех, это честь, что ты так думаешь. Хорошо, я принимаю вашу просьбу.

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Hahaha! Drossel and I will put on our greatest performance yet, I promise!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Я и Дроссель покажем наше лучшее выступление, я обещаю!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Great to hear! I'll come by again with the details soon. Thanks!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Приятно слышать! Скоро зайду снова с подробностями. Спасибо!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Hahaha, this is exciting! Let's start the preparations at once!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха, это захватывающе! Начнем подготовку немедленно!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Mr. Fritz, we're going to be at the church gathering too.
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Мистер Фриц, мы тоже собираемся присутствовать на церковном собрании.

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: We're really looking forward to the puppet show already!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Мы уже с нетерпением ждем кукольного спектакля!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..original: Leave it to us, then! Hahaha!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_100..translation: Тогда оставьте это нам! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Mr. Fritz! Drossel! You've made up with Sister Grace?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Мистер Фриц! Дроссель! Ты помирился с Сестрой Грейс?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Hehe, that's great! Congratulations!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Хе-хе, это здорово! Поздравляем!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Heh, it all worked out somehow. It's all thanks to you two, really!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Хех, все как-то получилось. Это все благодаря вам двоим, правда!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: That's right. The support you offered us really helped us get through, Lydie and Sue!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Это верно. Поддержка, которую вы нам предложили, действительно помогла нам выжить, Лиди и Сью!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Thank you so much, both of you!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Огромное спасибо вам обоим!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: This is great! Now you can all live as a family again!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Это здорово! Теперь вы снова можете жить как одна семья!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Ah, well, about that... It won't be long before I'll be hitting the road again...
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: А, ну об этом... Совсем скоро я снова отправлюсь в путь...

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: What? After just meeting your mom again?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Что? После очередной встречи с мамой?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Yes... There's something I want to do, so I can't live with them.
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Да... Мне кое-что хочется сделать, поэтому я не могу с ними жить.

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: I tried to persuade her, but it's no good. She's such a stubborn girl! Where does she get it from?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Я пытался ее уговорить, но это бесполезно. Она такая упрямая девочка! Откуда она это берет?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: I see... Drossel, can you tell us what it is you want to do?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Понятно... Дроссель, можешь ли ты сказать нам, что ты хочешь сделать?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Sure. I want even more people to see the ultimate puppet theater we have created!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Конечно. Я хочу, чтобы еще больше людей увидели созданный нами потрясающий кукольный театр!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: It's so good, after all. We want many more people to see it!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: В конце концов, это так хорошо. Мы хотим, чтобы это увидело как можно больше людей!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: So I'm going to leave the city and perform it in as many places as I can!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Так что я собираюсь покинуть город и выступить с ним в как можно большем количестве мест!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: I see! To get more people to see your show.
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Я понимаю! Чтобы больше людей посмотрело ваше шоу.

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Yeah. I bet mom and dad want some alone time, too!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Ага. Могу поспорить, мама и папа тоже хотят побыть наедине!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Hey! That's not for you to worry about!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Привет! Не вам об этом беспокоиться!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Hahah! It sounds like she's totally outmaneuvered you, Mr. Fritz!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Ха-ха! Похоже, она вас полностью перехитрила, мистер Фриц!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Aren't you going to be sad though, Drossel? Not being with your parents?
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: А ты не будешь грустить, Дроссель? Не быть с родителями?

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Yes, I'm sad! I plan on coming back pretty often, you'll see!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Да, мне грустно! Я планирую возвращаться довольно часто, вот увидите!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Hah! If your sense of direction doesn't improve, we'll probably never see you again!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Ха! Если ваше чувство направления не улучшится, мы, вероятно, никогда больше вас не увидим!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Hah, you have to bring that up! Don't worry, it'll all work out!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Ха, ты должен это поднять! Не волнуйтесь, все получится!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Are you sure? Anyway, more than that, I think it's about time you found a husband, at your age...
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Вы уверены? В любом случае, более того, я думаю, тебе пора найти мужа в твоем возрасте...

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Stop right there! Never talk to a girl about her age!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Остановитесь здесь! Никогда не говорите с девушкой о ее возрасте!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Hehe. Even after living apart for so long, it doesn't take much to turn back the clock.
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Хе-хе. Даже после столь долгой жизни в разлуке, не нужно много времени, чтобы повернуть время вспять.

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: The bonds of family are so strong, aren't they! Stronger than rocks, than metal, than anything!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Семейные узы так сильны, не так ли! Крепче камня, металла, чего бы то ни было!

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Yeah. So even if Drossel goes traveling, the bond between the three of them will be unchanged.
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Ага. Так что даже если Дроссель отправится в путешествие, связь между ними троими не изменится.

ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..original: Heheh! I wish all three of them endless happiness!
ebm:qc16_fri/event_message_qc16_fri_110..translation: Хе-хе! Желаю всем троим бесконечного счастья!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lucia
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Ah, this is a dream come true! I can't believe I get to meet THE Drossel!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Ах, это сбывшаяся мечта! Не могу поверить, что мне удалось встретиться с Дроссель!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lucia
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Ah, I have a copy of your book, "Created Eyes"...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Ах, у меня есть экземпляр вашей книги «Сотворённые глаза»…

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lucia
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: ... Could you please sign it for me?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: ... Не могли бы вы подписать это для меня?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Yes, of course. Like this?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Да, конечно. Так?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lucia
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: That's lovely! I'll treasure this forever! Thank you so much, Drossel!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Это прекрасно! Я буду хранить это вечно! Огромное спасибо, Дроссель!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Lucia seemed really excited! What was that all about?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Люсия выглядела очень взволнованной! Что это было?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Oh, you saw that?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: О, ты это видел?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Yes, we did. You signed something for her?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Да, мы это сделали. Ты что-то для нее подписал?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Have you published a book, Drossel? You did say that you write things, right?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Вы опубликовали книгу, Дроссель? Ты же говорил, что пишешь что-то, да?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Sorry, girls, can you give me some room? I'm still not used to all this attention...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Простите, девочки, не могли бы вы дать мне немного места? Я еще не привык к такому вниманию...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: But yes, I did have a book published a while back. It's called "Created Eyes".
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Но да, некоторое время назад у меня была опубликована книга. Это называется «Сотворённые глаза».

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: It was pretty well received, so sometimes I get fans coming up to me like that.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Это было довольно хорошо принято, поэтому иногда фанаты подходили ко мне вот так.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Wow, really? What kind of book is it?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Вау, правда? Что это за книга?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Ready for this? A romance about puppets in a puppet shop!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Готовы к этому? Романс о куклах в кукольном магазине!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Forbidden love between puppets from rival shops is the best part, I think.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Я думаю, что запретная любовь между марионетками из конкурирующих магазинов — лучшая часть.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Hahaha, you certainly have a theme, don't you! Right, Lydie?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха, у тебя определенно есть тема, не так ли! Верно, Лиди?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: How lovely! Drossel! I want to read that book myself!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Как мило! Дроссель! Я сама хочу прочитать эту книгу!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Really? Of course, I'll give you a copy!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Действительно? Конечно, я дам вам копию!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Great! Thank you! I'll read it as soon as I get home!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Большой! Спасибо! Прочитаю, как только приду домой!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: It's no good... She's got the bug already. These bookworms, I don't know what to do with them!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Это бесполезно... У нее уже есть ошибка. Эти книжные черви, я не знаю, что с ними делать!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..original: Although I'm wondering about it myself now... I'll just have Lydie tell me what is it about, later.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_010..translation: Хотя сейчас я сам об этом думаю... Я просто попрошу Лиди рассказать мне, о чем идет речь, позже.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Ah, this looks good! This too! Ah, I can't make up my mind!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Ах, это выглядит хорошо! Это тоже! Ах, я не могу решиться!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Ah, excuse us! Drossel?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Ах, извините! Дроссель?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Hey, girls! What's up? Here to eat?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Эй, девочки! Как дела? Здесь поесть?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: No, we were just passing by. What about you, Drossel? What are you doing here?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Нет, мы просто проходили мимо. А ты, Дроссель? Что ты здесь делаешь?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Shopping, of course! There are so many great things on sale here in Merveille!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Конечно же, шопинг! Здесь, в Мервейле, продается так много замечательных вещей!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Hahaha. Which means I've bought too much again!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Ха-ха-ха. Это значит, что я снова купил слишком много!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Oh. How much did you spend?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Ой. Сколько вы потратили?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: About 30,000 Coll...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Около 30 000 Колл...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: What! That much?! We could live for a year on that!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Что! Так много?! На это мы могли бы прожить год!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Sue... I think that's a bit of an exaggeration.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Сью... Я думаю, это немного преувеличение.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: But it's still a lot of money. And you can afford it, Drossel?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Но это все равно большие деньги. И ты можешь себе это позволить, Дроссель?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Won't this make Mr. Fritz mad?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Не разозлит ли это мистера Фрица?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: No, it's fine! Reading lots of different books is best for a writer.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Нет, все в порядке! Для писателя лучше всего читать много разных книг.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: He'll forgive me, if I tell him I'm doing it for our plays!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Он меня простит, если я скажу ему, что делаю это для наших спектаклей!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: R-Really? I can see him at least sighing a bit over this...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Р-Правда? Я вижу, что он хотя бы немного вздыхает по этому поводу...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: No, it will be fine. Hey, there's something I want to ask you.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Нет, все будет хорошо. Эй, я хочу кое-что у тебя спросить.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: Do you know somewhere fun to do some shopping? Can you tell me?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Знаете ли вы место, где можно весело совершить покупки? Вы можете сказать мне?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: What, you're going to do more shopping? Uwah! I'm jealous. I want to be able to spend too!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Что, ты собираешься делать еще покупки? Ува! Я ревную. Я тоже хочу иметь возможность тратить!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: No, Sue, you can't. Right, well, on this street there's a place called the Corneria Enterprise...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Нет, Сью, ты не можешь. Хорошо, ну, на этой улице есть место под названием Компания Корнерии...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: The Corneria Enterprise... Right, thanks!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Компания Корнерии... Точно, спасибо!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: That's not the way! Ah, she really gets lost, doesn't she?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Это не так! Ах, она действительно заблудилась, не так ли?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..original: I don't think I've ever seen Drossel heading in the correct direction toward anything... Right?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_020..translation: Не думаю, что я когда-либо видел, чтобы Дроссель двигался в правильном направлении к чему-либо... Верно?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Say... I heard from my dad that the two of you are alchemists?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Скажи... Я слышал от отца, что вы двое алхимики?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Yes, that's right! The genius alchemist sisters, the hot topic in the town!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Да, это так! Гениальные сестры-алхимики — горячая тема в городе!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Hey, no need to get all embarrassing! We're regular, just regular alchemists!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Эй, не надо смущаться! Мы обычные, просто обычные алхимики!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Hahaha, no need to be so modest. My dad said you're pretty good!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Ха-ха-ха, не надо быть таким скромным. Мой отец сказал, что ты очень хорош!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: In which case, I've got a real important request! A life changing question!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: В таком случае у меня очень важная просьба! Вопрос, меняющий жизнь!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Life changing? Gulp! W-What do you mean?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Жизнь меняется? Глоток! Ч-что ты имеешь в виду?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Don't tell me, you want a magic potion that turns people into puppets!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Не говорите мне, что вам нужно волшебное зелье, превращающее людей в марионеток!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: I don't need anything that dangerous!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Мне не нужно ничего настолько опасного!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: What I need is a tool to hone a blade. A whetstone, polishing agent, something like that...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Мне нужен инструмент для заточки лезвия. Точильный камень, полировальное средство, что-то в этом роде...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Why? Why would a puppeteer need to maintain a blade?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: An axe, actually. I want to get a bit of a workout.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Вернее, топор. Я хочу немного потренироваться.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: An axe! You use an axe, Drossel?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: I've fought dragons, ghosts, grass monsters, all sorts of creatures, with my friends. Hundreds of battles!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Вместе со своими друзьями я сражался с драконами, призраками, травяными монстрами и разными существами. Сотни сражений!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Н-вау... Это на самом деле довольно неожиданно.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: No problem, though. We'll make just the item you need!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Но это не проблема. Мы изготовим именно то, что Вам нужно!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Hahaha! Leave it to Lydie and Sue, the beautiful and skilled alchemist sisters!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Предоставьте это Лиди и Сью, красивым и опытным сестрам-алхимикам!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: That's enough! At least just limit it to "skilled alchemists"!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..original: Hahaha! It sounds promising. I'll be counting on you!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_030..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Звучит многообещающе. Я буду рассчитывать на тебя!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Here we go! The genius beautiful ultimate twin alchemists... uwah, I bit my tongue!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Вот так! Гениальные прекрасные алхимики-близнецы... ух, я прикусила язык!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Hahah, you deserved that. This is what you requested, here.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Ха-ха, ты это заслужил. Это то, что вы просили здесь.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Ah, thank you girls! Ah, this is going to give me some great ideas!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Ой, спасибо, девочки! О, это подарит мне несколько замечательных идей!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Huh? What do you mean? I thought you wanted to fix an axe?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Хм? Что ты имеешь в виду? Я думал, ты хочешь починить топор?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Yeah, that's right. First I'll use this to repair the axe...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Да, это так. Сначала я воспользуюсь этим, чтобы починить топор...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Then I'll get a work out fighting some monsters. Getting a bit crazy in battle...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Потом я потренируюсь сражаться с монстрами. Немного схожу с ума в бою...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Will be a great change of pace, and give me some great ideas! Well? Aren't I a genius?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Это будет отличное изменение темпа и подарит мне несколько отличных идей! Хорошо? Разве я не гений?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Genius is a stretch. Muscle brain might be better?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Гений — это преувеличение. Мышечный мозг может быть лучше?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Hahaha, give me a break, Sue!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: A change of pace can be important, anyway. This is all to create the ultimate puppet show.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: В любом случае, смена темпа может оказаться важной. Все это для создания настоящего кукольного спектакля.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Ah, you talked about that before. Just what kind of show is it going to be?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Ах, ты говорил об этом раньше. Что это будет за шоу?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Hmm, well, I don't have any concrete ideas yet... Something that appeals to the audience's emotions.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Хм, ну, конкретных идей у меня пока нет... Что-то, что апеллирует к эмоциям аудитории.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: A wonderful show, in which the puppets seem to be alive!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Замечательный спектакль, в котором куклы кажутся живыми!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: My father and I have always dreamed of putting on the ultimate puppet show! We'll move the hearts of one and all!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Мы с отцом всегда мечтали устроить настоящий кукольный спектакль! Мы тронем сердца всех и каждого!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: I'd love to see that myself, to be honest!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Я бы сам хотел это увидеть, если честно!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Me too, me too! Say, Drossel!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Я тоже, я тоже! Скажи, Дроссель!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Once that ultimate puppet show is ready, will you invite us?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Когда этот потрясающий кукольный спектакль будет готов, вы нас пригласите?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..original: Hehe, I should work harder! For these two, and for all others who are waiting to see it!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_040..translation: Хе-хе, мне нужно работать усерднее! Для этих двоих и для всех остальных, кто ждет этого!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Hey, girls! I'm here to have some fun!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Эй, девочки! Я здесь, чтобы повеселиться!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Ah, welcome. Make yourself at home.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ах, добро пожаловать. Чувствуйте себя как дома.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Hahaha, thank you! The medicinal smell in the air, the bubbling cauldron!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ха-ха-ха, спасибо! Лекарственный запах в воздухе, кипящий котел!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Ah, this all takes me back. I do love the atmosphere in an atelier.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ах, это все возвращает меня назад. Мне очень нравится атмосфера в ателье.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: What's that, Drossel? You've been in other ateliers before?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Что это, Дроссель? Вы раньше бывали в других ателье?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Sure. I've got other alchemist friends. Gah! Now I'm getting excited!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Конечно. У меня есть другие друзья-алхимики. Га! Теперь я в восторге!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Hey, could I take a look around? I'll try to stay out of your way!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Эй, могу я осмотреться? Я постараюсь держаться подальше от тебя!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Sure, that should be fine... Take a look around, as much as you like!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Конечно, ничего страшного... Осматривайтесь вокруг, сколько хотите!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Yay! Thanks! I'm going to go over every inch of this place with a fine tooth comb!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ура! Спасибо! Я собираюсь пройтись по каждому дюйму этого места гребешком с мелкими зубьями!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Hey, stay away from the bedroom, will you? Nothing to see in there...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Эй, держись подальше от спальни, ладно? Ничего там смотреть...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Hehe! An atelier really is like a toy box, isn't it?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Хе-хе! Ателье действительно похоже на ящик для игрушек, не правда ли?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Is this your mom?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Это твоя мама?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Yes, that's right. She passed away...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Да, это так. Она скончалась...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Ah, sorry for asking... It's tough not being able to see your mom, isn't it?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ах, извини, что спрашиваю... Тяжело не видеться с мамой, не так ли?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Well... What's your mom like, Drossel?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ну... Какая твоя мама, Дроссель?

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: She's kind. So very kind, and bright like the sun.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Она добрая. Такой добрый и яркий, как солнышко.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Hehe. Just like you then, Drossel!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Хе-хе. Совсем как ты, Дроссель!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: No, not as insensitive as me. She's prettier, and brighter. I want to be just like her.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Нет, не такой бесчувственный, как я. Она красивее и ярче. Я хочу быть такой же, как она.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: I can barely remember her face, to be honest, but I still want to meet her and see her again.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Честно говоря, я едва помню ее лицо, но мне все равно хочется встретиться с ней и увидеть ее снова.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Oh, Drossel...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ох, Дроссель...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Ah, sorry! I didn't mean to do this in front of you two.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Ах, извини! Я не хотел делать это в присутствии вас двоих.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Don't worry. We were happy to hear about it, Drossel.
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Не волнуйся. Мы были рады услышать об этом, Дроссель.

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: I'm sure you'll meet your mom again one day. Don't give up!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Я уверен, что однажды ты снова встретишь свою маму. Не сдавайтесь!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Thanks. You two really are something special. It was fun looking around your atelier. See you!
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Спасибо. Вы двое действительно особенные. Было интересно осмотреть ваше ателье. Увидимся!

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Drossel is sad about not being able to see her mom, isn't she...
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Дроссель грустит из-за того, что не может увидеть свою маму, не так ли...

ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..original: Of course she is. I wonder if there's anything we could do to reunite them?
ebm:qc17_dro/event_message_qc17_dro_050..translation: Конечно, она есть. Интересно, можем ли мы что-нибудь сделать, чтобы воссоединить их?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: We haven't been to the church much recently, have we? Maybe we should drop by every once in a while...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Мы в последнее время мало бывали в церкви, не так ли? Может быть, нам стоит заглядывать сюда время от времени...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Yeah, maybe. There might be something fun going on...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Да, возможно. Возможно, происходит что-то интересное...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Very well. I think I can allow that. But you have to keep your duties as a nun too. Understood?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Очень хорошо. Думаю, я могу это позволить. Но ты также должна выполнять свои обязанности монахини. Понял?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Of course, I understand. I'll do my very best!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Конечно, я понимаю. Я сделаю все возможное!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Hey, Pamela! It's been a while!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: My, if it isn't Lydie and Sue? Nice to see you again!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Боже, а не Лиди и Сью? Приятно видеть вас снова!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: You've been gone a while. What have you been doing?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Тебя давно не было. Что вы делали?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: I've been looking for items for my shop. I want to sell as many as I can!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Я искал товары для своего магазина. Я хочу продать как можно больше!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: I see. You'll be running a shop here again?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Я понимаю. Ты снова будешь управлять здесь магазином?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Hahaha, opening a shop in a church! You're a bold one, Pamela!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Ха-ха-ха, открытие магазина в церкви! Ты смелая, Памела!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: It's fine. I've got my reasons, and so I'm sure God will forgive me.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Все в порядке. У меня есть причины, и поэтому я уверен, что Бог меня простит.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: That sounds a bit suspicious to me! What do you think, Sister Grace?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Для меня это звучит немного подозрительно! Что вы думаете, Сестра Грейс?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Just like she said, there are reasons for this. She has my permission.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Как она сказала, для этого есть причины. У нее есть мое разрешение.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: That's right. My shop is approved by the church!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Это верно. Мой магазин одобрен церковью!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Ahem. I don't think we should go quite that far.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Кхм. Я не думаю, что нам стоит заходить так далеко.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Really? Well, in any case, welcome to my grand re-opening!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Действительно? Ну, в любом случае, добро пожаловать на мое торжественное открытие!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..original: Hehehe, go ahead, girls! Take a good look around!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_010..translation: Хе-хе-хе, вперед, девочки! Посмотрите хорошенько вокруг!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Hmmm. You've been to Merveille in the past, haven't you, Pamela?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Хм. Ты бывала в Мервейле раньше, не так ли, Памела?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Yes, that's right. I trained here as a nun.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Да, это так. Я обучалась здесь как монахиня.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Hehe, you were so small back then! This small! Ah, that takes me back!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Хе-хе, ты тогда был таким маленьким! Этот маленький! Ах, это возвращает меня назад!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Haha, I don't think we were quite that small!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Ха-ха, я не думаю, что мы были такими уж маленькими!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: When you finished, though, didn't you leave in a carriage?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: А когда ты закончил, разве ты не уехал в карете?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: So why did you come back to Merveille? After all this time, too...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Так почему же ты вернулся в Мервейле? Ведь и это время тоже...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Hmm. Do you really want to know?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Хм. Вы действительно хотите знать?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Yes, of course.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Да, конечно.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: All right. Have your handkerchiefs ready, though, girls.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Все в порядке. Однако, девочки, приготовьте платочки.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: It was after I finished my training. I stopped in a large town on my way home.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Это было после того, как я закончил обучение. По пути домой я остановился в большом городе.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: I was buying some gifts, and went and spent too much money! I couldn't pay for the rest of the journey!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Я покупал подарки, пошел и потратил слишком много денег! Я не смог оплатить оставшуюся часть пути!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Ugh...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Фу...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: But I wasn't going to give up! I earned enough money for a ticket, got another carriage...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Но я не собирался сдаваться! Заработал денег на билет, купил другой вагон...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: But this time it was the wrong carriage! So I turned up back here!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Но на этот раз это был не тот экипаж! Итак, я вернулся сюда!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: I see... That's just like you, Pamela!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Понятно... Это совсем как ты, Памела!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Ah. So the reason for this new shop...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Ах. Итак, причина создания этого нового магазина...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: That's right! To make the cash to get me back home!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Это верно! Чтобы заработать деньги и вернуть меня домой!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Well, that's a better reason than I expected. I thought maybe you were just passing the time!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Что ж, это более весомая причина, чем я ожидал. Я подумал, может быть, ты просто проводишь время!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Please! Sue, that's quite rude!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Пожалуйста! Сью, это довольно грубо!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: This is about more than just passing the time! Finding products, managing sales, it isn't easy!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Это нечто большее, чем просто времяпрепровождение! Поиск продуктов, управление продажами – это непросто!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: Hahaha, I guess you're right.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я думаю, ты прав.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..original: So please, think of it as helping me out, and buy a lot of things from me! Thank you!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_020..translation: Поэтому, пожалуйста, воспринимайте это как помощь мне и купите у меня много вещей! Спасибо!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Seriously! What are you playing at, Ines?!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Серьезно! Во что ты играешь, Инес?!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Uwah! I'm sorry!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Ува! Мне жаль!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: W-What's going on here?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Ч-что здесь происходит?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Hey, girls. Ines broke a goblet used in our services.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Привет, девочки. Инес разбила кубок, который использовался в наших службах.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: I'm sorry. My hand just slipped!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Мне жаль. Моя рука просто соскользнула!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Just? You need to be more responsible!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Только? Вам нужно быть более ответственным!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: I think that's enough, Chloe. No need to be so hard on her!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Я думаю, этого достаточно, Хлоя. Не надо с ней так строго обращаться!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Everyone makes a mistake sometimes. No need to get vindictive!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Каждый иногда совершает ошибку. Не надо мстить!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Sister Pamela... But...!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Сестра Памела... Но...!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Hehe, it's all right. Lydie and Sue here will make us another goblet, won't you girls?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Хе-хе, все в порядке. Лиди и Сью сделают нам еще один кубок, не так ли, девочки?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: That's right! We can whip up one of those in... hold on, us?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Это верно! Мы можем подстегнуть одного из тех, кто... подожди, мы?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Why are you pushing this on to us?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Зачем вы нам это навязываете?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Oh? You don't want to help?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Ой? Вы не хотите помочь?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Ah, those sparkling eyes! That's a low blow!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Ах, эти сверкающие глаза! Это удар ниже пояса!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Fine! Fine! We'll make this goblet, if we must!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Отлично! Отлично! Если понадобится, мы сделаем этот кубок!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: So please, Chloe, don't make things any harder on Ines.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Так что, пожалуйста, Хлоя, не усложняй жизнь Инес.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Fine, I won't. If that's what all of you think.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Хорошо, я не буду. Если вы все так думаете.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Looks like you're off the hook, Ines.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Похоже, ты сошла с крючка, Инес.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: That's right!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Это верно!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: All right! Please go ahead and make the goblet!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Все в порядке! Пожалуйста, сделайте кубок!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..original: Hehe!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_030..translation: Хе-хе!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Ah, what a lovely goblet! Thank you, both of you!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Ах, какой чудесный кубок! Спасибо вам обоим!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Let me thank you too! You really saved me, Lydie, Sue!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Позвольте и мне поблагодарить вас! Вы действительно спасли меня, Лиди, Сью!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: They've made this lovely new goblet, so be sure not to break it again, understand?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Они сделали этот прекрасный новый кубок, так что не разбивай его снова, понимаешь?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: I'm sorry for being so hard on you before.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Мне жаль, что я был так строг с тобой раньше.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Thank you!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Спасибо!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Uwah, hey! No hugging on church grounds!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Увау, эй! Никаких объятий на территории церкви!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: I'm so happy!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Я так счастлив!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Hehehe!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Хе-хе-хе!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Thank goodness for that. Another case closed!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Слава богу за это. Еще одно дело закрыто!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: It looks that way.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Это выглядит именно так.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Ah, Sister Grace! Hello!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Ах, Сестра Грейс! Привет!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Hello. Pamela really is a wonderful nun, isn't she?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Привет. Памела действительно замечательная монахиня, не так ли?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Covering for other's failures, improving relationships while solving the issue...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Прикрытие чужих неудач, улучшение отношений и решение вопроса...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: She comes across as kind of an airhead, and it can be very deceptive. But she's rather clever indeed.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Она производит впечатление легкомысленной, и это может быть очень обманчиво. Но она действительно довольно умна.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Hahaha! It might be rude to say "actually", but actually she's very reliable!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Возможно, грубо говорить «на самом деле», но на самом деле она очень надежная!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: I guess so. She just comes across as not all there sometimes!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Полагаю, что так. Просто иногда она производит впечатление не все здесь!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Which is just something that makes her so special.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Это то, что делает ее такой особенной.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: What was that?! It sounds like something just broke!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Что это было?! Кажется, что-то только что сломалось!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Ines! Not again!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Инес! Не снова!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: I-I-It wasn't me this time! Not me!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Я-я-это был не я на этот раз! Не я!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: So who... ah!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Так кто... ах!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Ah!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Ах!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Don't tell me, Pamela?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Не рассказывай мне, Памела?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Hehe! Sorry!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Хе-хе! Извини!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Chloe
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: What?! Pamela, what just happened?!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Что?! Памела, что только что произошло?!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: I'm sorry... My hand just slipped!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Мне очень жаль... Моя рука просто соскользнула!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Ines
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Maybe we can just make it stick together with something? Do you think that might work?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Может быть, мы можем просто склеить его чем-нибудь? Как вы думаете, это может сработать?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: It makes her special, all right!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Это делает ее особенной, да!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..original: Hahaha, yeah... That's it for our involvement in this, I think!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_040..translation: Ха-ха-ха, да... Вот и всё, думаю, с нашим участием в этом!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Hey, girls. I've got something I want to ask.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Привет, девочки. У меня есть кое-что, что я хочу спросить.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Is there anything that I don't have in stock that you would like to see in the shop?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Есть ли что-то, чего у меня нет в наличии, и что вы хотели бы видеть в магазине?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Hmm, nothing really comes to mind... What about you, Sue?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Хм, ничего особенного не приходит на ум... А ты, Сью?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: No, nothing really... "Mom's shop" has pretty much everything we need...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Нет, ничего особенного... В "Мамином магазине" есть практически все, что нам нужно...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: What was that? "Mom's"?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Что это было? "Мамин"?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Ah! I'm sorry! Pamela! Pamela's shop!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Ах! Мне жаль! Памела! Магазин Памелы!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Hahaha! Sue, you put your foot in your mouth this time!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Сью, на этот раз ты засунула ногу в рот!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Uwah! I can't believe I just said that...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Ува! Не могу поверить, что я только что это сказал...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Hehe. I sort of can understand why, though...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Хе-хе. Хотя я вроде как понимаю почему...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Pamela is so kind, and she smells nice too... She's like a mom.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Памела такая добрая, и от нее приятно пахнет... Она как мама.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Yeah, that's right. I've kind of thought of Pamela being very mother-like for a while now.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Да, это так. Я уже некоторое время думаю, что Памела очень похожа на мать.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Oh my! That makes me very happy!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: О боже! Это меня очень радует!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Lydie! Sue! You can call me "mom" as much as you like!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Лиди! Сью! Ты можешь называть меня «мама» сколько угодно!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Go ahead, give it a try! Call me mom!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Давай, попробуй! Позвони мне, мама!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Very well... Ahem. Mom!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Очень хорошо... Кхм. Мама!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Mom! Ah, it sounds better than I thought.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Мама! Ах, это звучит лучше, чем я думал.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: I'm right here, girls! Yes, I quite like the sound of that!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Я здесь, девочки! Да, мне очень нравится это звучание!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Maybe we'll call you mom every now and then?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Может, будем время от времени называть тебя мамой?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Say, Mommy dearest... Can you also give us a discount?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Скажи, мамочка дорогая... А можешь нам тоже скидку сделать?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..original: Hehehe! Not a chance!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_050..translation: Хе-хе-хе! Нет шансов!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Ah, I've got one question. What's your hometown like, Pamela?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Ах, у меня есть один вопрос. Какой твой родной город, Памела?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: It's a long way from here. Everyone is so kind, though, it's a lovely place!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Это далеко отсюда. Но все такие добрые, это прекрасное место!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Lydie
