ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Wow. A place just like you, Pamela!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Ух ты. Место, похожее на тебя, Памела!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Uwah, Lydie! We don't usually compare people and places, do we?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Ух ты, Лиди! Мы обычно не сравниваем людей и места, не так ли?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Haha, I was just trying something out. I bet it is a wonderful place, though.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Ха-ха, я просто попробовал кое-что. Могу поспорить, что это чудесное место.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Well, I haven't been back for a long time. Five years? Ten? Something like that.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Ну, я давно не возвращался. Пять лет? Десять? Что-то в этом роде.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Hold on... Sorry if I'm being rude, but how old are you, Pamela?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Подожди... Извини, если я груб, но сколько тебе лет, Памела?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Thinking about it now, you don't seem to have changed at all from when we first met you!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Если подумать об этом сейчас, то кажется, что ты совсем не изменился с тех пор, как мы впервые тебя встретили!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Good point! Are you the same age as Sister Grace?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Хороший вопрос! Вы одного возраста с Сестрой Грейс?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Hahaha, I didn't think so. Sister Grace looks young, but she's in her 50s...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я так не думал. Сестра Грейс выглядит молодо, но ей уже за 50...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: I'm much, much older than Grace. I guess I'm 200? 300?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Я намного старше Грейс. Кажется, мне 200? 300?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: ...Huh? Could you say that one more time, Pamela?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: ...Хм? Не могли бы вы сказать это еще раз, Памела?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Pamela, sorry... I can borrow you for a moment?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Памела, извини... Могу тебя одолжить на минутку?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: Yes, of course. Sorry girls, we'll have to pick this up another time.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Да, конечно. Извините, девочки, нам придется обсудить это в другой раз.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: She said 300, but she was just joking, right?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Она сказала 300, но она просто пошутила, да?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..original: H-Has to be... A joke! Just a joke! Hahaha!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_060..translation: Х-должно быть... Шутка! Просто шутка! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Ah!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Ах!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Uwah, I did it again...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Ух, я сделал это снова...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Are you alright, Lydie? It's been a while since you failed so badly!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: С тобой все в порядке, Лиди? Давненько ты так сильно не проигрывал!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Yeah... That thing Pamela said has been on my mind.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Да... То, что сказала Памела, было у меня на уме.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: What, about being 300 years old? Hahaha, that was just a Pamela-style joke!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: А что насчет того, что тебе 300 лет? Ха-ха-ха, это была просто шутка в стиле Памелы!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: She came out with it really smoothly, for it to be a joke... Maybe Pamela is actually a ghost?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: У нее это получилось очень гладко, чтобы это была шутка... Может быть, Памела на самом деле призрак?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: No, that can't be. It can't!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Нет, этого не может быть. Не может!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Maybe, it could?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Может быть, могло бы?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Uwaaaaah! P-P-P-Pamela! W-What are you doing here?!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Уваааа! П-п-п-Памела! Ч-что ты здесь делаешь?!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: I didn't hear the door open! Did you come in through the window?!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Я не слышал, как открылась дверь! Ты зашёл через окно?!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: No, I came through the door. Quite literally through it! Wooooh!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Нет, я вошел через дверь. Буквально через это! Оооо!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Uwah! So you really are a g-g-g-g...!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Ува! Так ты действительно г-г-г-г...!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: That's right! I'm a ghost!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Это верно! Я призрак!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Howah!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Хауа!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Sue! Come back to us!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Сью! Вернитесь к нам!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Oh my... I just wanted to get some more ink?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: О боже... Я просто хотел взять еще чернил?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: I'll leave the papers here... I hope you can take care of it for me!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Я оставлю бумаги здесь... Надеюсь, ты позаботишься обо мне!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Aaaaaaah, don't look! Don't look! She ghosted her way out of here again! Noooooo!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Аааааа, не смотри! Не смотри! Она снова ускользнула отсюда! Неееееет!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Calm down! It's okay, calm down! Everything is okay!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Успокоиться! Все в порядке, успокойся! Все в порядке!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Uwaaaah! I can't take any more! I can't believeeeee anything any moooooore!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Уваааа! Я больше не могу! Я ни во что не могу поверить, мууууу!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..original: Sue! You can believe in me! Sue!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_070..translation: Сью! Ты можешь поверить в меня! Сью!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Pamela? Here's the ink you asked for.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Памела? Вот чернила, которые вы просили.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Hehehe, thank you. Now I can make some new products!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Хе-хе-хе, спасибо. Теперь я могу делать новые продукты!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Why is Sue hiding behind you like that?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Почему Сью так прячется за тобой?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: A g-g-g-ghost! I'm scared of ghosts! I'm scared of Pamela being a ghost!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Призрак! Я боюсь привидений! Я боюсь, что Памела станет призраком!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Is it true, what you said before? That you're a ghost?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Это правда то, что вы сказали раньше? Что ты призрак?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Yes, it's true! I'm a real ghost, 100%!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Да, это правда! Я настоящий призрак, 100%!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Oh dear, has Sue been triggered again? It's alright, it's all fine!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: О боже, Сью снова разозлилась? Все в порядке, все в порядке!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Hmmm... This might be a problem.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: If you're so scared of me already... What would happen if I really tried to scare you...?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Если ты уже так меня боишься... Что произойдет, если я действительно попытаюсь тебя напугать...?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Gyaaaah! Nooo! I understand! I'm not scared anymore! Don't scare me!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Даааа! Нееет! Я понимаю! Я больше не боюсь! Не пугай меня!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Good. There's nothing to fear. La-la-la!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Aaaah! I'm not scared... I'm not! Pamela is still Pamela! Pam-Pam-Pam-Pam...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Аааа! Я не боюсь... Нет! Памела остается Памелой! Пам-Пам-Пам-Пам...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..original: Ghosts seem to be more common than I expected. I'll need to remember this.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_080..translation: Призраки, кажется, встречаются чаще, чем я ожидал. Мне нужно будет это запомнить.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Pamela! We're here to check if ghosts really don't have legs...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Памела! Мы здесь, чтобы проверить, действительно ли у призраков нет ног...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: You are more than qualified. Please, Pamela.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Вы более чем компетентны. Пожалуйста, Памела.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Will you become Head Sister, and lead this church into an even better future?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Станете ли вы старшей сестрой и поведете эту церковь к еще лучшему будущему?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: H-Head Sister? I wonder what Pamela will do?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: H-главная сестра? Интересно, что сделает Памела?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Thank you for the offer, but I can't accept...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Спасибо за предложение, но я не могу принять...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Why? I know you're perfect for this!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Почему? Я знаю, ты идеально подходишь для этого!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: No, I don't agree. I'm sure you can do a much better job, Grace!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Нет, я не согласен. Я уверен, что ты справишься гораздо лучше, Грейс!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Look at Chloe, at Ines. Everyone holds you in such high regard, Grace!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Посмотрите на Хлою, на Инес. Все очень уважают тебя, Грейс!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: So, please, you should remain the Head Sister. All right?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Так что, пожалуйста, останьтесь старшей сестрой. Все в порядке?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: I see... In which case, very well. I won't say any more about it.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Понятно... В таком случае, очень хорошо. Я больше ничего об этом не скажу.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Grace
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: But you'll still let me consult with you on the direction the church should take, of course?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Но вы, конечно, позволите мне посоветоваться с вами о том, в каком направлении должна двигаться церковь?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Of course! You can leave that to me, no problem!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Конечно! Можешь оставить это мне, без проблем!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: So she turned it down, but that was so cool.
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Поэтому она отказалась, но это было так круто.

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Yeah! It really got me! I guess those 300 years make all the difference!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Ага! Меня это действительно зацепило! Я думаю, эти 300 лет имеют решающее значение!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: What? 300 years? Lydie, what are you talking about?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Что? 300 лет? Лидия, о чём ты говоришь?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Excuse me? What are YOU talking about? Remember, she told us herself? Pamela's a ghost...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Прошу прощения? О чем ты говоришь? Помните, она сама нам рассказала? Памела - призрак...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Hahaha, a ghost?! Have you been dreaming?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Sue, don't tell me... You've erased your own memory?!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Сью, не говори мне... Ты стерла себе память?!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..original: Human defense mechanisms at work. Honestly, I guess Sue is better off this way!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_090..translation: Защитные механизмы человека в действии. Честно говоря, я думаю, Сью так будет лучше!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Hold on... Hold on there!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Подожди... Подожди!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: W-What's up, Pamela? Something seems to have seriously surprised you...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Ч-что случилось, Памела? Кажется, что-то вас серьезно удивило...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Guess what! It seems sales at my shop have reached my target figure!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Угадай, что! Кажется, продажи в моем магазине достигли запланированной цифры!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Wow, that's great! Congratulations!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Вау, это здорово! Поздравляем!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Thank you! Hahaha! This is thanks to all of your purchases, too!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Спасибо! Ха-ха-ха! И это тоже благодаря всем вашим покупкам!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: I've set aside money for gifts this time. Now I can finally go back home!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: На этот раз я отложил деньги на подарки. Теперь я наконец могу вернуться домой!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: I see... You've made your money, so it's time to move on?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Понятно... Ты заработал деньги, пора двигаться дальше?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Yeah. We're going to be sad!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Ага. Нам будет грустно!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Say, Pamela! One last time... Could we call you mom again, one last time?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Скажи, Памела! В последний раз... Можем ли мы снова называть тебя мамой, в последний раз?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Yes, of course!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Да, конечно!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Together
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Mom!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Мама!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: System
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Mom!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Мама!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Ah! That settles it!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Ах! Это решает вопрос!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: I'm going to become a nun who travels between both Kirchen Bell and Merveille!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Я собираюсь стать монахиней и путешествовать между Кирхен-Белл и Мервейль!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: What?! I'm happy to hear that, but are you sure?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Что?! Я рад это слышать, но ты уверен?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: It will be exhausting, so no, I'm not, but if I get serious I should be able to manage it!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Это будет утомительно, так что нет, это не так, но если я буду серьёзен, то смогу с этим справиться!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: I'm really starting to like this place, after all. And I want to see the two of you grow up!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: В конце концов, мне действительно начинает нравиться это место. И я хочу увидеть, как вы двое вырастете!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: So I'm going to use all my powers and just fly there and back!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Так что я собираюсь использовать все свои силы и просто летать туда и обратно!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Ah, of course! You can fly because you're a ghost!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Ах, конечно! Ты умеешь летать, потому что ты призрак!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Fly?... A ghost?... H-Hold on... Scaring... I feel like I'm about to remember something...!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Лететь?... Призрак?... П-подожди... Страшно... Такое ощущение, что я вот-вот что-то вспомню...!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Uwaah! Uwaaaaaaaaah!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Уваа! Увааааааа!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Kyaah, Sue! Are you okay?! Water, get some water!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Дааа, Сью! Ты в порядке?! Вода, принеси воды!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Hmm... What should I do with all the money I've made, though?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Хм... Но что мне делать со всеми заработанными мной деньгами?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Buy lots of gifts, I guess! Hmm, what would be best?
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Думаю, накупить побольше подарков! Хм, что было бы лучше?

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Pamela
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: I hope everyone in Kirchen Bell is doing well!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Я надеюсь, что у всех в Кирхен-Белл все хорошо!

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: A ghost... I can't take this... Pamela is scary. Mom is a ghost. I want to like her, but...
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Призрак... Я не вынесу этого... Памела пугает. Мама - призрак. Я хочу, чтобы она мне нравилась, но...

ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..original: Someone! Anyone! Sue! Sue!
ebm:qc18_pam/event_message_qc18_pam_100..translation: Кто-то! Любой! Сью! Сью!

ebm:xf01/event_message_xf01_010.ebm:0.speaker: System
ebm:xf01/event_message_xf01_010.ebm:0.original: A new Combination Art for Mathias and Alt <CLEG>"Einzelkampf"<CLNR> is unlocked.
ebm:xf01/event_message_xf01_010.ebm:0.translation: Разблокировано новое Комбинированное искусство для Матиаса и Альт <CLEG> «Einzelkampf»<CLNR>.

ebm:xf01/event_message_xf01_030.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xf01/event_message_xf01_030.ebm:0.original: ...The Fire Dragon... it's too strong. I don't think we can defeat it on our own...
ebm:xf01/event_message_xf01_030.ebm:0.translation: ...Огненный Дракон... он слишком силен. Я не думаю, что мы сможем победить его в одиночку...

ebm:xf01/event_message_xf01_030.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:xf01/event_message_xf01_030.ebm:1.original: Ugh... It hurts to say it, but you might be right. There must be a smarter way...
ebm:xf01/event_message_xf01_030.ebm:1.translation: Ух... Больно это говорить, но, возможно, ты прав. Должен быть более разумный способ...

ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_140.ebm:0.speaker: Alt's Passionate Fan
ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_140.ebm:0.original: Ah, you're back! Let the fighting begin again!
ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_140.ebm:0.translation: Ах, ты вернулся! Пусть боевые действия начнутся снова!

ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_150.ebm:0.speaker: Alt's Passionate Fan
ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_150.ebm:0.original: That was fun! Thanks for playing with me! Here's a token of my thanks. Haaaaaaaaaah! Hah!
ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_150.ebm:0.translation: Это было весело! Спасибо, что играете со мной! Вот знак моей благодарности. Хаааааааа! Ха!

ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_150.ebm:1.speaker: Alt's Passionate Fan
ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_150.ebm:1.original: Right, I'm going to nap for a while. Please do come again.
ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_150.ebm:1.translation: Ладно, я собираюсь немного вздремнуть. Пожалуйста, приходите еще раз.

ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_190.ebm:0.speaker: Firis
ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_190.ebm:0.original: Hehehe. What do you say about some special training with me?
ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_190.ebm:0.translation: Хе-хе-хе. Что ты скажешь о какой-то специальной тренировке со мной?

ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_190.ebm:1.speaker: Firis
ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_190.ebm:1.original: Ugh! There's no one but me here! I can't just fight myself!
ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_190.ebm:1.translation: Фу! Здесь нет никого, кроме меня! Я не могу просто бороться с собой!

ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_200.ebm:0.speaker: Firis
ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_200.ebm:0.original: Uwah, I lost? I'll win next time, you'll see!
ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_200.ebm:0.translation: Ух, я проиграл? В следующий раз я выиграю, вот увидишь!

ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_210.ebm:0.speaker: Firis
ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_210.ebm:0.original: Heheh, you've still got a way to go! Come back any time!
ebm:xf02/event_message_xf02_210.ebm:0.translation: Хе-хе, тебе еще есть куда идти! Возвращайся в любое время!

ebm:xf04/event_message_xf04_060.ebm:2.original: <CLEG>Sand Crystals<CLNR>, <CLEG>White Ash Stone<CLNR> and <CLEG>Leiden Ore<CLNR> received.
ebm:xf04/event_message_xf04_060.ebm:2.translation: <CLEG>Кристаллы песка<CLNR>, <CLEG>Камень белого ясеня<CLNR> и <CLEG>Лейденская руда<CLNR> получены.

ebm:xf04/event_message_xf04_100.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xf04/event_message_xf04_100.ebm:0.original: (Ah! Mom's secret stash of money! Thanks Mom, I know just what to use this for!)
ebm:xf04/event_message_xf04_100.ebm:0.translation: (Ах! Мама, тайный запас денег! Спасибо, мама, я знаю, для чего их использовать!)

ebm:xf04/event_message_xf04_100.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:xf04/event_message_xf04_100.ebm:1.original: (Hey! This is Mom's secret stash o' cash! Thanks Mom, I'll make good use of it!)
ebm:xf04/event_message_xf04_100.ebm:1.translation: (Эй! Это мамин секретный запас денег! Спасибо, мама, я им воспользуюсь!)

ebm:xf05/event_message_xf05_060.ebm:0.speaker: System
ebm:xf05/event_message_xf05_060.ebm:0.original: The installation of the required data is not complete. Unable to proceed.
ebm:xf05/event_message_xf05_060.ebm:0.translation: Установка необходимых данных не завершена. Невозможно продолжить.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:0.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:0.original: Whispering voices mutter rumors from amid the trees.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:0.translation: Шепчущие голоса доносят слухи из-за деревьев.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:1.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:1.original: From the glooming darkness, you sense the eyes of someone,<CR>something... watching you.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:1.translation: Из мрачной тьмы ты чувствуешь чьи-то глаза, <CR>что-то… наблюдающее за тобой.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:2.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:2.original: Looking around, those gnarly trees are all you can see.<CR>All who visit this place are bound to feel the same breath of fear.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:2.translation: Оглянувшись вокруг, вы увидите только эти корявые деревья.<CR>Все, кто посещают это место, обязательно почувствуют одно и то же дыхание страха.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:3.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:3.original: And with good reason. For this place is the intersection<CR>between the world of living and the spectral plain.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:3.translation: И не без оснований. Ибо это место является пересечением<CR>между миром живых и призрачной равниной.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:4.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:4.original: This is the Spooky Forest.<CR>Beware of the tricks that might be played on you here...
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_010.ebm:4.translation: Это Жуткий Лес.<CR>Остерегайтесь шуток, которые могут быть с вами здесь сыграны...

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:0.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:0.original: A tranquil and cold grotto of eternal winter.<CR>Here bloom the ice flowers of crystals.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:0.translation: Спокойный и холодный грот вечной зимы.<CR>Здесь цветут ледяные цветы кристаллов.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:1.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:1.original: The passage of time has polished the ice walls clear,<CR>unleashing relentless glimmer.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:1.translation: С течением времени ледяные стены отполировались до чистоты, <CR>высвобождая неумолимое мерцание.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:2.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:2.original: They almost look like a glossy mirror.<CR>However, you'll have no time to stop and admire your reflection.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:2.translation: Они почти похожи на глянцевое зеркало.<CR>Однако у вас не будет времени остановиться и полюбоваться своим отражением.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:3.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:3.original: Just as every rose has its thorn,<CR>dark shadows watch intently from between the frosty blossoms.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:3.translation: Как у каждой розы есть шип,<CR>так и тёмные тени пристально наблюдают из-за морозных цветов.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:4.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:4.original: The Luminous Ice Grotto is guarded by the Ruler of Hoarfrost.<CR>So what kind of future does the ice here truly reflect?...
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_020.ebm:4.translation: Светящийся Ледяной Грот охраняет Повелитель Инея.<CR>Так какое будущее на самом деле отражает здешний лед?...

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:0.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:0.original: With a grating roar, there pours forth a rain of vivid red.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:0.translation: С резким ревом льется ярко-красный дождь.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:1.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:1.original: The endless, tumbling flow of molten rock scorches the sky,<CR>parches the land, becoming a sea of fire.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:1.translation: Бесконечный, падающий поток расплавленной породы опаляет небо, <CR> высушивает землю, превращаясь в море огня.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:2.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:2.original: Amid this tumult of engulfing flame,<CR>no seed of life can hope to find purchase.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:2.translation: Среди этого буйства охватывающего пламени <CR>ни одно семя жизни не может надеяться найти опору.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:3.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:3.original: Backed by dragon's roars, this world heads into destruction.<CR>Will you stand witness to that fate?
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:3.translation: Под реву дракона этот мир движется к разрушению.<CR>Сможете ли вы стать свидетелем этой судьбы?

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:4.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:4.original: Land of the red apocalypse, The Great Cascades of Anfel.<CR>If only some salvation could be found...
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_030.ebm:4.translation: Земля красного апокалипсиса, Великие каскады Анфела.<CR>Если бы только можно было найти какое-то спасение...

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:0.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:0.original: A white forest, and a frozen manor standing silently<CR>among the frost covered trees​.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:0.translation: Белый лес и замёрзшая усадьба, молча стоящая<CR> среди покрытых инеем деревьев.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:1.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:1.original: The floor, walls, and even time, are all frozen here,<CR>simply existing, encased in a rime of ice.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:1.translation: Пол, стены и даже время здесь заморожены, <CR>просто существуют, окруженные инеем льда.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:2.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:2.original: A lone girl lives in the spacious manor,<CR>but her heart, too, is frozen shut in the ice.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:2.translation: В просторном поместье живет одинокая девушка, <CR>, но ее сердце тоже замерзло во льду.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:3.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:3.original: Which would make sense. For she is the one<CR>who created this cold world, just as she wished it to be.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:3.translation: Это имело бы смысл. Потому что именно она<CR> создала этот холодный мир таким, каким она хотела его видеть.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:4.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:4.original: The Frozen Palace, created by a certain girl...<CR>Will a thaw ever come to this icebound land?
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_040.ebm:4.translation: Ледяной дворец, созданный некой девушкой...<CR>Придет ли когда-нибудь оттепель на эту скованную льдом землю?

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:0.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:0.original: The ocean, heaving with raging waves.<CR>Above it flutters the black flag of a pirate vessel.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:0.translation: Океан, вздымающийся бушующими волнами.<CR>Над ним развевается черный флаг пиратского судна.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:1.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:1.original: In these brigand infested waters, there is known a legend<CR>of one pirate who rose above all others.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:1.translation: В этих кишащих разбойниками водах известна легенда<CR> об одном пирате, который возвысился над всеми остальными.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:2.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:2.original: Setting aflame anything in his way, and drowning in riches,<CR>there was one known by the name... Burning Backen.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:2.translation: Поджигая все на своем пути и тонув в богатстве,<CR>был один, известный по имени... Пылающий Бакен.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:3.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:3.original: All pirates still seek his most valuable treasures,<CR>hidden somewhere in a cave below the sea waters.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:3.translation: Все пираты до сих пор ищут его самые ценные сокровища,<CR>спрятанные где-то в пещере под морскими водами.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:4.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:4.original: The so-called Treasury at the Sea Bottom,<CR>where the great pirate treasure supposedly still slumbers...
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_050.ebm:4.translation: Так называемая Сокровищница на морском дне, <CR>, где предположительно до сих пор дремлет великое пиратское сокровище...

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:0.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:0.original: In reality, time can only move one way.<CR>Like an arrow, it simply shoots forward.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:0.translation: На самом деле время может двигаться только в одну сторону.<CR>Как стрела, оно просто устремляется вперёд.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:1.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:1.original: But what if a world existed in which that was not the case?<CR>If you could meet your lost past again?
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:1.translation: Но что, если бы существовал мир, в котором это было не так?<CR>Если бы вы могли снова встретиться со своим потерянным прошлым?

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:2.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:2.original: Joy, anger, sadness, pleasures.<CR>What time of their life would a traveler seek to encounter again?
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:2.translation: Радость, гнев, печаль, удовольствия.<CR>Какое время своей жизни путешественник хотел бы увидеть снова?

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:3.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:3.original: However, one thing must never be forgotten.<CR>The past is gone. And it can never be changed.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:3.translation: Однако никогда нельзя забывать одну вещь.<CR>Прошлое ушло. И это никогда не изменить.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:4.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:4.original: This fickle depiction of time, "Etel Nepica".<CR>When faced with the ghosts of the time past, how will you react?
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_060.ebm:4.translation: Это непостоянное изображение времени, «Этель Непика».<CR>Как вы отреагируете, столкнувшись с призраками прошлого?

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:0.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:0.original: This is a painting created by someone I love.<CR>Someone who thinks so much of me. A special place.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:0.translation: Это картина, созданная человеком, которого я люблю.<CR>Тем, кто так много обо мне думает. Особое место.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:1.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:1.original: The floating clouds, and the flower fields swaying in the breeze.<CR>All so lovely, and so wonderful.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:1.translation: Плывущие облака и цветочные поля, колышущиеся на ветру.<CR>Все так мило и так чудесно.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:2.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:2.original: But even here, in this fabulous place,<CR>I can still feel a hole left in my heart.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:2.translation: Но даже здесь, в этом сказочном месте,<CR>я всё ещё чувствую дыру в своём сердце.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:3.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:3.original: My treasures, the ones capable of filling that hole,<CR>have been gone from my life for too long.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:3.translation: Мои сокровища, способные заполнить эту дыру, <CR> слишком надолго исчезли из моей жизни.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:4.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:4.original: I will walk these flower fields again today,<CR>hoping to see even a glimpse of them. Hoping for a miracle.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:4.translation: Сегодня я снова пройдусь по этим цветочным полям,<CR>надеюсь увидеть их хотя бы мельком. Надеясь на чудо.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:5.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:5.original: A paradise of clouds and flowers. The "Heavenly Flower Garden".<CR>Lydie... Suelle... How are you both?
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_070.ebm:5.translation: Рай облаков и цветов. «Небесный цветочный сад».<CR>Лиди... Сюэль... Как вы обе?

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:0.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:0.original: A countless number of shiny star shards rained down on a vast plain.<CR>They were the blessings from the heavens that gave them life.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:0.translation: Бесчисленное количество блестящих осколков звезд упало на обширную равнину.<CR>Это были благословения небес, давшие им жизнь.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:1.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:1.original: The falling stars plow the land, become part of it,<CR>and cover the fields in a myriad of flowers to match the night sky.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:1.translation: Падающие звезды пашут землю, становятся ее частью<CR> и покрывают поля мириадами цветов, гармонирующих с ночным небом.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:2.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:2.original: Every night, the Star Flowers on the ground think of their birthplace above them.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:2.translation: Каждую ночь Звездные Цветы на земле думают о месте своего рождения над ними.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:3.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:3.original: They can never go back, but it seems so close, almost reachable,<CR>if only they were to spread their leaves far enough...
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:3.translation: Они никогда не смогут вернуться назад, но кажется, что это так близко, почти достижимо, <CR>, если бы только они раскинули свои листья достаточно далеко...

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:4.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:4.original: In Starlight Plain, both the land and the sky are full of stars,<CR>and their light illuminates the important things within your heart.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_080.ebm:4.translation: На Звездной равнине и земля, и небо полны звезд,<CR>, и их свет освещает важные вещи в вашем сердце.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_090.ebm:0.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_090.ebm:0.original: Powerful emotions can call on miracles. But, on the opposite side of the coin,<CR>they can also bring out unyielding crookedness.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_090.ebm:0.translation: Сильные эмоции могут вызвать чудеса. Но, с другой стороны, <CR> они также могут выявить непреклонную кривость.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_090.ebm:1.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_090.ebm:1.original: Here, lies endless darkness.<CR>Here, grieves the world painted over with black.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_090.ebm:1.translation: Здесь лежит бесконечная тьма.<CR>Здесь скорбит мир, закрашенный черным.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_090.ebm:2.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_090.ebm:2.original: Even the voice of bitter resentment will eventually dry out,<CR>sinking into nothingness with everything else.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_090.ebm:2.translation: Даже голос горькой обиды со временем засохнет, <CR> канет в небытие вместе со всем остальным.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_090.ebm:3.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_090.ebm:3.original: The Black Horizon. This is the conclusion of this Mysterious Painting<CR>of distorted and broken miracles, a world ruled only by black and white.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_090.ebm:3.translation: Черный горизонт. Таков вывод этой Таинственной Картины <CR> искаженных и разбитых чудес, мира, которым правят только черное и белое.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:0.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:0.original: This is a world created by a certain Goddess.<CR>As if painted by the final moments of the setting sun,<CR>this world is covered in darkness and crimson.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:0.translation: Это мир, созданный некой Богиней.<CR>Как будто нарисованный последними мгновениями заходящего солнца,<CR>этот мир покрыт тьмой и малиновым цветом.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:1.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:1.original: This is a world forged by a certain Goddess.<CR>A world of controversy, which rejects all intruders while craving for their company.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:1.translation: Это мир, созданный некой Богиней.<CR>Мир противоречий, который отвергает всех злоумышленников, но жаждет их компании.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:2.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:2.original: A holder of superfluous power,<CR>She wished to be surrounded by solitude, because of that power.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:2.translation: Обладательница избыточной силы,<CR>Она хотела быть окруженной одиночеством из-за этой силы.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:3.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:3.original: And yet, that solitude She had wished for,<CR>is now the very thing that suffocates her.
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:3.translation: И все же то одиночество, которого Она желала, <CR> теперь является именно тем, что душит ее.

ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:4.speaker: System
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:4.original: The Domain of Despair rejects any connections to the outside world,<CR>to protect the heart of its Crimson Goddess...
ebm:xf06/event_message_xf06_100.ebm:4.translation: Области Отчаяния отвергают любые связи с внешним миром, <CR>, чтобы защитить сердце своей Багровой Богини...

ebm:xx02/event_message_xx02_020.ebm:0.speaker: System
ebm:xx02/event_message_xx02_020.ebm:0.original: A new outfit has been unlocked and you now can use "Change Outfits"!
ebm:xx02/event_message_xx02_020.ebm:0.translation: Новый наряд был разблокирован, и теперь вы можете использовать «Сменить наряд»!

ebm:xx02/event_message_xx02_020.ebm:1.translation: Вы можете выбрать «Сменить наряд» на столе в ателье.

ebm:xx03/event_message_xx03_060.ebm:0.speaker: Sophie
ebm:xx03/event_message_xx03_060.ebm:0.original: Hey, listen. Do you want to try fighting me?
ebm:xx03/event_message_xx03_060.ebm:0.translation: Эй, послушай. Хочешь попробовать сразиться со мной?

ebm:xx03/event_message_xx03_060.ebm:1.speaker: Sophie
ebm:xx03/event_message_xx03_060.ebm:1.original: Eh? Hmmm... <CR>Fighting against myself is a little...
ebm:xx03/event_message_xx03_060.ebm:1.translation: Э? Хммм... <CR>Борьба с самим собой - это немного...

ebm:xx03/event_message_xx03_070.ebm:0.speaker: Sophie
ebm:xx03/event_message_xx03_070.ebm:0.original: Haha, you've all grown so strong... I'll have to train harder myself...
ebm:xx03/event_message_xx03_070.ebm:0.translation: Ха-ха, вы все стали такими сильными... Мне самому придется тренироваться усерднее...

ebm:xx03/event_message_xx03_080.ebm:0.speaker: Sophie
ebm:xx03/event_message_xx03_080.ebm:0.original: Okay, looks like I win. I'm happy to accept a rematch any time you like!
ebm:xx03/event_message_xx03_080.ebm:0.translation: Ладно, похоже, я выиграл. Я рад принять матч-реванш в любое удобное для вас время!

ebm:xx04/event_message_xx04_240.ebm:0.speaker: System

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:1.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:1.original: Oh, you've come at just the right time. I was just about to head to your atelier.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:1.translation: О, ты пришел как раз в нужное время. Я как раз собирался зайти в ваше ателье.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:2.original: Huh...? Our atelier?! You weren't going to give us our next task, were you?!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:2.translation: Хм...? Наше ателье?! Ты же не собирался дать нам следующее задание, не так ли?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:3.original: Augh! How terrible, Lydie! We've been caught completely unprepared! Arrghh!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:3.translation: Ох! Какой ужас, Лидия! Нас застали совершенно неподготовленными! Ааа!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:4.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:4.original: Wait a minute! Just calm down! Stop acting like I'm some monster who's always testing you!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:4.translation: Подождите минуту! Просто успокойся! Перестань вести себя так, будто я какой-то монстр, который постоянно тебя проверяет!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:5.original: Huh... But that's more or less true...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:7.original: U-Uh, nothing, nothing... But Ilmeria, if you didn't want to give us a new task, then why...?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:7.translation: Н-э-э, ничего, ничего... Но, Ильмерия, если ты не хотела давать нам новое задание, то почему...?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:8.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:8.original: Hmph, well, listen and be amazed. I wanted to come and offer to help you gather new materials!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:8.translation: Хм, ну слушай и удивляйся. Я хотела прийти и предложить помочь вам собрать новые материалы!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:9.original: Help us...? You mean, you're going to come with us?!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:9.translation: Помогите нам...? Ты имеешь в виду, ты собираешься пойти с нами?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:10.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:10.original: Precisely. Things have calmed down a little, so I thought I'd teach you the fundamentals of gathering up close.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:10.translation: Именно так. Ситуация немного успокоилась, поэтому я решил научить вас основам собираться поближе.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:11.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:11.original: Hehehe, be well aware that this won't be easy. Make a mistake, and you'll pay for it...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:11.translation: Хе-хе-хе, имейте в виду, что это будет непросто. Совершишь ошибку и заплатишь за это...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:15.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:15.original: Sue! Sue! We finally get to go on an adventure with our teacher!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:15.translation: Сью! Сью! Наконец-то мы отправимся в приключение с нашим учителем!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:16.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:16.original: I know, Lydie! Isn't it wonderful?! You always said you wanted to travel with Ilmeria!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:16.translation: Я знаю, Лидия! Разве это не чудесно?! Ты всегда говорил, что хочешь путешествовать с Ильмерией!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:17.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:17.original: That's right! It's always been my dream... to go places with her, and gather materials with her...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:17.translation: Это верно! Я всегда мечтал... ходить с ней куда-нибудь и собирать с ней материалы...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:22.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:22.original: ...Hehe, then leave it to me! After all, I am your teacher.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:22.translation: ...Хе-хе, тогда предоставь это мне! Ведь я твой учитель.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:23.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:23.original: Just sit back and trust that you're in good hands... Lydie, Sue, let's make the most of this!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_010.ebm:23.translation: Просто расслабьтесь и верьте, что вы в надежных руках... Лиди, Сью, давайте извлекем из этого максимум пользы!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:1.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:1.original: Wh-What's the matter? Why did you start sulking as soon as you saw me...?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:1.translation: Ч-что случилось? Почему ты начал дуться, как только увидел меня...?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:2.original: Hahaha, well, here's the thing... You're really strong, right, Ilmeria?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:2.translation: Ха-ха-ха, ну вот в чем дело... Ты очень сильная, да, Ильмерия?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:3.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:3.original: Well, yes, I suppose. I can certainly handle most monsters you'll come across round these parts.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:3.translation: Ну да, я полагаю. Я, конечно, смогу справиться с большинством монстров, которых вы встретите в этих местах.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:4.original: That's the problem. That's why Sue's a little upset...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:4.translation: В этом проблема. Вот почему Сью немного расстроена...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:6.original: ...If you're so strong, then why didn't you help us until now?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:6.translation: ...Если ты такой сильный, то почему ты не помог нам до сих пор?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:7.original: If you had helped us, our investigations of the paintings would have been so much easier! Hmph!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:7.translation: Если бы вы нам помогли, наши исследования картин были бы намного проще! Хм!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:8.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:8.original: Oh, I see. You don't seem to understand my intent. There was an important reason for me not to help you!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:8.translation: Ага, понятно. Кажется, ты не понимаешь моих намерений. У меня была важная причина не помогать вам!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:10.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:10.original: Precisely! If you have your teacher by your side all the time, and rely on them, it would hamper your development.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:10.translation: Именно так! Если ваш учитель все время будет рядом с вами и вы будете полагаться на него, это будет препятствовать вашему развитию.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:11.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:11.original: That's why I decided not to go with you. Even though it tore me up inside. Can't you appreciate the sacrifice I made?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:11.translation: Вот почему я решил не идти с тобой. Хоть это и разрывало меня изнутри. Разве ты не можешь оценить ту жертву, которую я принес?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:12.original: Teacher... That's all nice, but you should tell us the truth...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:12.translation: Учитель... Это всё хорошо, но вы должны сказать нам правду...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:14.original: I knew it! You see - you put your work before your students! That's why I'm so upset! Hmph!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:14.translation: Я знал это! Видите ли, вы ставите свою работу выше своих учеников! Вот почему я так расстроен! Хм!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:15.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:15.original: D-Don't be so demanding! I'm helping you now, aren't I?! Be satisfied with that!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:15.translation: Д-Не будь таким требовательным! Я помогаю тебе сейчас, не так ли?! Будьте довольны этим!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:16.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:16.original: I mean... I also wish I could have spent more time with you...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:16.translation: Я имею в виду... мне бы тоже хотелось проводить с тобой больше времени...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:17.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:17.original: ...Hehe. Come on, Sue. Let's cut our teacher some slack, okay?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:17.translation: ...Хе-хе. Давай, Сью. Давай послабимся с нашим учителем, ладно?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:18.original: You know full well how busy she's been. Right, Sue?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:18.translation: Ты прекрасно знаешь, насколько она занята. Верно, Сью?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:19.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:19.original: ...I wasn't really that angry to begin with. But you have to make us a promise, as our teacher!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:19.translation: ...Поначалу я не был так уж зол. Но вы должны дать нам обещание, как наш учитель!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:20.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:20.original: From now on, we come first, not your other work! Okay?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:20.translation: Отныне на первом месте мы, а не другая ваша работа! Хорошо?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:21.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:21.original: Haha, you really are demanding... All right, I understand.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:21.translation: Ха-ха, ты очень требовательна... Ладно, я понимаю.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:22.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:22.original: I promise I'll go with you wherever you want to go. Is that what you want?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:22.translation: Обещаю, я пойду с тобой, куда бы ты ни пожелал. Это то, чего ты хочешь?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:24.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:24.original: ...Oh, and one more thing. You have to bring some sweets! And something to drink would be nice, too...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:24.translation: ... Да, и еще кое-что. Надо принести сладостей! Да и попить было бы неплохо...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:25.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:25.original: Hey! I'm not your servant, you know! I'm not doing that!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:25.translation: Привет! Я не твой слуга, ты знаешь! Я этого не делаю!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:26.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:26.original: Hmph, I knew you were cheap! Can't you even do that much for us?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:26.translation: Хм, я знал, что ты дешевка! Неужели ты не можешь сделать для нас так много?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:27.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:27.original: No! I'm the teacher, you're my students! If anyone should be bringing treats along, it should be you...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_020.ebm:27.translation: Нет! Я учитель, вы мои ученики! Если кто-то и должен принести с собой угощения, так это вы...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:1.original: Oh, Ilmeria? What are you doing here in the gallery?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:1.translation: О, Ильмерия? Что ты делаешь здесь, в галерее?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:2.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:2.original: Ah, there you both are. I've been conducting a little research of my own into the Mysterious Paintings.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:2.translation: Ах, вот вы оба. Я провожу небольшое собственное исследование Таинственных Картин.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:3.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:3.original: I've ended up leaving all the work to you so far... But, as an alchemist, I am fascinated by them as well.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:3.translation: В итоге я пока оставил всю работу вам... Но, как алхимик, я тоже ими очарован.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:4.original: Oh, that's our teacher! Always passionate about learning!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:4.translation: О, это наш учитель! Всегда с желанием учиться!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:5.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:5.original: Well, of course. But the thing is, I have a little bit of a problem...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:5.translation: Ну, конечно. Но дело в том, что у меня есть небольшая проблема...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:7.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:7.original: It's the Paintings. They're all kept here, right? It's tiresome to have to come all the way to the castle to see them...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:7.translation: Это Картины. Они все хранятся здесь, верно? Утомительно ехать до самого замка, чтобы увидеть их...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:8.original: I see... I suppose you do have a point...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:9.original: It would be easier to investigate them if they were closer to hand...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:9.translation: Было бы легче исследовать их, если бы они были поближе...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:10.original: Hehehe, dear teacher. Leave everything to me.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:10.translation: Хе-хе-хе, дорогой учитель. Оставьте все мне.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:11.original: I may not be able to move the Mysterious Paintings, but I do have a "Slightly Mysterious Painting" on me!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:11.translation: Возможно, я не смогу переместить Таинственные картины, но у меня есть «Слегка загадочная картина»!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:12.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:12.original: A "Slightly Mysterious Painting"?! S-Sue, how did you...?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:13.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:13.original: Well, I don't care. As long as it's mysterious! Sue, will you show me your Painting?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:13.translation: Ну, мне все равно. Пока это загадочно! Сью, ты покажешь мне свою картину?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:14.original: Of course! Tadaa! Here it is!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:16.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:16.original: I see... This is your "Slightly Mysterious Painting"... It's a fascinating work indeed... Very peculiar style...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:16.translation: Понятно... Это ваша "Слегка загадочная картина"... Действительно увлекательная работа... Очень своеобразный стиль...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:17.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:17.original: If I restore it, I should be able to enter the painting world too... I must return and begin at once! Thank you!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:17.translation: Если я его восстановлю, я тоже смогу войти в нарисованный мир... Я должен вернуться и начать немедленно! Спасибо!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:18.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:18.original: Ah, she's gone... I only meant it as a joke...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:18.translation: Ах, она ушла... Я только пошутил...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:19.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:19.original: You fool! You stupid, stupid girl! You know full well that I painted that!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:19.translation: Ты дурак! Ты глупая, глупая девчонка! Вы прекрасно знаете, что я это нарисовал!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:20.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:20.original: Sorry, sorry. But think about it this way. Our teacher thought your painting was good.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:20.translation: Извините, извините. Но подумайте об этом вот так. Наш учитель считает, что ты хорошо рисуешь.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:21.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:21.original: Only as a "Slightly Mysterious Painting"! Hmph, of course she'd think my paintings are "mysterious"...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:21.translation: Только как «Слегка загадочная картина»! Хм, конечно, она подумает, что мои картины «загадочны»…!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:22.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:22.original: What else would you call a painting that can do what this does...? How can you not see that? Haha...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_030.ebm:22.translation: Как еще вы могли бы назвать картину, которая может делать то, что делает эта...? Как ты можешь этого не видеть? Хаха...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:0.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:0.original: I really am happy to be able to fight alongside you again, Ilmeria. I really feel like I can trust you to cover my back!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:0.translation: Я действительно рад снова сражаться вместе с тобой, Ильмерия. Я действительно чувствую, что могу довериться тебе, чтобы прикрыть мою спину!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:1.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:1.original: Well, I won't deny that I like it too. Besides, unless I'm near you, I feel like I'll get caught up in one of your explosions.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:1.translation: Ну не буду отрицать, что мне это тоже нравится. Кроме того, если я не буду рядом с тобой, мне кажется, что я попаду в один из твоих взрывов.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:2.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:2.original: Come on, I wouldn't do that... Probably. I don't think I've ever done that before, have I...?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:2.translation: Да ладно, я бы так не делал... Наверное. Я не думаю, что когда-либо делал это раньше, не так ли...?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:3.original: Excuse us! Oh, it's Firis. Have you come here to get some sweets from our teacher?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:3.translation: Простите нас! О, это Фирис. Вы пришли сюда, чтобы получить сладости от нашего учителя?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:4.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:4.original: Oh, you saw right through me. I just decided to have some tea with Ilmeria!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:4.translation: О, ты видел меня насквозь. Я просто решил попить чаю с Ильмерией!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:5.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:5.original: ...Oh, seeing you reminds me, Sue. There was something I meant to ask Ilmeria about.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:5.translation: ...О, видя тебя, это напомнило мне, Сью. Я хотел кое о чем спросить Ильмерию.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:6.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:6.original: Something you wanted to ask me? I hope it isn't anything too weird...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:6.translation: Ты что-то хотел у меня спросить? Надеюсь, это не что-то слишком странное...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:7.original: Don't worry... Ilmeria, I've noticed you haven't used your gun much recently. It looked so cool on you. How come?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:7.translation: Не волнуйся... Ильмерия, я заметил, что в последнее время ты мало пользуешься оружием. На тебе это выглядело так круто. Почему?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:8.original: A-A gun...?! You used to use a gun?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:9.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:9.original: Of course. My father taught me how to use it when I was young.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:9.translation: Конечно. Мой отец научил меня пользоваться им, когда я был маленьким.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:10.original: Huh...! Our teacher with a gun...! I'd love to see that...!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:10.translation: Хм...! Наш учитель с пистолетом...! Я бы хотел это увидеть...!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:11.original: But Firis is right - we've never seen you use one. Is there a reason for that?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:11.translation: Но Фирис прав: мы никогда не видели, чтобы вы им пользовались. Есть ли для этого причина?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:14.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:14.original: ...Mireille. As you know, I have been officially invited by this country to set up an atelier here.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:14.translation: ...Мирей. Как вы знаете, эта страна официально пригласила меня открыть здесь ателье.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:15.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:15.original: As I play a public role, I have been forbidden from using anything other than a traditional alchemist's staff.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:15.translation: Поскольку я играю общественную роль, мне запрещено использовать что-либо, кроме традиционного посоха алхимика.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:16.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:16.original: Oh, I see... I had no idea you operated under such strict rules...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:16.translation: О, понятно... Я понятия не имел, что вы действуете по таким строгим правилам...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:17.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:17.original: Nor did I. If we were under the country's auspices, both Sue and I would be forced to change too.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:17.translation: Я тоже. Если бы мы находились под эгидой страны, и Сью, и я тоже были бы вынуждены измениться.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:18.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:18.original: Hehe... Yes, dealing with the bureaucracy of a state is actually a lot more troublesome than it appears.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:18.translation: Хе-хе... Да, иметь дело с государственной бюрократией на самом деле гораздо сложнее, чем кажется.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:19.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:19.original: Don't you forget that, Lydie, Sue. You either, Firis. Hehehe...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:19.translation: Не забывайте об этом, Лиди, Сью. И ты, Фирис. Хехехе...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:20.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:20.original: I-I see... The politics of the real world can be very tricky...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_040.ebm:20.translation: Я-понятно... Политика реального мира может быть очень сложной...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:0.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:0.original: Hmm, I see... I wonder if that's due to a difference between schools of alchemic thought...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:0.translation: Хм, понятно... Интересно, связано ли это с разницей между школами алхимической мысли...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:1.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:1.original: Yes, probably. Plachta's alchemy may actually differ slightly from modern-day alchemy...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:1.translation: Да, наверное. Алхимия Плахты может немного отличаться от современной алхимии...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:2.original: Hello... Oh, Firis. What are you and Ilmeria talking about?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:2.translation: Привет... О, Фирис. О чем вы с Ильмерией говорите?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:3.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:3.original: Oh, there you are. In fact, we were just talking about that thing you two came up with.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:3.translation: О, вот и ты. На самом деле, мы только что говорили о том, что вы двое придумали.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:4.original: That thing...? What do you mean? The "Fully-Automatic Lecture Machine Ilmeria Mark 3", maybe?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:4.translation: Эта штука...? Что ты имеешь в виду? Может быть, «Полностью автоматическая лекционная машина Ильмерия Mark 3»?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:5.original: No, I bet they're talking about the "Pretty Ilmeria Doll"... Ah!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:5.translation: Нет, я уверен, они говорят о «Красивой кукле Ильмерии»… Ах!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:6.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:6.original: Hehe...! Lecture Machine...! Pretty Ilmeria Doll..?! Hehehe...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:6.translation: Хе-хе...! Лекционная машина...! Милая кукла Ильмерия..?! Хехехе...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:7.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:7.original: Wh-What are you two talking about? Why are you wasting your time thinking up things like that?!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:7.translation: Ч-о чем вы двое говорите? Зачем ты тратишь время на такие вещи?!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:8.original: U-Uh-oh...! Umm, Firis, what was it you were talking about?
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:8.translation: У-у-у...! Эмм, Фирис, о чём ты говорил?

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:9.original: Y-Yes! Tell us, please! We really would like to know!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:9.translation: Д-да! Расскажите нам, пожалуйста! Нам очень хотелось бы это знать!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:10.original: Huh? Oh, it was "Battle Mix." You know, the technique you use to synthesize things in-battle.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:10.translation: Хм? О, это был «Боевой синтез». Ну, вы знаете, технику, которую вы используете для синтеза вещей в бою.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:11.original: Ah! That was a revolutionary idea, even if I do say so myself. A truly historic achievement, if you'd like.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:11.translation: Ах! Это была революционная идея, даже если я сам так говорю. Поистине историческое достижение, если хотите.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:12.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:12.original: ...You might be right. I mean, it's turned the conventional alchemic wisdom on its head.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:12.translation: ...Возможно, ты прав. Я имею в виду, что это перевернуло общепринятую алхимическую мудрость с ног на голову.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:14.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:14.original: It's that you don't use anything like a cauldron. Traditionally, alchemy has always been conducted in a vessel...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:14.translation: Дело в том, что вы не используете ничего вроде котла. Традиционно алхимия всегда проводилась в сосуде...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:15.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:15.original: But "Battle Mix" makes use of Anima, allowing you to synthesize without any vessel.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:15.translation: Но в «Боевом синтезе» используется Анима, позволяющая синтезировать без какого-либо сосуда.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:16.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:16.original: That's a remarkable achievement. But it does make it more difficult.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:16.translation: Это замечательное достижение. Но это усложняет задачу.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:17.speaker: Firis
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:17.original: Sophie and I tried it out several times, but we just couldn't get it to work...
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:17.translation: Мы с Софи пробовали это несколько раз, но так и не смогли заставить это работать...

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:18.speaker: Sue
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:18.original: What?! Sophie and Firis...?! This is too much! Too much, Lydie! This is amazing!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:18.translation: Что?! Софи и Фирис...?! Это слишком много! Слишком много, Лидия! Это потрясающе!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:19.speaker: Lydie
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:19.original: I-I know! This makes it all somehow feel more real...! We invented something really incredible!
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:19.translation: Я-я знаю! Это делает все это каким-то образом более реальным...! Мы изобрели нечто действительно невероятное!

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:20.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:20.original: Haha... Well, Firis and I think the difficulty may be due to differences in schools of alchemy.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:20.translation: Ха-ха... Ну, мы с Фирисом думаем, что трудности могут быть связаны с различиями в школах алхимии.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:21.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:21.original: But it is certainly true that you two are very talented alchemists, to come up with something so remarkable.
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:21.translation: Но это правда, что вы двое очень талантливые алхимики, раз уж придумали что-то столь замечательное.

ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:22.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:xx05/event_message_xx05_050.ebm:22.original: You should stop wasting your time with lecture machines and dolls, and make something else truly useful.
